Henry the Lion burned the town, the cathedral and the cathedral hill in a feud in 1179, and from 1236 to 1239 the great cathedral was begun anew in the style of French Gothic, though it was consecrated only in 1491. The town had a town hall and its own law by 1241, and walls built between 1199 and 1236. In 1326 it allied with Aschersleben and Quedlinburg in the Halberstadt League of Three Towns, which lasted until 1477, and it joined the Hanse some time before 1387.

In 1363 the town bought the neighbouring Klus hills from Quedlinburg Abbey, and an earthquake is recorded in 1408. In 1423 the Halberstadt Schicht began, a revolt in which the craft guilds around Matthias von Hadeber, called the Long Matz, seized control of the town, until Bishop Johann of Hoym restored the old order in 1425. Bishops and burghers remained uneasy neighbours, with the cathedral chapter ruling the cathedral hill and the council ruling the town.

The first sermons of the Reformation came in 1521 but were driven out in 1523, and only in 1591 did the first Protestant bishop, Henry Julius, introduce Protestant teaching in the cathedral. The plague returned in 1577, 1597 and 1611. Wallenstein's troops occupied the town in 1625 and 1629, and with the Edict of Restitution the cathedral briefly returned to the old faith. The peace of 1648 turned the bishopric into a Protestant duchy within Brandenburg-Prussia. Huguenots settled here from 1685 and founded a glove industry, while the court Jew Issachar Berend Lehmann built a baroque synagogue consecrated in 1712 and a rabbinical seminary, making the Jewish community the largest in central Germany. From about 1750 Johann Gleim made his house a meeting place of the German Enlightenment.
simp_chinese:
哈尔伯施塔特自9世纪至1648年是主教驻地，位于哈尔茨山北部山前地带。狮子亨利在一场世仇中于1179年烧毁了城镇、大教堂和教堂山，1236至1239年间，一座法国哥特式风格的大教堂又重新动工，但直到1491年才祝圣。到1241年，城里已有市政厅和自己的法律，1199至1236年修建了城墙。1326年它与阿舍斯莱本和奎德林堡结成哈尔伯施塔特三城同盟，延续到1477年，并在1387年之前的某个时候加入了汉萨。

1363年城镇从奎德林堡女修院手中买下了毗邻的克鲁斯山丘，1408年有地震的记录。1423年哈尔伯施塔特“希希特”（Schicht）开始：手工业行会在马蒂亚斯·冯·哈德贝尔（外号“长个子马茨”）带领下夺取了城镇的控制权，直到1425年霍伊姆的约翰主教才恢复旧秩序。主教与市民始终是不安的邻居，大教堂参事会管辖教堂山，议会管辖城镇。

宗教改革的首批布道出现在1521年，但1523年即被驱逐，直到1591年，首位新教主教亨利·尤利乌斯才在大教堂里引入新教教义。1577年、1597年和1611年瘟疫再度发生。1625年和1629年华伦斯坦的军队占领此城，借助《归还敕令》，大教堂一度重回旧教。1648年的和约使主教区成为勃兰登堡-普鲁士境内的新教公国。1685年起胡格诺教徒定居于此，开创了手套工业；宫廷犹太人伊萨哈尔·贝伦德·莱曼修建了1712年祝圣的巴洛克犹太会堂，并设立拉比神学院，使这里的犹太社区成为德意志中部最大的一个。约1750年起，约翰·格莱姆把自己的家变成了德国启蒙运动的交流中心。

english: The Halchidhoma lived along the lower Colorado River, where riverbank settlements and fields formed part of a populous chain of Yuman-speaking communities. Their name has been interpreted as “people who live toward the water.” Seasonal floods watered the river’s bottomlands, making cultivation possible in a dry region. In 1604–1605 Juan de Oñate’s expedition encountered people identified as the Halchidhoma below the junction of the Colorado and Gila rivers. Later they formed alliances with the Maricopa and other neighbours in conflicts with the Quechan and Mojave. By the early nineteenth century warfare and movement had changed the position of communities along the river.
simp_chinese: 哈尔奇多马人居住在科罗拉多河下游，河岸聚落与田地属于一系列人口众多的尤曼语族社区。其族名被解释为“住在水边的人”。河流季节性泛滥浸润低地，使干旱地区能够耕种。1604至1605年，胡安·德·奥尼亚特远征队在科罗拉多河与希拉河汇合处下游遇到了被认作哈尔奇多马人的居民。后来，他们与马里科帕人等邻族结盟，对抗奎查恩人和莫哈韦人。到十九世纪初，战争与迁徙已改变沿河社区的位置。

english:
Halden grew as a timber port at the head of the Iddefjord, exporting wood to the Netherlands and England from the sixteenth century. The loss of Bohuslän to Sweden in 1658 placed it close to the new frontier. After its inhabitants resisted Swedish attacks, Frederick III granted the town privileges in 1665 and named it Fredrikshald. Above the harbour rose the fortress of Fredriksten, begun in 1661 to guard the approach to eastern Norway.

In 1716 townspeople set fire to their own houses to drive out the forces of Charles XII. The Swedish king returned in 1718 and was shot dead while besieging the fortress, after which his army withdrew. Fredriksten faced another Swedish siege in 1814; the Convention of Moss brought a ceasefire, and the garrison left the fortress under its terms.
simp_chinese:
哈尔登兴起于伊德峡湾尽头，自16世纪起便作为木材港口向尼德兰和英格兰出口。1658年布胡斯伦割让给瑞典后，此地紧邻新边界。居民抵御瑞典进攻后，腓特烈三世于1665年授予城市特权，并将其命名为腓特烈斯哈尔。港口上方的腓特烈斯滕堡垒于1661年动工，负责守卫通往挪威东部的道路。

1716年，市民放火焚烧自己的房屋，以驱逐卡尔十二世的军队。瑞典国王于1718年再次来袭，在围攻堡垒时中弹身亡，其军队随后撤退。1814年腓特烈斯滕再度遭到瑞典军队围攻；《莫斯协定》带来停火，守军依照条款撤离堡垒。

english: Haldensleben grew on the Ohre and was recorded in a charter of Otto I in 966. A fortified settlement developed under Henry the Lion, but Archbishop Wichmann of Magdeburg besieged and destroyed it in 1181, damming the river to flood the town. Rebuilding began in 1223, and Magdeburg town law followed in 1224. A Cistercian nunnery was founded nearby at Althaldensleben in 1228. The town's Roland, a mounted figure associated with civic rights, was first recorded in 1419. The Reformation was introduced in 1541. Plague took a heavy toll in 1636 during the Thirty Years' War, and a great fire destroyed sixty houses in 1661.
simp_chinese: 哈尔登斯莱本兴起于奥勒河畔，见于奥托一世966年的宪章。狮子亨利统治下形成了设防聚落，但1181年马格德堡大主教维希曼围攻并摧毁此地，攻城者筑坝使河水淹没城镇。1223年重建开始，1224年城镇获得马格德堡城市法。1228年，附近的旧哈尔登斯莱本建立熙笃会女修院。与城市权利相关的骑马罗兰像最早见于1419年的记载。宗教改革于1541年传入。三十年战争期间，1636年的瘟疫造成惨重损失；1661年的大火又烧毁了六十座房屋。

english:
Haleri lies in the wooded hills of Kodagu, the country known as Coorg. It gave its name to a dynasty that united the region under a line of rajas connected by tradition with the Nayakas of Ikkeri. The chiefs first established their seat here among the forested slopes of the Western Ghats, where many local rulers had previously held separate territories.

Muddu Raja ruled from Haleri in the seventeenth century before establishing a new royal capital at Madikeri, where he built a fort and palace in 1681. His descendants continued to rule Kodagu through conflicts with Mysore and other neighbours. In 1834 the East India Company deposed Chikka Viraraja, bringing the long rule of the Haleri dynasty in Kodagu to an end.
simp_chinese:
哈莱里位于库格，即科达古的森林山地。这座聚落为统一当地的罗阇王朝命名，传统认为该王朝与伊凯里那耶迦有亲属关系。此前地方首领各自掌管领地，新王朝最初在西高止山脉林木覆盖的山坡间建立驻地。

十七世纪，穆杜罗阇从哈莱里统治，后来在马迪凯里建立新都，并于1681年修建堡垒和宫殿。他的后代继续统治科达古，经历了与迈索尔及其他邻国的冲突。1834年，东印度公司废黜奇卡·维罗阇，哈莱里王朝的统治就此结束。

sources.title: TVA BOK 0046866 Mysore and Coorg Vol 3.pdf

english: The caves of Halesi are a place of pilgrimage in the hills of eastern Nepal, revered by Hindu, Buddhist and Kirati communities. Hindus associate them with Mahadeva, a form of Shiva. Buddhists call the caves Maratika and connect them with Padmasambhava, while the Kirati Rai honour them as an ancestral place of Raechhakule. The caves are mentioned in Himalayan literature by the twelfth century, including a biography of Padmasambhava revealed by Nyangrel Nyima Ozer.
simp_chinese: 哈利西洞窟位于尼泊尔东部丘陵，是印度教徒、佛教徒和基拉特诸族共同敬仰的朝圣地。印度教徒将它与湿婆的化身摩诃提婆联系起来；佛教徒称其为玛拉蒂卡，认为这里与莲花生有关；基拉特赖人则视之为祖先拉埃恰库勒的居所。至迟在十二世纪，喜马拉雅文献已提及这些洞窟，其中包括娘热·尼玛沃色发掘的莲花生传记。

english:
Hali, historically known as Hali ibn Yaqub, stood in the coastal plain south of al-Qunfudhah on the eastern side of the Red Sea. It developed as a station on the road between Yemen and Mecca and became a substantial town long before the fourteenth century. Its wadi linked the plain to the Asir mountains, while an anchorage on the coast connected the district with Red Sea shipping. The town thus belonged to both the overland pilgrimage route and the coastal world facing Africa.

Ibn Battuta's account from shortly before the middle of the fourteenth century gives a particularly vivid picture. After sailing from Suakin, he reached Hali and described a large, populous town and an impressive congregational mosque. He also visited an Indian ascetic, Qabala, whose modest dwelling adjoined the mosque. The man's companions gathered for prayer and remembrance, and visitors were offered simple food. The account places local religious life within the movements of pilgrims and scholars across the Red Sea and Indian Ocean, alongside the roads that connected Hali with neighboring Arabian districts.
simp_chinese:
哈利旧称哈利·伊本·雅各布，位于红海东岸、贡富宰以南的滨海平原。它从也门通往麦加道路上的驿站发展而来，十四世纪以前已成为相当规模的城镇。当地河谷把平原同阿西尔山地相接，沿海锚地则连接红海航运。因此，哈利既属于陆上朝觐道路，也参与面向非洲的沿海往来。

伊本·白图泰在十四世纪上半叶留下了生动记述。他由萨瓦金乘船抵达哈利，描述这里人口众多、建筑良好，并赞赏当地的聚礼清真寺。他还拜访来自印度的苦行者卡巴拉，其简朴住所紧靠清真寺。信众聚集祈祷、记念真主，来客则受到简单食物的招待。这一记录把哈利的地方宗教生活置于红海和印度洋之间朝觐者、学者的流动之中；通往邻近阿拉伯地区的道路，又使海上的交往向内陆延伸。

english:
Halifax Bay entered James Cook's journal during the Endeavour's northward voyage along the Australian coast in June 1770. The bay he described formed part of a coast already inhabited and watched by Aboriginal people. On 8 June, as the ship passed islands off the northern end of the waters he called Halifax Bay, Cook recorded people gathered on a nearby island looking towards the vessel.

His account also shows the care required in navigating this coast. The Endeavour passed through a channel between the outer islands and those nearer shore, and soundings during the day's sailing ranged from seven to sixteen fathoms. Cook identified Dunk Island as the bay's northern boundary in his contemporary description. Islands, narrow passages and measured depths therefore accompanied the European charting of a sea landscape whose inhabitants were present throughout the encounter.
simp_chinese:
1770年6月，奋进号沿澳大利亚东岸北行，哈利法克斯湾进入詹姆斯·库克的航海日志。这是一片早已有原住民居住和观察海上活动的海岸。6月8日，船只经过他称作哈利法克斯湾北端外侧的岛群时，库克记下附近一座岛上有人聚集，注视着舰船。

日志也呈现了沿岸航行所需的谨慎。奋进号穿过外侧岛屿与近岸岛屿之间的水道，当日航程中的测深在七至十六英寻之间。库克在当时的描述中，把邓克岛列为海湾北界。岛屿、狭窄通道与反复测量的水深共同进入欧洲人的海图和文字记录；原住民则始终在这次相遇的海岸现场。

english:
Haliti is the self-designation of the Arawakan-speaking peoples commonly called Paresí, in the plateau country of Mato Grosso. The word can mean people or human beings. Their communities formed a network of related groups across the plateau, linked by language and social relationships. Kazíniti, Wáimare and other names distinguished parts of this social and linguistic landscape, which extended across headwater country between the Paraguay and Amazon drainage systems.

The earliest colonial references to Paresí country date from the last quarter of the seventeenth century. In the following decades Antônio Pires de Campos ascended the Sepotuba and reached a plateau he called the kingdom of the Parecis. His own observations described numerous inhabitants and decentralized political organization. Farther north he encountered people he named Mahibarez, similar in customs but differing in parts of their language. Slave-raiding followed these encounters. During the expansion of the Cuiabá mines, nearby Paresí villages were treated as sources of enslaved labour and food. The mining frontier thus drew on established communities while subjecting their inhabitants to capture, displacement and growing colonial demands.
simp_chinese:
哈利蒂是马托格罗索高原上通常被称为帕雷西的阿拉瓦克语族群体的自称，可意为人或人民。其社群由散布高原、彼此相关的群体构成，通过语言和社会关系相互连接。卡齐尼蒂、瓦伊马雷等名称，区分这一社会与语言地域的不同部分；他们生活于巴拉圭河与亚马孙水系之间的源头地带。

殖民文献对帕雷西地区的最早记载始于十七世纪最后二十五年。随后几十年，安东尼奥·皮雷斯·德坎波斯沿塞波图巴河上行，抵达他称作帕雷西王国的高原；但他的实际观察描述的是人口众多、政治组织分散的社会。更北方还有被他称为马希巴雷斯的居民，习俗相似，语言部分词汇不同。接触后随之而来的是捕奴活动。库亚巴矿业扩张期间，附近帕雷西村落被当作奴役劳动和食物的来源。矿业边疆因此依赖既有社群，也给居民带来掳掠、迁徙和不断增加的殖民要求。

english:
Schwäbisch Hall rose in the valley of the Kocher around a salt spring. Brine was boiled here for centuries, providing the basis of the town's wealth, while a ford brought trade through the settlement. Hall was securely recorded in 1156 and became an imperial city in 1280. Its mint produced the small silver coin known as the Heller, which circulated widely throughout the Empire.

In 1396 the city itself acquired the right to mint coins. Disputes with the court of Würzburg prompted its council to assert that Hall belonged to Swabia; in 1489 it formally adopted the name Schwäbisch Hall. Its saltworks remained central to the economy, and in the early eighteenth century new methods of concentrating brine reduced the fuel needed for boiling. Imperial independence ended in 1802, when the city and its saltworks passed to Württemberg.
simp_chinese:
施瓦本哈尔兴起于科赫尔河谷的一处盐泉旁。居民数百年来在此煮卤制盐，为城镇财富奠定基础；河上的浅滩也将贸易引入聚落。哈尔于一一五六年有可靠的文献记载，一二八〇年成为帝国城市。当地铸造的赫勒小银币在帝国各地广泛流通。

一三九六年，城市取得铸币权。与维尔茨堡法庭的争执促使市议会宣称哈尔属于施瓦本；一四八九年，议会正式采用“施瓦本哈尔”这一名称。盐场仍是当地经济的核心；十八世纪初，浓缩盐水的新方法减少了煮盐所需的燃料。一八〇二年，城市与盐场归属符腾堡，帝国城市的独立地位随之终结。

english: The Hall Islands lie north of Chuuk Lagoon and include the low atolls of Nomwin and Murilo. Canoes connected their communities with other islands in the Carolines. In 1824 Captain John Hall sighted these islands from the Lady Blackwood after passing Chuuk; the group later received his name on European charts.
simp_chinese: 霍尔群岛位于楚克潟湖北方，包括诺姆温和穆里洛等低矮环礁。独木舟将当地社群与加罗林群岛其他岛屿连接起来。1824年，约翰·霍尔船长乘黑木夫人号经过楚克后望见这些岛屿；欧洲海图后来以他的名字称呼这组岛。

english:
Halle grew around salt springs on the Saale, used since prehistory and first named Halla in 806. Its salt boilers, the Halloren, made the town rich, and for about two centuries it ruled itself as a member of the Hanseatic League under the archbishops of Magdeburg. In 1418 the town began the Red Tower, a bell tower built to the honour of God and for the adornment of Halle and its surroundings, which became its landmark.

In 1478 the town's independence ended. Archbishop Ernest II of Wettin issued a new constitution in 1479 that ended its Hanse membership in practice, and in 1484 he began the Moritzburg in the north-west corner as a fortified residence, intended as a stronghold against the self-confident salt boilers, and moved in ceremonially in 1503. Until 1680 Halle was the capital and residence of the archbishopric of Magdeburg.

Cardinal Albrecht of Brandenburg made Halle his favourite residence and built on the Moritzburg and the cathedral, but he demolished the Neuwerk monastery and the chapel of Saint Lambert, and his permanent lack of money led him to sell relics from the Halle collection. Between 1530 and 1554 the Romanesque churches of Saint Gertrude and Saint Mary on the market were torn down and replaced by the Marktkirche between their towers. After Albrecht left in 1541 the Reformation was introduced under Justus Jonas, and Luther preached several times in the Marktkirche; in 1546 his body lay in state here on its way from Eisleben to Wittenberg. Wallenstein's imperial troops occupied the town in 1625 and the Moritzburg burned out in 1637. In 1680 Halle fell with the archbishopric to Brandenburg, and the university opened in 1694.
simp_chinese:
哈雷围绕萨勒河畔的盐泉发展起来，盐泉自史前起就被利用，806年首次被称为“Halla”。制盐工人哈洛伦（Halloren）使这座城镇富裕，约两个世纪里，它作为汉萨同盟成员在马格德堡大主教治下实行自治。1418年城镇开始兴建红塔，这座钟楼“为荣耀上帝，装点哈雷及周边地区”，后来成了城市的象征。

1478年，城市的独立走到终点。1479年大主教韦廷的恩斯特二世颁布新的市政条例，实际上终结了汉萨成员资格；1484年他在西北角动工兴建莫里茨堡作为设防的居所，本意是对付自信的制盐工人的堡垒，并于1503年隆重入驻。直到1680年，哈雷一直是马格德堡大主教区的首府和驻地。

勃兰登堡的阿尔布雷希特红衣主教把哈雷当作最爱的驻地，扩建了莫里茨堡和大教堂，但也拆除了新工修道院和兰贝特礼拜堂，长期缺钱又使他出售了哈雷珍藏的圣物。1530至1554年，市场上罗马式的圣格特鲁德教堂和圣母教堂被拆毁，两教堂的塔楼之间建起了集市教堂。1541年阿尔布雷希特离开后，宗教改革在尤斯图斯·约纳斯主持下传入，路德多次在集市教堂布道，1546年他的遗体从艾斯莱本运往维滕贝格途中曾停放在这里。1625年华伦斯坦的帝国军队占领该城，1637年莫里茨堡被烧毁。1680年哈雷随大主教区划归勃兰登堡，1694年大学开办。

english:
Hallein lies on the Salzach below the salt-bearing Dürrnberg. Salt was mined there in antiquity, and a salt pan at the medieval settlement was recorded in 1198. The town grew around its boiling houses, where brine from the mountain was turned into salt. By the sixteenth century Hallein had become a major producer, and trade along the Salzach brought the archbishops of Salzburg a large share of their revenues.

The wealth of the salt trade was not equally shared by its workers. Lost markets and competition with Bavaria brought hardship to miners and salt workers. In 1731–1732, during the expulsion of Protestants from Salzburg, 780 Dürrnberg miners and their families left the country. After the archbishopric lost its independence in the Napoleonic wars, Hallein passed to the Austrian Empire in 1816.
simp_chinese:
哈莱因位于萨尔察河畔，坐落在蕴藏盐矿的迪恩山下。古代人已在山上采盐；一一九八年的文书记载了中世纪聚落中的盐锅。城镇围绕煮盐场发展，工人将山上运来的卤水熬成盐。到十六世纪，哈莱因已成为重要产盐地，沿萨尔察河的盐贸易为萨尔茨堡大主教带来大量收入。

盐贸易的财富并未平均分配给工人。市场丧失和与巴伐利亚的竞争，使矿工和盐场工人陷入困境。一七三一至一七三二年萨尔茨堡驱逐新教徒期间，七百八十名迪恩山矿工及其家人离开故土。拿破仑战争中，大主教领地失去独立地位；一八一六年，哈莱因归属奥地利帝国。

english: Hallingdal follows the Hallingdal River through a long valley between the high country of eastern and western Norway. Farms and villages occupy the valley floor and slopes, while mountain pastures rise above them. At Torpo stands a stave church, built in the late twelfth century and dedicated to Saint Margaret. Its timber walls and painted medieval ceiling preserve the work of the craftsmen and worshippers who made the valley their home.
simp_chinese: 哈灵达尔沿哈灵达尔河展开，长谷位于挪威东西部高地之间。农场和村落分布在谷底与山坡，山地牧场则更高。托尔波有一座建于12世纪末的木板教堂，献给圣玛格丽特；木墙与绘有中世纪壁画的天花板留存着山谷工匠和信众的手艺。

english:
Halmstad stands at the mouth of the Nissan on the coast of Halland. Its harbour and position between the Scandinavian kingdoms made it a place of trade and negotiation. During the Kalmar Union, rulers and representatives met here repeatedly, at the Dominican friary and later at St Nicholas Church, to discuss the affairs of Denmark, Norway and Sweden.

In 1619 a great fire destroyed almost the whole town. King Christian IV ordered a new plan before rebuilding could begin, with broad straight streets and a large square suited to the needs of the garrison. Halland passed from Denmark to Sweden under the peace of 1645. War returned in 1676, when Swedish forces defeated a Danish army at Fyllebro outside Halmstad, while the Scanian War brought renewed uncertainty to the former Danish province.
simp_chinese:
哈尔姆斯塔德坐落在哈尔兰海岸尼桑河入海处。港口及位于斯堪的纳维亚诸王国之间的位置，使它成为贸易与谈判之地。卡尔马联盟时期，统治者和代表多次在此会晤，在多明我会修院及后来的圣尼古拉教堂商议丹麦、挪威和瑞典事务。

1619年，大火几乎毁灭整座城镇。克里斯蒂安四世命令先制定新城计划，再开始重建；宽阔笔直的街道和大广场服务于驻军需要。1645年和约将哈尔兰从丹麦转交瑞典。1676年战争再度到来，瑞典军队在城外菲勒布罗击败丹麦军；斯科讷战争也给这个原属丹麦的地区带来新的动荡。

english: Halona Idiwan’a is a Zuni pueblo in the valley of the Zuni River. It was one of the communities known to the Spanish as the cities of Cíbola, a group of villages surrounded by fields in a dry plateau country. A Franciscan mission was established here in the seventeenth century. During the Pueblo Revolt of 1680, the Zuni killed the priest at Halona and burned the church. They withdrew to the defensible mesa of Dowa Yalanne, remaining there after the Spanish return to New Mexico. Around 1699 they resettled together at Halona, forming the community that became Zuni Pueblo.
simp_chinese: 哈洛纳伊迪瓦纳是祖尼河谷中的一座祖尼人普韦布洛。它是西班牙人口中“锡沃拉诸城”之一；这些村落位于干旱高原，周围分布着田地。十七世纪，方济各会士在此建立传教站。1680年普韦布洛起义期间，祖尼人在哈洛纳杀死神父并焚毁教堂。他们退到易守的多瓦亚兰内台地，西班牙人重返新墨西哥后仍留在那里。约1699年，居民重新聚居哈洛纳，形成后来所称的祖尼普韦布洛。

english: Halshany was the seat of the princely Olshansky family in the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. Sophia of Halshany, who became queen of Poland, was born here; her marriage to Władysław Jagiełło ensured the continuation of the Jagiellonian dynasty. The Sapieha family later held the town and built a castle in the early seventeenth century. The wars of that century reduced Halshany, and the partitions of the Commonwealth brought it under Russian rule. French and Polish troops passed through the area during Napoleon's campaign of 1812.
simp_chinese: 哈尔沙内曾是立陶宛大公国奥尔尚斯基亲王家族的驻地。后来成为波兰王后的哈尔沙内的索菲娅出生于此，她与瓦迪斯瓦夫·雅盖沃的婚姻使雅盖隆王朝得以延续。此后萨皮耶哈家族拥有城镇，并在十七世纪初修建城堡。同世纪的战争使哈尔沙内衰落，联邦被瓜分后它归入俄罗斯。1812年拿破仑远征期间，法国和波兰军队经过这一地区。

english:
Halych gave its name to Galicia and to the principality that once ruled much of the country between the Carpathians and Volhynia. The princely capital stood above the Lukva, near the Dniester, with great earthworks, churches and the residence of its rulers. Prince Volodymyrko made Halych his capital in 1141; under Yaroslav Osmomysl it became a major centre of Rus'.

After the Mongol invasion of 1241 the old capital declined and its inhabitants concentrated near the river port. The later town received Magdeburg rights in 1367, when a Catholic bishopric was also established; the archbishop's seat moved to Lviv in 1409. Halych remained an administrative centre of the Polish Ruthenian Voivodeship, and from 1564 its regional assembly met here. Tatar raiders burned it in 1621, Cossacks devastated it in 1649, and further destruction followed during the Ottoman war in 1676. Habsburg troops occupied Halych in 1772 during the first partition of Poland.
simp_chinese:
哈雷奇为加利西亚及曾统治喀尔巴阡山与沃里尼亚之间大片土地的公国命名。诸侯时代的首府位于德涅斯特河附近的卢克瓦河上方，拥有巨大的土垒、教堂和统治者的居所。1141年，弗拉基米尔科公爵迁都哈雷奇；雅罗斯拉夫·奥斯莫梅斯尔治下，它成为罗斯的重要中心。

1241年蒙古入侵后，旧都渐趋衰落，居民向河港附近集中。后来的城镇于1367年获得马格德堡法权，同年还设立天主教主教区；大主教驻地于1409年迁至利沃夫。哈雷奇仍是波兰鲁塞尼亚省的行政中心，1564年起地区议会在此开会。1621年鞑靼劫掠者焚毁城镇，1649年哥萨克又使其荒废；1676年奥斯曼战争期间，这里再次遭到破坏。1772年第一次瓜分波兰时，哈布斯堡军占领哈雷奇。

english:
Hama stands on the Orontes in central Syria, surrounded by gardens watered from the river. Great wooden waterwheels, or norias, lift water into channels that supply orchards, baths and mosques. Their large wooden rims carry rows of containers, which fill as the river turns the wheel and empty into a channel at the top. Their creaking frames have long marked the city's riverbanks. Hama was also the home of the historian and geographer Abu al-Fida, an Ayyubid prince who ruled the city in the early fourteenth century.

The largest of the dated wheels, al-Muhammadiyya, was built in 1361 under the Mamluks. Its compartments raised water to an aqueduct of stone arches leading towards the Great Mosque. Other wheels served gardens on both banks of the Orontes, making the river's current work against the height of the surrounding land. These machines joined the city's daily life to the fertile orchards beyond its walls.

After the Ottoman conquest of Syria in 1516, Hama remained a provincial city of merchants, craftsmen and notable families. In the eighteenth century the Azm family became prominent in Syrian government, while other local families maintained religious and commercial influence. Courtyard houses and reception halls enriched the older town, whose river, gardens and waterwheels continued to give Hama a character of its own.
simp_chinese:
哈马位于叙利亚中部奥龙特河畔，周围园圃由河水灌溉。巨大的木制提水轮将水送入渠道，供应果园、浴场和清真寺；木轮边缘排列着水斗，河流推动水轮转动，水斗装满后升至顶部，将水倒入渠道。水轮转动的声音长期伴随着河岸生活。哈马也是历史学家兼地理学家阿布·菲达的故乡，这位阿尤布王子曾在十四世纪初统治此城。

已知年代的最大水轮穆罕默迪耶建于一三六一年马穆鲁克统治时期。轮缘的水斗将河水提升至石拱水渠，再送往大清真寺。其他水轮灌溉奥龙特河两岸的园圃，使河流的力量克服周围地面的高度。这些机器把城中日常生活与城外肥沃果园联系起来。

一五一六年奥斯曼人征服叙利亚后，哈马仍是商人、工匠和显贵家族聚居的地方城市。十八世纪，阿兹姆家族在叙利亚政坛崭露头角，其他地方家族则保有宗教和商业影响力。庭院住宅与接待厅增添了旧城的面貌，河流、园圃和水轮依旧构成哈马独特的风景。

english: The Hamada al-Hamra, or Red Hamada, is a vast stony plateau south of the Nafusa Mountains. It stretches towards the northern edge of Fezzan, its exposed rock and gravel contrasting with the great sand seas farther south. Dry valleys cut the plateau, carrying water only after infrequent rain. The hamada forms part of the formidable desert country between the cultivated Mediterranean coast and the oasis settlements of the interior.
simp_chinese: 哈马达哈姆拉意为红色石漠，是奈富塞山脉以南广阔的砾石高原。它向费赞北缘延伸，裸露的岩石和砾石与更南方巨大的沙海形成对比。干谷切过高原，只有在罕见降雨之后才有水流。这片石漠是地中海沿岸耕作地区与内陆绿洲之间艰险荒漠的一部分。

english:
Hamadan lies on the slopes of Mount Alvand in the cold highlands of western Iran, on the site of Ecbatana, the first capital of the Medes, beside the Achaemenid Ganj Nameh inscriptions. Under the Buyids and then the Seljuks it prospered, and the Seljuk sultans shifted their capital here from Baghdad. Benjamin of Tudela reported a community of 30,000 Jews in 1170. The Mongols destroyed the city in 1220, and it was later completely destroyed again in the Timurid invasions.

Hamadan revived under the Safavids. It stands on the Silk Road, and its commerce depended on the main roads of western Iran. In the chaos of the early 18th century Kurdish tribes seized Hamadan in 1719 and pushed nearly as far as Isfahan, and the city was then surrendered to the Ottomans, until Nader Shah cleared the invaders and a peace treaty returned it to Iran.
simp_chinese:
哈马丹位于伊朗西部寒冷高地的阿尔万德山坡上，所在之处是米底人的第一座都城埃克巴坦那，旁边就是阿契美尼德王朝的甘杰纳梅铭文。布韦希王朝和塞尔柱王朝时期这里相当繁荣，塞尔柱苏丹把都城从巴格达迁到此地。图德拉的本杰明记载1170年这里有三万犹太人。蒙古人在1220年毁坏了这座城市，后来在帖木儿入侵中它又被彻底毁灭。

萨法维时期哈马丹复兴。它位于丝绸之路上，商业依赖伊朗西部的干线道路。18世纪初的混乱中，库尔德部落于1719年占领哈马丹，几乎推进到伊斯法罕，随后城市被交给奥斯曼人，直到纳迪尔沙清除入侵者，并通过和约使其重归伊朗。

english:
Hamarøy occupies a peninsula and neighbouring islands between the fjords of northern Nordland. Its coastal landscape contains both Norwegian and Lule Sami histories, while the name refers particularly to the western peninsula. Medieval accounts describe large farms in this country; Håkon Håkonsson's saga places the royal official Håkon Raud here in the thirteenth century.

For the early modern inhabitants, Presteid became an enduring parish centre. A church there is documented in 1589. The earlier building, probably a stave church, was replaced in 1655. By about 1770 that replacement had deteriorated, and in 1775 a new timber church rose on the same site. Repeated rebuilding kept the parish's religious focus in place across generations, even as the structures themselves changed. In 1837, Hamarøy became the Hammerø local government district under Norway's new municipal system. The parish community and the emerging municipality thus connected older coastal settlement with the institutions of nineteenth-century local government.
simp_chinese:
哈马略由诺尔兰北部峡湾间的半岛及邻近岛屿构成，沿海景观兼有挪威与吕勒萨米历史，地名尤其指西部半岛。中世纪记述提及当地大农庄，《哈康·哈康松萨迦》还将十三世纪王室官员哈康·劳德的居所置于此地。

近代早期，普雷斯泰德长期作为教区中心。1589年已有当地教堂的记录；较早建筑可能是木板教堂，1655年被新堂取代。约1770年，新堂也已破旧，1775年又在原址建起木结构教堂。建筑屡次更替，使教区的宗教中心跨世代延续。1837年，挪威实施新的地方自治制度，建立名为Hammerø的地方行政区。教区社群与初建的自治机构，由此把较早的沿海居民点连接到十九世纪地方政府的发展。

english: Hambantota lies on the dry southern coast of Sri Lanka, where natural salt pans provided a valuable resource for the island’s interior. The coastal settlement served the country of Ruhuna and later developed as a port under British rule. In the early nineteenth century the British sent convicts to collect salt at the Maha Levaya. After an attack by Kandyan forces in 1803, they began a round Martello gun tower on a nearby hill; work was under way in 1805.
simp_chinese: 汉班托塔位于斯里兰卡干燥的南部海岸，天然盐田为岛屿内陆提供珍贵资源。沿海聚落服务于鲁胡纳地区，后来在英国统治下发展为港口。十九世纪初，英国人将囚犯送往马哈莱瓦亚盐田采盐。1803年康提军队袭击后，他们开始在附近山丘修筑圆形马泰洛炮塔，1805年工程仍在进行。

english: Hambatus lies in the central Ecuadorian highlands, in the valley of the Ambato River. The settlement that became Ambato grew amid a landscape of mountains and fertile valleys. A destructive earthquake struck in 1698, bringing down slopes and devastating the town. Colonial officials subsequently established Ambato again on land purchased from the Indigenous Quisapincha; the town declared independence from Spain in November 1820.
simp_chinese: 汉巴图斯位于厄瓜多尔中部高地的安巴托河谷。后来发展为安巴托的聚落坐落在群山与肥沃河谷之间。1698年，一场破坏性的地震引发山坡崩塌，摧毁了城镇。殖民官员随后在向原住民基萨平查人购买的土地上重建安巴托；1820年11月，城镇宣布脱离西班牙独立。

english: The Hambukushu are a Bantu-speaking people of the Kavango and Okavango river country, with traditions linking their origins to Barotseland. Their language is Thimbukushu, and the Hambukushu kingdom is one of the Kavango kingdoms. Fishing, cultivation and livestock keeping have sustained communities along the river and around the delta. The Hambukushu are also known for basketry and for rainmaking: their rain chiefs hold a special place in the traditions of the Okavango.
simp_chinese: 汉布库舒人是卡万戈河和奥卡万戈河流域的班图语族居民，传统将他们的起源与巴罗策兰联系起来。他们使用提姆布库舒语，汉布库舒王国是卡万戈诸王国之一。沿河及三角洲周围的社群以捕鱼、耕作和畜牧为生。汉布库舒人也以编篮和祈雨闻名，他们的祈雨首领在奥卡万戈的传统中占有特殊地位。

english: The Hamcumqua, also called the Inqua, were Khoekhoe herders of the southern African interior. Their country lay north of the coastal communities of the southern Cape, and their herds attracted the attention of Dutch traders. In 1689 the Cape expedition led by Isaac Schrijver crossed the mountains to seek livestock and met Hykon, an Inqua leader. The meeting brought the Dutch into contact with a pastoral society whose relationships extended across the country beyond the coastal ranges.
simp_chinese: 哈姆昆夸又称因夸，是南部非洲内陆的科伊科伊牧人。他们的土地位于开普南岸社群以北，牛羊吸引了荷兰商人的注意。1689年，伊萨克·施赖弗率领的开普远征队穿越群山寻找牲畜，见到了因夸领袖海孔。荷兰人由此接触到一个牧业社会，其关系网络遍及沿海山脉以外的地区。

english: Hamdallaye lies northeast of the Niger River in Zarma country, amid the dry farmland and bush of the Sahel. A Zarma seat of authority was established here in the middle of the seventeenth century. The surrounding villages raised millet and sorghum in the rainy season, while herders moved between pastures to the north and the lands near the Niger. Stands of combretum and guiera shrubs grow among the grasses, giving the country its characteristic broken cover.
simp_chinese: 哈姆达拉耶位于尼日尔河东北方的扎尔马地区，周围是萨赫勒的旱地农田和灌木丛。十七世纪中叶，这里建立了一处扎尔马人统治中心。附近村落在雨季种植粟米和高粱，牧人则往返于北方草场与尼日尔河附近的土地之间。诃子属和西非榄仁属灌木散生在草地中，使这一带的植被呈现斑驳的形态。

english:
Hamelin grew on the Weser around a monastery founded in the ninth century. By the twelfth century the surrounding settlement had become a town; its best-known story tells of a piper who led away its children in 1284. Hamelin also traded as a minor member of the Hanseatic League in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries.

During the Thirty Years' War Swedish forces besieged the town, and an imperial army attempting to relieve it was defeated at Oldendorf in 1633. From 1664 Hamelin developed as a fortified frontier town of Calenberg and later Hanover. New forts rose around it in the eighteenth century, giving it a formidable reputation among the fortified towns of the region. In 1806 the garrison surrendered to the French, who subsequently dismantled much of its defences.
simp_chinese:
哈默尔恩兴起于威悉河畔一座九世纪创立的修道院周围。到十二世纪，附近聚落已发展为城镇；最著名的故事讲述一名吹笛人于1284年带走了当地儿童。十五至十六世纪，哈默尔恩也是汉萨同盟的小型贸易成员。

三十年战争期间，瑞典军队围攻城镇，前来解围的帝国军队于1633年在奥尔登多夫战败。自1664年起，哈默尔恩发展为卡伦贝格、后来又是汉诺威的边境设防城镇。十八世纪，周围新建了多座堡垒，使它在地区设防城镇中获得坚固的声誉。1806年，守军向法国军队投降，法军随后拆除了大部分城防。

english: Hamenk was a Selk’nam territory on the main island of Tierra del Fuego. Selk’nam families organised the island into territories known as haruwen and moved through open plains, forests and river valleys. The guanaco was central to their hunting economy, supplying food, hides and materials for tools and shelter. The windswept country lay between the Atlantic coast and the wooded interior of the island.
simp_chinese: 哈门克是火地岛主岛上的一处塞尔克南领地。塞尔克南家庭将全岛划分为称作哈鲁文的领地，在开阔平原、森林和河谷之间移动。原驼是狩猎经济的核心，提供食物、皮毛以及制作工具和住所的材料。这片多风地区介于大西洋海岸与岛屿森林内陆之间。

english: Hamhŭng was the principal town of Korea's northeastern province and the seat of its governor. It was also closely associated with the family of Yi Sŏnggye, founder of the Joseon dynasty. After becoming King Taejo in 1392, he established a shrine at his ancestors' former home here, where tablets for four generations of his forebears were honoured. The town's walls and government buildings marked its importance in the administration of Hamgyŏng.
simp_chinese: 咸兴是朝鲜东北部的大邑，也是咸镜道监营所在地。这里与朝鲜王朝开国者李成桂的家族关系密切。他于1392年即位为太祖后，在祖先旧宅所在地建立本宫，祭祀先祖四代的神位。城墙与官衙显示出咸兴在咸镜道治理中的重要地位。

english:
Hamhmam lies in Karukinka, the Selk'nam name for Tierra del Fuego. The island's northern and central plains and its southern mountains were home to Selk'nam communities. Hunting supplied food and skins, and guanaco and fox skins were used for clothing and footwear.

Selk'nam extended families occupied territories known as haruwenh, whose boundaries neighbouring groups generally respected. The nearby Haush shared a number of cultural traits with the Selk'nam. European ships began passing the southern continent in the sixteenth century.
simp_chinese:
哈姆玛姆位于卡鲁金卡，即火地岛的塞尔克南语名称。岛屿北部和中部的平原以及南部山地，是塞尔克南人社群的家园。狩猎提供食物和兽皮，原驼与狐狸皮用于制作衣物和鞋。

塞尔克南人的扩展家庭占有称为 haruwenh 的领地，其边界通常受到邻近群体尊重。附近的豪什人与塞尔克南人具有若干相似的文化特征。十六世纪起，欧洲船只开始经过南美洲南端。

english:
Hami, also known as Kumul, is an oasis at the eastern gateway to the lands beyond the Gansu corridor. Water from the Tian Shan sustains orchards and fields amid the surrounding desert, and its sweet melons have long been celebrated. Known as Yiwu under the Han and Yizhou under the Tang, the oasis was a valuable station for armies and caravans travelling between China and Central Asia.

In the late fourteenth century the Chagatayid prince Gunashiri established the small kingdom of Qara Del here. Its rulers accepted Ming overlordship in 1404, but Hami was contested by the Ming, the Oirats and the rulers of Turpan. In 1513 Mansur Khan conquered the oasis, bringing the kingdom to an end and Islam to the city. Its position made it a prize for rival powers on either side of the desert. During the wars between the Qing and the Dzungars, Hami's ruler submitted to the Qing and received a hereditary title in the 1690s. The oasis became the seat of a local dynasty under Qing authority. Its rulers governed an agricultural population whose crops and fruit continued to provision the road across the eastern frontier.
simp_chinese:
哈密又称库木尔，是河西走廊通往西域的东部门户。天山来水在四周沙漠中滋养田园果林，当地的甜瓜历来享有盛名。汉代称伊吾、唐代称伊州的绿洲，是往来中国与中亚的军队和商队的重要驻足之地。

十四世纪末，察合台后裔兀纳失里在此建立哈剌帖烈小国。其统治者于1404年接受明朝宗主权，此后明朝、瓦剌与吐鲁番统治者争夺哈密。1513年，满速儿汗征服绿洲，小国随之灭亡，伊斯兰教也进入这座城市。哈密所处的位置使它成为沙漠两侧强权争夺的要地。清朝与准噶尔战争期间，哈密统治者归附清廷，1690年代获得世袭封号。此后绿洲成为清朝之下地方王族的治所，农民种植的粮食与瓜果继续供应穿越东部边疆的道路。

english: The land around Hamidiyeh lies on the lower Karkheh, west of Ahvaz in the Khuzestan plain. The river descends from the Zagros and spreads across the lowlands towards the Hawizeh marshes. Its changing courses and branches have shaped the country between the mountains and the head of the Persian Gulf, where river water made cultivation possible in a hot, dry region.
simp_chinese: 哈米迪耶周边位于阿瓦士以西的胡齐斯坦平原，靠近卡尔赫河下游。河水从扎格罗斯山脉流下，穿过低地，注入豪维泽沼泽。不断变化的河道与支流塑造了山地和波斯湾北端之间的土地，也使炎热干旱地区得以依靠河水耕作。

english: The Hamilton Highlands rise in the lake-strewn interior of Labrador, near the upper reaches of the great river the Innu call Mishta-shipu. Rivers descend from this plateau towards the Atlantic, some through long stretches of rapids. To the north, the route along Meshikamau-shipu led Innu travellers between the interior and Lake Melville. Camps and portage trails along its course bear witness to journeys made over many generations through a land of lakes, forests and hunting grounds.
simp_chinese: 汉密尔顿高地耸立在湖泊密布的拉布拉多内陆，靠近因努人称作米什塔希普的大河上游。河流从高原奔向大西洋，有些河段急流绵延。高地以北，沿梅希卡毛希普的路线连接内陆与梅尔维尔湖，是因努人往来的通道。沿途营地和绕过急流的搬运小径，见证了一代代人穿行于湖泊、森林与猎场之间。

english:
Hamilton Inlet cuts deep into the coast of Labrador, joining Groswater Bay to the long waters of Lake Melville. The Churchill and Naskaupi rivers reach its inner end, carrying water from far inland. Inuit knew the inlet as Aivitok, the place of the walrus, and travelled along its shores in kayaks and larger skin boats. Innu routes from the interior also led towards Lake Melville.

In 1743 the Quebec merchant Louis Fornel sailed into the inlet, claimed the bay for France and left Jean Pilote and his son near the western end to establish trade. They remained among Innu families near what became North West River. Inuit middlemen also brought baleen from northern Labrador to Hamilton Inlet for exchange with French traders. The sheltered passage thus linked the inland fur trade with the hunting and commerce of the coast.
simp_chinese:
汉密尔顿湾深深切入拉布拉多海岸，将格罗斯沃特湾与狭长的梅尔维尔湖连接起来。丘吉尔河和纳斯考皮河从遥远内陆流向海湾深处。因纽特人称此湾为艾维托克，即“海象之地”，乘皮划艇和较大的皮船沿岸旅行；因努人从内陆而来的道路也通向梅尔维尔湖。

1743年，魁北克商人路易·福内尔驶入海湾，为法国宣称这片水域，并留下让·皮洛特与其子在西端附近开展贸易。他们与因努家庭留在一起，地点靠近后来的西北河。因纽特中间人也从拉布拉多北部将鲸须带到汉密尔顿湾，与法国商人交换。这条受遮蔽的水道因此连接了内陆毛皮贸易与沿海的狩猎、商业活动。

english:
Hamm was founded in 1226 by Count Adolf of Mark between the Lippe and the Ahse, where he settled people displaced from Nienbrügge. The rivers supplied water and fish to the new town, which became a centre of the County of Mark. Adolf granted market and minting rights, and the market square beside Saint George's Church formed the enduring heart of its public and commercial life.

Hamm joined the Hanseatic League in 1469. Its merchants exported linen and a local beer known as Hammscher Keut. The Treaty of Xanten in 1614 assigned Cleves and the counties of Mark and Ravensberg to the rulers of Brandenburg. Much later, in 1826, the Lippe was made navigable for commercial transport, offering another means of carrying goods through the region.
simp_chinese:
哈姆由马克伯爵阿道夫于1226年建立，位于利珀河与阿泽河之间，他将来自尼恩布吕格的流民安置于此。河流为新城提供水和鱼，哈姆也成为马克伯国的中心。阿道夫授予市场和铸币权，圣乔治教堂旁的市场广场成为公共与商业生活的核心。

哈姆于1469年加入汉萨同盟。商人出口亚麻布和称为「哈姆凯特」的当地啤酒。1614年的克桑滕条约将克莱沃以及马克、拉文斯贝格两伯国分配给勃兰登堡。很久以后，1826年利珀河被整治为可供商业运输的航道，为地区货物运输提供了另一条道路。

english: Hammamet lies on the Mediterranean shore of northeastern Tunisia, where its old town faces the Gulf of Hammamet. A coastal fortress began as a ribat, a place of religious retreat and watch against dangers from the sea. Under the Hafsids the town grew in importance, and its fortifications were strengthened in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries. The kasbah and walls still define the old settlement beside the water.
simp_chinese: 哈马马特位于突尼斯东北部地中海海岸，老城面向哈马马特湾。沿岸堡垒最初是一座里巴特，既供宗教人士静修，也用于警戒海上危险。哈夫斯王朝时期，城镇的重要性上升；十六至十七世纪，其防御工事得到加强。卡斯巴和城墙勾勒出临水老聚落的轮廓。

english: Hammerdal lies beside Hammerdalssjön in northern Jämtland. A church stood here in the Middle Ages, and a stone church was built on a promontory by the lake in 1590. Its parish served a wide countryside of forests, lakes and scattered farms. At the time Jämtland belonged to the Norwegian crown; the Treaty of Brömsebro transferred the province to Sweden in 1645, changing the frontier around this northern parish.
simp_chinese: 哈默达尔位于耶姆特兰北部的哈默达尔湖畔。中世纪这里已有教堂，1590年一座石教堂在伸入湖面的岬地建成。堂区服务于森林、湖泊和分散农庄组成的广阔乡村。当时耶姆特兰属于挪威王室；1645年的《布伦瑟布鲁条约》将该省交给瑞典，改变了这一北方堂区周围的边界。

english: Hammerfest stands on the northwestern shore of Kvaløya, with an ice-free harbour facing the Arctic seas. Long before it became a town, fishers and hunters used this coast. Its first church was built in 1684, when the settlement had around sixty inhabitants. Russian ships brought grain as part of the Pomor trade from 1764, and Christian VII granted market-town rights in 1789. During the Gunboat War two British brigs captured and plundered Hammerfest in 1809 before withdrawing.
simp_chinese: 哈默弗斯特位于克瓦尔岛西北岸，不冻港面向北极海域。早在城镇建立之前，渔民和猎人就利用这一海岸。1684年，聚落建起第一座教堂，当时约有六十名居民。1764年起，俄罗斯船只作为波莫尔贸易的一部分运来粮食；1789年，克里斯蒂安七世授予集镇权利。炮舰战争期间，两艘英国双桅军舰于1809年攻占并劫掠哈默弗斯特，随后撤离。

english:
Hammershus crowns a height at the northern tip of Bornholm, overlooking the Baltic. Built in the thirteenth century, it was among the largest medieval fortresses in Scandinavia, with a great tower and a long circuit of walls. In struggles between Denmark's kings and the archbishops, it served as a refuge for the latter and was repeatedly taken by royal forces.

Christian II captured Hammershus in 1521 and imprisoned the bishop of Funen there; Lübeck's forces took it later that year. Swedish troops seized the fortress in 1645 and occupied it again in 1658, but an island revolt ended Swedish rule and returned Bornholm to the Danish king. Corfitz Ulfeldt and Leonora Christina were held here in 1660–1661. Abandoned as a stronghold in 1743, Hammershus was partly demolished around 1750; its remains were protected in 1822.
simp_chinese:
哈默斯胡斯雄踞博恩霍尔姆岛北端的高地，俯瞰波罗的海。这座十三世纪的要塞是斯堪的纳维亚最大的中世纪堡垒之一，拥有高塔和绵长的围墙。在丹麦国王与大主教的争斗中，它曾为后者提供庇护，也屡次被王军夺取。

1521年，克里斯蒂安二世攻下哈默斯胡斯，将菲英主教囚禁于此；同年吕贝克军队又夺取了要塞。瑞典军队于1645年和1658年占领城堡，但岛上的起义结束了瑞典统治，将博恩霍尔姆归还丹麦国王。1660至1661年，科菲茨·乌尔费尔特和莱奥诺拉·克里斯蒂娜被囚于此。1743年城堡不再作为要塞使用，约1750年被部分拆除；1822年遗址获得保护。

english: The waters of the Gulf of Oman lie between the coasts of Arabia and Makran, opening eastward onto the Arabian Sea. At their western end, the Strait of Hormuz leads into the Persian Gulf. Ships sailing between the Gulf and the Indian Ocean pass through this broad approach, where the seasonal winds of the Arabian Sea affect the timing of voyages.
simp_chinese: 阿曼湾位于阿拉伯与马克兰海岸之间，向东通往阿拉伯海；西端的霍尔木兹海峡则通入波斯湾。往返波斯湾和印度洋的船只经过这片广阔水域，阿拉伯海的季风会影响航行时节。

english: Hamrånge lies on the coast of northern Gästrikland, where farms and fishing places adjoin extensive forest. In 1671 the Axmar ironworks received its privileges beside a stream with access to woodland for charcoal and a harbour for transport. The works drew skilled smiths, including people of Walloon origin. In 1721 Russian troops landed in the parish and burned much of the district during the final phase of the Great Northern War; the church was plundered but spared the flames.
simp_chinese: 哈姆龙厄位于耶斯特里克兰北部海岸，农场和渔村与大片森林相接。1671年，阿克斯马尔铁厂在一条溪流旁获得特许，当地森林可供烧制木炭，港口则便利运输。铁厂吸引了包括瓦隆裔工匠在内的熟练铁匠。1721年大北方战争末期，俄军在教区登陆并焚毁大片地区；教堂遭到劫掠，却免于火灾。

english: Hamtai is a Papuan language of the mountainous country north of the Gulf of Papua. Its speakers belong to a region of steep valleys and tropical forest within the New Guinea highlands. Hamtai is one of several distinct languages spoken by communities across the mountains and their southern approaches.
simp_chinese: 汉泰语是巴布亚湾以北山区的一种巴布亚语言。其使用者属于新几内亚高地中陡峭山谷与热带森林交错的地区。汉泰语是山脉及其南部入口地区社群使用的多种不同语言之一。

english: The Dasht-e Kavir, or Great Salt Desert, spreads across the central Iranian plateau. In its winding low valleys, shallow lakes, mudflats and salt marshes share the basin floor. Water collects in these depressions and evaporates, leaving salt behind. Dry ground and dunes extend between the low areas of the Kavir.
simp_chinese: 卡维尔大盐漠横贯伊朗中部高原。蜿蜒低谷的盆地底部分布着浅湖、泥滩和盐沼，流入洼地的水逐渐蒸发，在地表留下盐分。卡维尔的低洼地之间则延伸着干地和沙丘。

english: The basin of the Dasht-e Lut contains salt pans amid one of Iran's most arid deserts. Mountains surround the depression, casting it into a rain shadow. When streams enter from the margins, their waters evaporate and leave mineral crusts in the dry beds and salt flats. Wind has also shaped long ridges and great dunes across the wider desert, giving the Lut a striking variety of landforms.
simp_chinese: 卢特沙漠盆地中的盐滩位于伊朗最干旱的沙漠地带之一。群山环抱洼地，使这里处于雨影之中。边缘溪流注入后，水分蒸发，在干涸河床和盐地留下矿物结壳。风也在广阔沙漠中塑造出长脊和巨大沙丘，使卢特拥有多样而醒目的地貌。

english: Gowd-e Zereh lies at the lowest end of the Sistan basin, amid the deserts south of the Helmand wetlands. In exceptionally wet years, overflow from the Hamun lakes reaches this shallow depression, where water collects without an outlet to the sea. Its brackish waters and surrounding salt flats change greatly with the supply from the rivers, leaving broad dry expanses when floods subside.
simp_chinese: 高德泽拉位于锡斯坦盆地最低处，在赫尔曼德湿地以南的沙漠之中。洪水特别丰沛的年份，哈蒙诸湖的溢流抵达这片浅洼，水在此汇集而无法流入海洋。微咸的湖水和周围盐碱地随河流水量大幅变化，洪水退去时留下一片广阔的干地。

english: Hamun-e Jaz Murian occupies a closed basin in southeastern Iran, between the highlands of Kerman and Baluchistan. The Halil Rud enters from the west and the Bampur from the east. After rain in the surrounding mountains, their waters can spread across the shallow depression; in drier periods the basin contracts into marsh and exposed ground. Its changing shores lie between the irrigated river valleys and the arid country beyond.
simp_chinese: 贾兹穆里安沼泽位于伊朗东南部的封闭盆地，介于克尔曼与俾路支斯坦高地之间。哈利勒河从西方注入，班布尔河从东方流来。周围山区降雨后，河水可漫入浅洼；干旱时，水域收缩，露出沼泽和地面。变化的湖岸处于灌溉河谷与周围旱地之间。

english: Hamun-e Lora is a shallow, salty lake basin in the dry interior of Baluchistan. It receives the Pishin Lora, which rises in the Toba Kakar range, crosses the Pishin valley and bends through the country beyond before passing Nushki. The river carries much silt, filling channels and creating new courses when floods spread across the plain. The hamun has no outlet to the sea, and its waters gather at the end of this long journey through mountains and desert.
simp_chinese: 洛拉哈蒙是俾路支斯坦干旱内陆的一处浅盐湖盆地。皮欣洛拉河发源于托巴卡卡尔山脉，穿过皮欣谷地，在邻近地区绕行后经过努什基，最后流入这里。河水携带大量泥沙，填塞河道；洪水漫过平原时，又会开辟新的水路。这座哈蒙没有通往海洋的出口，河水在穿越山地和荒漠后汇集于此。

sources.title: Pakistan Geographical Review 1952 Vol. VII No. 1.pdf

english: Hamun-e Mashkel is a shallow inland depression in the desert of western Baluchistan. The Mashkel River reaches it after crossing the Siahan range and running along the western side of the Kharan basin. Most of the year the lake bed holds little water, but heavy rain can spread temporary water across its flat floor. Sand dunes and barren plains surround the basin, which has no outlet to the sea and is separated from the larger deserts of Sistan by the Chagai hills.
simp_chinese: 马什凯勒哈蒙是俾路支斯坦西部荒漠中的浅洼内陆盆地。马什凯勒河穿越西亚汉山脉，沿哈兰盆地西侧流向这里。湖床在一年大部分时间里积水甚少，大雨之后水才会暂时漫过平坦的洼地。沙丘和荒原环绕盆地；它没有通往海洋的出口，恰盖山则将其与锡斯坦更广阔的荒漠分隔开来。

sources.title: Pakistan Geographical Review 1952 Vol. VII No. 1.pdf

english: Hamun-e Puzak is one of the shallow lakes and marshes of the Sistan basin. The Khash River brings spring meltwater from the Afghan highlands, while channels of the Helmand also feed the wetlands. Reed beds fringe the open water, providing shelter for fish and birds. The lake expands and contracts with the rivers, a fertile wetland amid the surrounding desert when water is abundant.
simp_chinese: 普扎克湖是锡斯坦盆地的浅湖与沼泽之一。哈什河从阿富汗高地带来春季融雪，赫尔曼德河的支流也为湿地供水。芦苇丛环绕开阔水面，为鱼类和鸟类提供栖息地。湖面随着河流水量涨缩；水源丰沛时，它是周围沙漠中的肥沃湿地。

english: Hamun-e Saberi forms part of the changing network of lakes and marshes in the closed Sistan basin. Rivers from the Afghan highlands bring water into the shallow depression, and the extent of open water varies with the season and the strength of the floods. Reeds and wetlands support fish and provide a resting place for birds travelling between northern Asia and the Indian Ocean.
simp_chinese: 萨比里湖是锡斯坦封闭盆地中时常变化的湖泊与沼泽网络的一部分。来自阿富汗高地的河流将水带入这片浅洼，开阔水面的范围随季节和洪水强弱而变化。芦苇和湿地为鱼类提供栖息地，也为往来北亚与印度洋的候鸟提供歇脚之处。

english: The Han were an Indigenous people encountered near Galveston Bay on the Texas coast. Their name is known from the account of Álvar Núñez Cabeza de Vaca, who reached this coast after the wreck of a Spanish expedition in 1528. They may have been ancestors of the later Akokisa: in both Akokisa and related Atakapa, a similar word means “house.” Their precise relationship to later coastal communities remains a matter of interpretation.
simp_chinese: 汉恩人是加尔维斯顿湾附近得克萨斯海岸的原住民。其名称见于阿尔瓦尔·努涅斯·卡韦萨·德·瓦卡的记述；1528年，他在西班牙远征队遭遇海难后抵达这一海岸。他们可能是后来阿科基萨人的祖先：在阿科基萨语及相关的阿塔卡帕语中，相似的词意为“房屋”。他们与后来沿海社区的确切关系仍有不同解释。

english: Hanábana was a rural district of southern Matanzas, on the low country that runs toward the Zapata swamps. Spanish settlers were active there before 1550, and in the later sixteenth century the Havana cabildo granted land for cattle raising in Hanábana and neighbouring districts. The district appears among the places receiving new settlers in 1566. By the late eighteenth century a small hamlet had formed around the local parish, with a cemetery and a cluster of inhabitants. The general register of 1778 counted two sugar mills in Hanábana, out of ten in the Matanzas jurisdiction. The landscape was uneven: livestock estates, scattered homesteads and early sugar production existed side by side.
simp_chinese: 哈纳巴纳是马坦萨斯南部的乡村地区，位于通向萨帕塔沼泽的低地。1550年以前，西班牙人已在此活动；十六世纪后半叶，哈瓦那市议会在哈纳巴纳及邻近地区批准土地用于养牛。1566年，该地区出现在接受新定居者的地点之列。十八世纪末，当地教堂周围形成小村落，有墓地和一批聚居人口。1778年的总登记在马坦萨斯辖区的十座糖厂中，列出哈纳巴纳有两座。这里的景观并不均匀：牧牛庄园、分散的农舍与初起的制糖业并存。

english: Hanagal lies in the dry plateau country east of Chitradurga, near the routes between Challakere and the Bellary plain. The region was part of a landscape of fortified settlements and local chiefs under Vijayanagara and its successors. Chitradurga’s Nayakas built their power around the great granite stronghold to the west; their state lasted until Haidar Ali of Mysore captured the fort in 1779.
simp_chinese: 哈纳加尔位于吉德勒杜尔加以东的干燥高原，靠近查拉凯雷与贝拉里平原之间的道路。这一地区分布着设防聚落和地方首领，先后处于毗奢耶那伽罗及其继承势力的世界中。吉德勒杜尔加的那耶迦以西方的巨大花岗岩要塞为中心建立权力，其国家持续至1779年迈索尔的海德尔·阿里攻下堡垒。

english: Hanasaki lies on the Pacific side of the Nemuro Peninsula. Its Japanese name refers to a projecting cape, while an Ainu name for the place was Poronot, or great cape. At the shore, volcanic basalt has cooled into striking radial formations known as wheel stones: their joints spread outward like the spokes of a great wheel. The largest of these formations measures several meters across, exposed where the sea has cut into the rock.
simp_chinese: 花咲位于根室半岛的太平洋一侧。日语地名指突出的海岬，阿伊努语名称“波罗诺特”则意为大岬。海岸上的火山玄武岩冷却后形成奇特的放射状构造，被称作车石：岩石裂纹如巨轮的辐条向外伸展。海浪切开的岩壁上显露出的最大车石，直径达数米。

english:
Hanau grew around a castle protected by the waters of the Kinzig, not far from its meeting with the Main. The lords of Hanau took their name from the place, which became a town in 1303. As the settlement expanded beyond its first walls, new Renaissance fortifications were built in the sixteenth century to enclose the castle, the old town and its suburb.

In 1597 Count Philipp Ludwig II invited Protestant refugees to settle south of Hanau. French, Walloon and Dutch newcomers established a new town with its own church and administration, and their crafts helped make Hanau a centre of goldsmithing. During the Thirty Years' War imperial forces besieged the town in 1636 until Landgrave William V of Hesse-Kassel relieved it. The last count of Hanau died in 1736, and Hanau passed to Hesse-Kassel. Napoleon later ordered its fortifications demolished. In 1813 French troops defeated an Austro-Bavarian army near Hanau during their retreat from Germany. The administrations of the old and new towns were united in the 1820s, more than two centuries after the refugees founded their separate settlement.
simp_chinese:
哈瑙兴起于一座受金齐格河水保护的城堡周围，距离该河汇入美因河之处不远。哈瑙领主以此地为名，聚落于1303年成为城市。随着居民区越过最初的城墙，十六世纪建起了新的文艺复兴式城防，将城堡、旧城与郊区一并圈入。

1597年，伯爵腓力·路德维希二世邀请新教难民在哈瑙以南定居。法国、瓦隆和荷兰移民建立了拥有自己教会和行政机构的新城，他们的手艺也促进哈瑙成为金匠业中心。三十年战争期间，帝国军于1636年围攻此城，直至黑森—卡塞尔领地伯威廉五世前来解围。1736年，最后一位哈瑙伯爵去世，城市归于黑森—卡塞尔。拿破仑后来下令拆除哈瑙的城防。1813年，法军从德意志撤退途中在附近击败奥地利和巴伐利亚联军。十九世纪二十年代，新旧城的行政机构终于合并，距难民建立独立聚落已有两个多世纪。

english: Hanawa lies in the Kazuno basin of northern Mutsu, near the boundary between the lands of Morioka and Kubota. During the Tokugawa period it was an administrative centre of the Morioka domain, with officials stationed at Hanawa Castle. Streets and houses grew around the stronghold and along the Kazuno road, making the town a centre of trade and local culture amid the surrounding mountain country.
simp_chinese: 花轮位于陆奥北部鹿角盆地，靠近盛冈与久保田两藩的边界。德川时代，这里是盛冈藩的地方行政中心，藩役驻守花轮馆。街道与民居沿城馆和鹿角街道发展，使花轮成为周围山地中的商业与文化中心。

english:
Hancheng stands on the west bank of the Yellow River at the Dragon Gate, where the river squeezes between cliffs, and the carp that leap them are said to become dragons. The Western Zhou made it the fief of the Marquis of Han; the Qin put a county here at Xiàyáng in 327 BC, and the Sui gave it the name Hánchéng. It is remembered as the home of the Han historian Sima Qian, whose Records of the Grand Historian gave later generations an account of China's early past. A shrine and tomb on a bluff to the south honoured him, while temples and stone inscriptions marked the long history of the district.

Scholars continued to visit and repair the shrine; an inscription recorded its restoration in 1536. The town possessed a Confucian temple, while villages to the north developed distinctive courtyard houses. Dǎngjiā village, said to have been founded in 1331, grew under the Dang and Jia families, who prospered through farming and commerce, including trade at Nányáng in Henan during the early Qing. Their brick and timber residences reflected the wealth and values of local families, with maxims carved above doors and on walls.
simp_chinese:
韩城位于黄河西岸的龙门，河水在此挤过峭壁，传说鲤鱼跃过龙门便化为龙。西周时这里是韩侯封邑，秦国在前327年设夏阳县，隋代定名韩城。它是汉代史家司马迁的故乡，他所著的《史记》为后世留下了中国早期历史的记载。城南高地有纪念他的祠墓，寺庙与碑刻也记录着这片地区悠久的往事。

后世士人不断祭拜和修缮司马迁祠，1536年的碑记记述了一次重修。城内有文庙，北面的村落则发展出别具特色的四合院民居。党家村传说始建于1331年，党、贾两族兼营农商，清初还有人到河南南阳经商致富；砖木宅院展示了地方家族的财富和价值观，门额墙壁上刻有训诫子孙的文字。

english: Hànchuān lies among rivers and lakes on the Jianghan Plain. Its old county seat at Jīngǔchéng suffered from war and flooding before the administration moved to ground bounded by the Hàn River and other waterways. In 1569 the magistrate Zhāng Chóngdé had the Téngchí channel repaired, seeking to control water in this low-lying district.
simp_chinese: 汉川位于江汉平原的河湖之间。旧县治金鼓城屡遭战火与洪水破坏，后来迁至汉江等水道环绕之地。明隆庆三年（1569年），知县张崇德修整腾池河，以治理低地水患。

english: Handan was once the capital of the state of Zhao, whose rulers left the celebrated Congtai terrace above the city. By the Ming it was a county town on the northern plain, with river landings linking its markets to the Fuyang River. Its ancient name remained alive in stories as well as ruins: at a shrine north of the town, the tale of a scholar’s dream of wealth and office became a lesson on the fleeting nature of worldly ambition. In the sixteenth century officials enlarged the walls and dug a moat. In 1534 they joined Congtai to the fortifications and built a pavilion upon it, giving an ancient landmark a new place in the defences of the Ming town.
simp_chinese: 邯郸曾是赵国都城，城中的丛台令人追忆赵王的时代。明代它是华北平原上的县城，滏阳河沿岸码头连接地方市场。古城的名字也留在故事中：城北吕翁祠所纪念的黄粱梦，讲述书生梦中富贵荣华，醒来却发现不过片刻，成为人生无常的寓言。十六世纪，地方官扩建城墙、开挖护城河。1534年，丛台与城墙相连，台上又建据胜亭，使古迹成为明代城防的一部分。

english: Handbörd was one of the small districts that gave Småland its name. Its old heart and meeting place lay at Högsby, on the Emån in the eastern part of the province. The early district extended from the wooded interior toward the Baltic coast, while the later hundred preserved its name in local administration. Its farms and parishes belonged to a landscape traversed by the Emån as it descends from the uplands to the sea.
simp_chinese: 汉德伯德是组成斯莫兰的古老小地区之一。它的中心和议会地点位于该省东部埃姆河畔的赫格斯比。早期地区从森林覆盖的内陆延伸至波罗的海岸，后来的百户区在地方行政中保留了这一名称。埃姆河从高地流向大海，穿过这里农庄和堂区所在的土地。

english: Handia, often called Hindia in Mughal records, stands on the southern bank of the Narmada opposite Nemawar. It was a prosperous town and the seat of a Mughal sarkar comprising twenty-three mahals, including Harda. The Chahar Gulshan, written in 1759, lists routes from Golconda through Asir to Handia and from Handia to Sironj among the empire's important roads. In 1742 the Marathas under Peshwa Balaji Baji Rao took the region and displaced its Mughal governor. Harda then overtook Handia as the local Maratha officer's residence. The Scindias retained the Handia country after the Third Anglo-Maratha War, although the East India Company briefly occupied its fort during the fighting.
simp_chinese: 汉地亚在莫卧儿文献中常称欣迪亚，坐落于纳尔默达河南岸，与内马瓦尔隔河相望。这里曾是繁荣的城镇，也是一个莫卧儿萨尔卡尔的驻地，辖二十三个马哈尔，其中包括哈达。1759年成书的《四花园》将戈尔康达经阿西尔至汉地亚，以及汉地亚至锡龙杰的道路，列入帝国的重要道路。1742年，佩什瓦巴拉吉·巴吉·拉奥率马拉塔人夺取此地，取代莫卧儿总督。此后当地马拉塔官员驻在哈达，使其地位超过汉地亚。第三次英马战争中，东印度公司曾短暂占领汉地亚堡，但战后辛迪亚家族仍保有这一地区。

english:
Hangu lay on the road westward from Kohat into the Bangash country. Babur followed this route during his expedition of 1505. His memoir describes the road between Kohat and Hangu as a valley enclosed by mountains, with local Afghans gathering on the slopes. At Hangu itself, defenders occupied a fortified hill position, or sangur. Babur's troops stormed it before continuing toward Thal and Bannu. The account records an armed encounter on an established route through inhabited country.

Later rulers worked through local chiefs as well as military expeditions. Grants remembered in the history of Hangu's khans included a sanad from Shah Jahan in 1632, assigning the revenues of Kachai and Marai, and another from Aurangzeb in 1700 covering Upper and Lower Miranzai. Such grants connected a local chiefly family to Mughal fiscal authority. Their effective reach varied with rivalry and political circumstances. Roads, hill defences and revenue rights consequently formed distinct parts of Hangu's relationship with powers based beyond its valley.
simp_chinese:
汉古位于从科哈特向西进入班加什地区的道路上。巴布尔在1505年远征中经过这里。他的回忆录将科哈特至汉古的道路描述为两侧山地夹峙的河谷，当地阿富汗人在坡上集结。汉古守军据守称作sangur的山上工事，巴布尔军攻入后继续前往塔尔与班努。这段记载呈现了既有道路上发生的武装冲突。

后来的统治者也通过地方首领行使权力。汉古汗家族的授命文书，包括沙贾汗1632年授予卡查伊与马赖赋税权的诏令，以及奥朗则布1700年涉及上、下米兰扎伊的授命。这些文书将地方首领家族连接到莫卧儿财政体系，但实际权力范围随竞争与政局改变。道路、山地防御和征税权，由此分别构成汉古与谷外政权发生关系的具体方式。

english: Hangu lies in the upper Bistrița valley beneath the mountains of the Eastern Carpathians. Its name was long applied to a wider stretch of the valley and to a monastery in these wooded uplands. In 1458 Stephen the Great confirmed the monastery of Neamț's possession of the house at Hangu. Prince Miron Barnovschi rebuilt its church in 1627; in 1715 Prince Nicolae Mavrocordat placed the monastery under the Patriarchate of Alexandria.
simp_chinese: 汉古位于比斯特里察河上游河谷，坐落在东喀尔巴阡山群峰之下。这个名称长期用于河谷中一片较广的地区，也用于山林中的一座修道院。1458年，斯特凡大公确认尼亚姆茨修道院对汉古修道院的所有权。1627年，米龙·巴尔诺夫斯基公爵重建了这里的教堂；1715年，尼古拉·马夫罗科尔达托斯公爵将修道院奉献给亚历山大宗主教区。

english: Hanguang stands on the Lian River in the hills west of Yingde. Known in antiquity as Hanguang County, it was an administrative center for the surrounding country until the Yuan abolished the county in 1314 and incorporated it into Yingde. The old town remained a place of commerce: by the transition from Ming to Qing, merchants from Guangdong and provinces farther north came to trade here, making it a center for the markets of western Yingde.
simp_chinese: 浛洸坐落在英德以西的丘陵之间，连江从镇旁流过。这里古称含洭县，长期是周边地区的行政中心；1314年，元朝撤销浛洸县，将其并入英德州。旧城此后仍是商贸聚集之地。明末清初，广东及北方各省的商人往来于此，使浛洸成为英德西部众多市集的中心。

english: Hangzhou Bay is a shallow, funnel-shaped inlet of the East China Sea. The Qiantang River enters its western end at Hangzhou, where fresh water meets the incoming sea. At the bay’s eastern and southeastern edge lie the many islands of the Zhoushan archipelago, off the coast of Ningbo. The narrowing bay and its river mouth form a distinctive meeting of inland and coastal waters.
simp_chinese: 杭州湾是东海一处浅而呈漏斗形的海湾。钱塘江在杭州注入海湾西端，江水在此与海水相遇。海湾东部和东南部，宁波外海散布着舟山群岛的众多岛屿。逐渐收窄的海湾和河口构成了内陆水域与海洋交汇的独特地带。

english: Haniguayagua is associated with Aniguayagua, another name for Xaragua, the Taíno chiefdom of southwestern Hispaniola. Its territories included the Yaguana plain, the southern peninsula and islands in the gulf to the north. Bohechío and his sister Anacaona were among the leaders remembered in early accounts. Spanish conquest at the beginning of the sixteenth century shattered the chiefdom and its network of communities.
simp_chinese: 哈尼瓜亚瓜与阿尼瓜亚瓜有关，后者是伊斯帕尼奥拉岛西南部泰诺哈拉瓜酋邦的另一名称。其地域包括亚瓜纳平原、南部半岛以及北方海湾中的岛屿。早期记载中的首领包括博埃奇奥及其妹妹阿纳卡奥纳。十六世纪初西班牙征服摧毁了这一酋邦及其社群网络。

english: Hanimmei lies east of Ben Guerir on the Gantour plateau, north of the Jbilet hills. Layers of limestone, marl and phosphate form part of this elongated basin, which stretches west towards the Youssoufia country. To the east, the Tassaout runs towards the Oum Er-Rbia, carrying water down from the High Atlas.
simp_chinese: 哈尼梅位于本盖里尔以东的甘图尔高原，在杰比莱特丘陵以北。这座狭长盆地向西延伸至优素菲耶一带，部分地层由石灰岩、泥灰岩和磷酸盐构成。东面的塔萨乌特河将高阿特拉斯山的水流带向乌姆赖比阿河。

english:
Hanle lies in a remote high valley of eastern Ladakh, on an old branch of the route between Ladakh and Tibet. Its fortified monastery belongs to the Drukpa Kagyu tradition. The Tibetan lama Taktsang Repa Ngawang Gyatso founded it in the seventeenth century with the patronage of the Ladakhi king Sengge Namgyal, making it one of the king's principal religious foundations.

Hanle also served Sengge as a place of residence and a stronghold. After Ladakh intervened in the affairs of neighbouring Guge around 1630, the displaced ruler of Guge was brought to Hanle. Sengge Namgyal died here in 1642 on his return from a campaign against Mongol forces. His association with the monastery joined the religious authority of the Drukpa lineage to the power of the Namgyal kings on Ladakh's eastern frontier.
simp_chinese:
甘里位于拉达克东部偏远的高谷，处在拉达克与西藏之间一条古道的支线上。这里的设防寺院属于竹巴噶举派，十七世纪由西藏上师达仓热巴·阿旺嘉措在拉达克国王森格南杰赞助下建立，是国王的重要宗教建筑之一。

甘里也曾是森格南杰的驻地和据点。约1630年拉达克介入邻国古格事务后，被废黜的古格国王被带到这里。1642年，森格南杰在对抗蒙古军队的行动归途中死于甘里。寺院将竹巴传承的宗教权威与南杰诸王在拉达克东部边地的权力联系在一起。

english: The waters off the northeastern coast of Cape York Peninsula contain reefs and low islands along the outer edge of the Great Barrier Reef. The Hannibal Islands lie in this tropical seascape. Aboriginal communities of the peninsula have long maintained connections to the coast and sea, while reefs complicate passage between the open Coral Sea and the mainland.
simp_chinese: 约克角半岛东北海岸外的水域分布着礁石和低矮岛屿，位于大堡礁外缘。汉尼拔群岛坐落在这片热带海域中。半岛原住民社群长期与海岸和海洋保持联系，礁石则使珊瑚海与大陆之间的航行更为复杂。

english: Hanol stands beside the Tons River in the mountain country of Jaunsar. Its temple is dedicated to Mahasu Devta, a local form of Shiva and a revered deity of the surrounding region. Built of stone and wood, the shrine preserves a curved tower in the Nagara style above its old sanctum. The main sanctuary dates to the ninth or tenth century, while the entrance and assembly hall were added later.
simp_chinese: 哈诺尔坐落在焦恩萨尔山区的通斯河畔。当地神庙供奉马哈苏神，他是湿婆的一种地方化身，在周围地区深受敬仰。神庙以石木建成，古老的内殿上方保留着纳伽罗式曲线塔顶。主体圣殿可追溯至九至十世纪，入口和集会厅则是后来增建的。

english: Hansan, near the Geum River in Chungcheong, was the home district of the late Goryeo scholar Yi Saek. Under Joseon it became renowned for fine ramie cloth, or mosi. Preparing it meant harvesting the plant, processing its fibres, joining the thread and weaving it on a loom. Families shared the work, while neighbours gathered to prepare the yarn together.
simp_chinese: 忠清道锦江附近的韩山是高丽末年学者李穑的故乡。朝鲜王朝时期，这里以细苎麻布闻名。织布需收割苎麻、处理纤维、绩线并上机织造；家庭成员分担工作，邻里也会聚在一起制线。

english: Hanshan lies between the Yangtze and the Huai River, east of Lake Chao. Named for a mountain within its territory, the county was first established in the Tang. During the wars at the end of the Yuan, it was abolished in 1367 and its territory divided between neighbouring jurisdictions. The Ming restored Hanshan County in 1380 under Hezhou. Its towns and villages occupied the country between the lake and the Yangtze, among hills and waterways.
simp_chinese: 含山位于长江与淮河之间、巢湖以东。县名取自境内的含山，唐代首次设县。元末战乱中，含山县于1367年被撤销，南部土地分入无为州，其余并入和州。明朝于1380年恢复含山县，隶属和州。此后城镇与村落仍分布在湖泊与长江之间，周围丘陵和水道交错。

english:
Hansi is an old fortified town west of Delhi, dominated by the walls of Asigarh. Traditions associate the fort with the Tomara rulers and with the making of swords. Its importance as a stronghold is reflected in the fighting that followed the defeat of Prithviraj Chauhan in 1192, when Jatwan besieged the commander Nasrat al-Din at Hansi. A relief force under Qutb al-Din marched to the town and defeated him.

Under Akbar, Hansi was a district of Hisar with a brick fort and a substantial assessed force of cavalry and infantry. In the late eighteenth century, as Mughal power waned, the Irish adventurer George Thomas made Hansi the center of his short-lived territory and repaired its fortifications. Maratha forces defeated him in 1801, and British power followed the Second Anglo-Maratha War. In 1803 James Skinner raised a cavalry regiment at Hansi, giving the town a new place in the military history of northern India.
simp_chinese:
汉西是德里以西的一座古老设防城镇，阿西加尔城堡的城墙俯临市区。传说将堡垒与托马拉统治者及制剑工艺联系起来。它作为要塞的重要性，在1192年普里特维拉杰·乔汉战败后的争斗中显露出来：贾特万围攻驻守汉西的纳斯拉特丁，古特卜丁率援军赶到并击败了他。

阿克巴统治时期，汉西是希萨尔辖下的一个地区，拥有砖砌堡垒，并承担可观的骑兵和步兵兵额。十八世纪末，莫卧儿势力衰落，爱尔兰冒险者乔治·托马斯以汉西为其短暂领地的中心，修缮城防。1801年，马拉塔军击败了他；第二次英马战争后，英国势力随之进入。1803年，詹姆斯·斯金纳在汉西组建骑兵团，使这座城镇在印度北部的军事史上获得新的地位。

english: The Hantam lies on the high western edge of the Karoo, where mountains and plateaus look out over dry plains. San hunters and Khoekhoe herders lived in this country before colonial farmers pushed north from the Cape. After about 1740, trekboers extended their livestock farms into the Hantam and neighbouring Roggeveld. Some Khoesan communities were driven away from springs, and mounting competition over water and pasture fed a cycle of resistance and violent reprisals.
simp_chinese: 汉坦位于卡鲁西缘的高地，山脉和高原俯瞰干燥的平原。殖民农民从开普向北推进之前，桑人猎手与科伊科伊牧人已生活在这里。约1740年后，迁徙牧场主将畜牧农场扩展到汉坦及邻近的罗赫费尔德。一些科伊桑社群被赶离泉水，水源和牧地的争夺日益激烈，助长了抵抗与暴力报复的循环。

english: Hànyáng stands where the Hàn River approaches the Yangtze. On the eastern slope of Guī Mountain, the Qíngchuān Pavilion overlooks the water opposite the Yellow Crane Tower. Built during the Jiājìng reign of the Míng, it took its name from a line in Cuī Hào’s Táng poem describing the trees of Hànyáng across the clear river.
simp_chinese: 汉阳位于汉江接近长江之处。龟山东麓的晴川阁临江而立，与黄鹤楼隔江相望。此阁建于明嘉靖年间，名字取自唐代崔颢诗中描写晴川和汉阳树木的诗句。

english:
Hanyin's county town acquired its defensive walls in 1465, the first year of the Ming Chenghua reign. Built to follow the local terrain, the circuit had four gates, a watchtower and three defensive towers. Blue bricks faced the outside, while pebbles and a mixture of earth, lime and sand formed much of the inner structure.

The walls served against water as well as armed attack, combining defense with protection from flooding. Repairs continued through the Ming and Qing periods. In 1767 the magistrate Huang Daojia repaired the brick fortifications, whose foundations remain an important part of the surviving wall. The town's early modern construction history is therefore preserved in successive layers of earth, stone and brick, adapted both to military danger and to the conditions of a southern Shaanxi valley settlement.
simp_chinese:
汉阴县城于1465年，即明成化元年修筑城墙。墙体依地形营建，设四座城门、一座谯楼和三座敌楼。外侧以青砖包砌，内侧多用卵石及黄泥、石灰、砂的混合材料构筑。

城墙兼顾抵御攻击与防洪排涝，明清两代持续修缮。1767年，知县黄道嘉整修砖城，今天留存的城墙仍保留了这次工程的基础。土、石、砖构成的接续营建层次，使县城近世的工程历史得以保存，也反映了陕南河谷聚落同时应对军事危险与水患的需要。

english:
Fulin lies in the Dadu River country of Hanyuan, south of the old county seat at Qingxi. The Qing gazetteer distinguished Fulin Township from Hanyuan Township and described Fulin Camp as a meeting place on the southern road. Chinese merchants and traders from neighbouring upland peoples gathered there. Fields, tiled houses and paths occupied the valley landscape approaching the settlement, while the surrounding mountains confined travel to a limited number of routes.

The wider district combined military establishments with civil government. During the Ming, the Dadu River guard and the Lizhou administration supervised parts of this frontier; their institutions changed repeatedly through war and reorganisation. In 1681 the Qing combined the Lizhou and Dadu River guard establishments. Civil county administration followed in the Yongzheng period, with its seat at Qingxi. Fulin remained a separate southern market and settlement within that jurisdiction. Its commercial role arose from the convergence of travellers and merchants on the road, rather than from being the county capital.
simp_chinese:
富林位于汉源大渡河地区，在旧县治清溪以南。清代县志将富林乡与汉源乡分别记载，并称富林营处于南行道路要冲，汉地商人与邻近山地商贾在此会集。通向聚落的河谷分布田地、瓦屋与阡陌，周围群山则限制可供通行的路线。

较大地域兼有军事机构和民政体系。明代，大渡河守御千户所与黎州地方机构分管边地，战争与整顿又使建置多次改变。1681年，清廷合并黎州、大渡河两所；雍正年间改设民县，县治位于清溪。富林仍是其辖境南部另一个集市与居民点。道路将行旅和商人汇聚于此，构成它的商业地位；同时，地方社会也处在不断调整的边地行政网络之中。

english: Hanzawa was a district of Musashi on the northern plain of the Kantō. Its ancient district office stood in the area later known as Okabe, and local warrior families took the name of Hanzawa from their lands. Tradition remembers Hanzawa Rokurō Narikiyo, whose remains were said to have been brought back to the family residence at Ushiro-Hanzawa. The district’s villages occupied a landscape of river terraces and cultivated land south of the Tone.
simp_chinese: 榛泽是武藏国北部关东平原上的一郡，古代郡衙位于后来称为冈部的地区。地方武士家族因领地而得榛泽之名。相传榛泽六郎成清的遗骨被带回后榛泽的家族宅邸。郡内村落分布在利根川以南的河流阶地与耕地之间。

english: Haomen lies in a high valley of the eastern Qilian Mountains, on the river of the same name. The Haomen is a reach of the Datong River, which flows eastward toward the Huang and ultimately the Yellow River. Marshes lie in its higher reaches, while the valley around Haomen provides land for cultivation and grazing. Mountain ridges rise on either side, separating this basin from other valleys and from the dry Hexi Corridor farther north.
simp_chinese: 浩门位于祁连山东段的高谷中，浩门河从这里流过。浩门河是大通河的一段，河水向东流入湟水，最终汇归黄河。上游有广阔湿地，浩门附近的谷地则可耕作和放牧。两侧山岭把这片谷地与其他河谷及更北面的干旱河西走廊分隔开来。

english: Haorangi, also known as Hao, is a large, elongated atoll in the central Tuamotus. Its low coral rim surrounds an immense lagoon, separated from the open sea by a reef and connected to it by a pass. The island was known to European navigators as Bow Island, a name recalling its curved shape.
simp_chinese: 豪朗吉又称豪，是土阿莫土中部一座大型狭长环礁。低矮的珊瑚礁缘围绕着广阔潟湖，将其与外海隔开；水道则连接两者。欧洲航海者曾称此地为弓岛，这个名字使人联想到环礁弯曲的形状。

english: Haorangi lies among the low coral islands of the eastern Tuamotus, near the long atoll of Hao. Its reef and lagoon belong to a chain of scattered landfalls known to Polynesian navigators. James Cook visited Hao in 1769 and called it Bow Island.
simp_chinese: 豪朗伊位于土阿莫土东部低矮珊瑚岛之间，靠近狭长的豪环礁。其礁体和潟湖属于波利尼西亚航海者熟悉的一串零散陆地。詹姆斯·库克于1769年到访豪，将其称为弓岛。

english:
In Hapcheon's wooded mountains stands Haeinsa, a Buddhist monastery founded in the early ninth century. In 1398 it became the home of the Tripitaka Koreana, a vast collection of woodblocks used to print Buddhist scripture. The storage halls were designed with ventilation to help preserve the blocks.

Royal patronage supported work on the complex during the fifteenth century, and repairs continued under Joseon rulers. The storage halls survived the Japanese invasions of the late sixteenth century, although later fires damaged other parts of the monastery. Haeinsa connected the mountain district with religious learning and printing traditions across Korea.
simp_chinese:
陕川的林木山岭中坐落着海印寺，这座佛寺始建于九世纪初。1398年，高丽大藏经木刻版迁至寺内保存。这批印制佛经的木版数量庞大，藏经殿的通风设计有助于保护它们。

十五世纪王室赞助寺院工程，朝鲜王朝后来的统治者也继续修葺。十六世纪末日本入侵期间，藏版殿得以幸存，但后来的火灾损毁了寺院其他部分。海印寺将这一山地地区与朝鲜各地的佛教学术和印刷传统联系起来。

english:
Hapsal, or Haapsalu, stands on a sheltered bay on Estonia's western coast. It grew around the castle and cathedral of the bishops of Ösel–Wiek, who governed lands on the mainland and the island of Saaremaa. Bishop Hermann granted the town rights modelled on those of Riga in 1279. The castle and cathedral formed an ecclesiastical centre as well as a stronghold beside the sea.

In 1559 the last Catholic bishop sold the bishopric to the Danish king. The Livonian War badly damaged Hapsal Castle, and after Sweden took control in 1581 it was rebuilt as a garrison fortress. King Gustavus Adolphus sold it to Jacob De la Gardie in 1624. A fire destroyed the castle in 1688, and the town suffered further devastation during the Great Northern War.
simp_chinese:
哈普萨尔，即哈普萨卢，坐落在爱沙尼亚西岸一处受遮蔽的海湾旁。城镇围绕厄瑟尔-维克主教的城堡和主教座堂发展起来，主教统治大陆及萨雷马岛上的土地。1279年，赫尔曼主教按里加法授予城镇自治权。城堡和主教座堂既是教会中心，也是海滨要塞。

1559年，最后一位天主教主教将主教领地售予丹麦国王。利沃尼亚战争使哈普萨尔城堡严重受损；1581年瑞典取得控制权后，城堡被改建为驻军要塞。1624年，古斯塔夫·阿道夫国王将其售予雅各布·德拉加迪。1688年的火灾毁坏了城堡，大北方战争又使城镇遭到进一步破坏。

english: Hapur lies east of Delhi in the upper Doab, the country between the Ganges and Yamuna. Tradition places its foundation in the tenth century. The Ain-i Akbari records it as a pargana of Delhi, contributing revenue and a contingent of infantry and cavalry to the Mughal state. At the end of the eighteenth century the Maratha ruler Daulat Scindia granted Hapur to his French general Pierre Cuillier-Perron, as power around Delhi passed into new hands.
simp_chinese: 哈普尔位于德里以东、恒河与亚穆纳河之间的上河间地。传说它建于十世纪。《阿克巴制度》记载这里是德里下属的帕尔加纳，向莫卧儿国家缴纳赋税并提供步兵和骑兵。十八世纪末，德里周边的权力格局发生变化，马拉塔统治者道拉特·辛迪亚将哈普尔授予他的法国将军皮埃尔·居耶－佩龙。

english: Haql stands on the eastern shore near the head of the Gulf of Aqaba, where the Red Sea reaches deep into the desert between Arabia and Sinai. Mountains rise behind the coast, while the narrow gulf opens southward toward the Red Sea. The palm groves and beaches of this northern shore lie close to the meeting place of routes from the Hijaz and the lands farther north.
simp_chinese: 哈基勒位于亚喀巴湾北端附近的东岸，红海在这里深入阿拉伯与西奈之间的沙漠。海岸后方群山耸立，狭长的海湾向南通往红海。北岸的棕榈林与海滩靠近汉志和更北方地区道路的交汇地带。

english: Harad lies southwest of the al-Ahsa oasis, on the desert route linking eastern Arabia with the central interior. The country around it approaches the northern edge of the Empty Quarter, where sandy ground and scattered watering places shape movement across the dry landscape. The name Harad was recorded as a water source known to the Bedouin, providing a halt between the distant settled districts.
simp_chinese: 哈拉德位于哈萨绿洲西南，处在连接阿拉伯东部与中部内陆的荒漠道路上。周边接近空旷之地北缘，沙地和分散水源影响着人们穿越干旱地带的路线。哈拉德之名曾被记作贝都因人熟悉的水源地，为远隔的定居区之间提供停驻之处。

english: Harad lies on the northern Tihama plain, where Wadi Harad descends west from the hills toward the Red Sea. The settlement stands on an alluvial fan beside the wadi, with cultivated fields spread over the surrounding plain. Its position connects the coastal lowlands with the broken country rising to the east and the routes leading toward the Yemeni highlands.
simp_chinese: 哈拉德位于提哈马平原北部，哈拉德干河从东面丘陵向西流向红海。聚落坐落在干河旁的冲积扇上，周围平原铺展着农田。这里连接沿海低地与东面起伏的山地，以及通往也门高地的道路。

english:
Haradok stands beside the Harazhanka River and Lake Luhavoye, north of Vitebsk. Its early modern importance grew from fortification and local administration. After Muscovite forces destroyed the castle at Yeziaryshcha, a bastioned castle was built at Haradok in the late sixteenth century, and the settlement became a volost centre. Tomasz Makowski's map, published in Amsterdam in 1613, marked it as a small town in the Vitebsk voivodeship of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania.

This was a frontier landscape in which a fortified settlement could organise the surrounding countryside as well as offer protection. The First Partition of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth transferred Haradok to the Russian Empire in 1772, when it received town status. A new coat of arms followed in 1781. By 1802 it was the administrative centre of a district in Vitebsk Governorate. The river-and-lake setting remained the same, but the institutions through which the town served its rural hinterland changed from Lithuanian local jurisdiction to an imperial district administration.
simp_chinese:
哈拉多克位于维捷布斯克以北的哈拉然卡河与卢哈沃耶湖畔，近世地位同防御和地方行政相连。莫斯科军队摧毁叶泽里谢城堡之后，十六世纪末这里修建棱堡式城堡，聚落也成为乡区中心。托马什·马科夫斯基1613年在阿姆斯特丹出版的地图，将其标作立陶宛大公国维捷布斯克省的一座小城镇。

在这片边疆，设防聚落既可提供庇护，也承担组织周围乡村的作用。1772年，波兰立陶宛联邦第一次被瓜分，哈拉多克转入俄罗斯帝国，并于同年获得城市地位。1781年颁发新城徽；到1802年，它已成为维捷布斯克省同名县的行政中心。河流与湖泊的地理背景延续下来，城镇服务乡村腹地的制度却不断调整，从立陶宛地方辖区转为俄国帝国县级行政机构，使这一旧堡垒获得新的政治角色。

english: Harahey was a country on the northern edge of Quivira, known from the account of Francisco Vázquez de Coronado’s expedition. Its communities lay on the central Plains, beyond the grass-covered villages and cultivated fields that the Spaniards encountered in Kansas. In 1541 a delegation associated with a leader called Tatarrax came to meet Coronado while he was among the Quivirans. Harahey belonged to a world of neighboring peoples whose farming villages and bison hunts linked the river valleys to the open prairie.
simp_chinese: 哈拉赫是基维拉北缘的一片地区，见于弗朗西斯科·巴斯克斯·德·科罗纳多远征队的记载。其社群位于中央平原，在西班牙人于堪萨斯见到的覆草村舍和农田之外。1541年，科罗纳多停留在基维拉人中间时，一支与名为塔塔拉克斯的领袖有关的代表团前来会见他。哈拉赫属于相邻民族组成的世界；农耕村落与野牛狩猎将河谷和开阔草原联系起来。

english: Haraiki was an inhabited atoll in the Tuamotu world when Domingo de Boenechea's expedition encountered it in 1772. Sailing from Callao toward Tahiti, the Spanish navigator reached the island on 31 October and named it San Quintín. This European name entered the voyage's record alongside the Polynesian place itself. The reception was far from an encounter with an empty island. A study of early Polynesian contacts describes armed inhabitants on the shore, shouting, displaying weapons and using fires as the vessel passed. These actions were interpreted by the visitors as hostility. The episode records islanders actively responding to an unfamiliar ship, while the Spanish expedition classified and renamed places along its Pacific route. It establishes a specific late-eighteenth-century encounter without supplying a complete history of the island's earlier community.
simp_chinese: 1772年，多明戈·德·博埃内切亚的远征队抵达哈拉基时，这座土阿莫土环礁已有居民。西班牙航海者从卡亚俄驶向塔希提，于十月三十一日经过此岛，并将其命名为圣昆廷，使这一欧洲名称进入航行记录。接触对象并非无人岛：有关早期波利尼西亚接触的研究记述，岸上居民携带武器、呼喊示意，并在船只经过时使用火光，来访者将这些行为理解为敌意。这段经历留下的是岛民主动回应陌生船只的场景，同时也反映西班牙远征在太平洋航线上辨认和重命名岛屿的做法。它提供了一次十八世纪后期的具体接触记录，却不足以重建当地社群此前的完整历史。

english: Haraiki is a small triangular atoll in the Tuamotu archipelago, with a southern passage into its lagoon. In 1772 the Spanish navigator Domingo de Boenechea first sighted the atoll from the ship Águila and gave the atoll the name San Quintín.
simp_chinese: 哈拉伊基是土阿莫土群岛的一座小型三角形环礁，南部有进入潟湖的水道。1772年，西班牙航海家多明戈·德·博内切亚在“阿吉拉”号上望见此地，将环礁命名为圣金廷。

english: Harandzuvan was a fortified town on the road through the western Chu valley. Medieval geographical accounts describe it as enclosed by a wall with a citadel in which a local lord lived. Archaeologists have associated it with the remains near Belovodskoye, whose position on natural rises and substantial defensive walls fit that description. The town lay between Nuzket and Dzhul on a route connecting the settlements of the valley.
simp_chinese: 哈兰祖万是楚河谷地西部道路上的一座设防城镇。中世纪地理著作称它有城墙，城内堡垒住着地方领主。考古学家将它与别洛沃茨科耶附近的遗址相联系：那里位于天然高地，留有坚固防御墙的痕迹，与这一描述相符。城镇位于努兹凯特与朱尔之间，沿途道路连接着谷地聚落。

english: Haranka lies in southern Somalia, in the country between the Jubba and Shabelle rivers. These rivers carry water from the Ethiopian highlands through the otherwise dry lowlands, and their seasonal floods spread across neighbouring plains. Communities in this interriverine region have combined cultivation with livestock keeping, making use of the different soils and pastures between the river valleys and the coast.
simp_chinese: 哈兰卡位于索马里南部、朱巴河与谢贝利河之间。这两条河将埃塞俄比亚高地的水带入原本干旱的低地，季节性洪水漫过邻近平原。河间地区的社群结合耕作与畜牧，利用河谷和海岸之间不同的土壤与牧场。

english:
Harar stands on a plateau above the dry lowlands of eastern Ethiopia. Its fortified old town, the Jugol, encloses a maze of narrow lanes, mosques, shrines and houses whose interiors reflect distinctive Harari traditions. Five historic gates opened onto the roads leading to the city, a renowned centre of Islamic learning and commerce between the coast and the highlands.

In 1520 Sultan Abu Bakr moved the seat of the Adal sultanate from Dakkar to Harar. The city became the base of Imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi's campaigns against Christian Ethiopia. Later in the sixteenth century, Emir Nur ibn Mujahid fortified Harar as the region faced renewed warfare and the expansion of Oromo peoples. When the sultanate's political centre moved elsewhere, Harar remained a city of merchants and scholars; in the seventeenth century it became an independent emirate under a new dynasty. Its religious institutions and markets sustained connections across the Horn of Africa.
simp_chinese:
哈勒尔坐落在埃塞俄比亚东部干旱低地之上的高原上。设防的旧城“朱戈勒”围起迷宫般的窄巷、清真寺、圣陵和民居，住宅内部保留着鲜明的哈勒尔传统。五座古老城门通向城外道路；这座城市也是伊斯兰学问中心，以及海岸与高地之间著名的贸易中心。

1520年，苏丹阿布·贝克尔将阿达尔苏丹国的驻地从达卡尔迁至哈勒尔。此后，伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐从这里出发，发动针对基督教埃塞俄比亚的战争。十六世纪后期，战事再起，奥罗莫人向外扩展，埃米尔努尔·伊本·穆贾希德为哈勒尔修筑防御工事。苏丹国的政治中心迁往别处后，这里仍是商人与学者的城市；十七世纪，新王朝建立独立的哈勒尔埃米尔国。宗教机构与市场继续维系着它同非洲之角各地的联系。

english: Harardhere lies in the dry country of central Somalia, near the Indian Ocean coast. Pastoral communities move through the inland grazing lands, while the shoreline connects the region with the sea. Seasonal winds and the alternation of rain and drought shape life across this stretch of the Somali coast.
simp_chinese: 哈拉尔代雷位于索马里中部干旱地区，靠近印度洋海岸。牧民社群穿行于内陆牧地，海岸则将这一地区与海洋相连。季节风以及雨季和旱季的交替，影响着索马里这段海岸的生活。

english: Harat is a town on the dry Iranian plateau where Fars meets Kerman, in the Marvast country south of Yazd. Medieval geographers including Istakhri and Ibn Hawqal recorded a town of this name in the Istakhr region of Fars. The district around it, with Bavanat to the west and Niriz to the south, was a block of Fars on the Kerman border, living from grain watered by underground channels. In later centuries that country passed from Fars toward Kerman and Yazd.
simp_chinese: 赫拉特是伊朗高原干燥地带上的一座城镇，位于法尔斯与克尔曼交界处，属亚兹德以南的马尔瓦斯特一带。伊斯塔赫里和伊本·豪卡勒等中世纪地理学家记载了法尔斯伊斯塔赫尔地区的同名城镇。周围地区西邻巴瓦纳特，南接尼里兹，是法尔斯靠克尔曼边界的一块辖地，靠地下渠道灌溉的谷物为生。后世这一带从法尔斯转向克尔曼和亚兹德。

sources.title: 409585239 Archaeological Survey at Khatam District Yazd Province Iran PERSICA ANTIQUA

english: The mountains around Hajjah rise above Yemen's Red Sea lowlands. Steep cliffs and deeply cut valleys divide the western highlands, where streams descend toward the plain of Tihamah. Higher ground gives way westward to foothills and, beyond them, the coastal plain. Terraced slopes and fortified settlements occupy the more accessible parts of this rugged country.
simp_chinese: 哈杰周围的群山高耸于也门红海低地之上。陡峭崖壁与深切谷地分隔西部高原，溪流由此向提哈马平原流去。高处向西逐渐转为山麓，再往外便是沿海平原。在这片崎岖土地较易到达的地带，梯田和设防聚落点缀山坡。

english: The highlands northwest of Sanaa form part of Yemen's rugged mountain country. Steep slopes and deeply cut valleys separate the elevated interior from the lower lands toward the Red Sea. Farmers built terraces on the mountainsides to hold soil and make use of rainfall, while villages and fortified heights occupy the ridges and valleys. The plateau around Sanaa lies beyond these ranges to the southeast.
simp_chinese: 萨那西北的高地属于也门崎岖山地的一部分。陡坡和深切谷地将高耸的内陆与通向红海的低地分隔开来。农民在山坡修筑梯田，保住土壤并利用雨水；村庄和设防高地分布在山脊与谷间。萨那周围的高原则位于山地东南方。

english: The western Yemeni highlands rise sharply above the Tihama coastal plain. Deep valleys cut through the mountains, and their seasonal waters descend toward the Red Sea. Farmers have built terraces on the steep slopes, retaining soil and rainwater behind stone walls to make fields where little level ground is available. Grain, coffee and vegetables grow on these carefully shaped mountainsides, while villages occupy ridges and heights above the valleys.
simp_chinese: 也门西部高地从提哈马沿海平原上陡然升起。深谷切穿山脉，季节性水流沿谷流向红海。农民在陡坡上修筑梯田，以石墙留住土壤和雨水，在少有平地的地方开垦田地。谷物、咖啡和蔬菜生长在精心塑造的山坡上，村庄则坐落于山谷之上的山脊和高处。
