english: The mountains around Ibb form part of Yemen's southern highlands. Ridges rise above valleys that become green in the rainy season, and stone-walled terraces turn steep slopes into fields. Jabal Badhan overlooks the town of Ibb, where a route crosses the highland passes between Sanaa and Taizz. Travellers once climbed these passes on roads with steps cut from stone, passing cultivated mountainsides before descending into the next valley.
simp_chinese: 伊卜周围的山岭属于也门南部高地。山脊高出雨季转绿的谷地，石墙梯田将陡坡变为田地。巴丹山俯瞰伊卜城，连接萨那与塔伊兹的道路在此越过高地山口。旅人曾沿铺有石阶的道路攀越这些山口，经过耕作的山坡，再下行进入另一处山谷。

english:
Harburg stood on the Süderelbe opposite Hamburg, growing from a castle and a settlement along the causeway that connected its sandy island with firmer ground. From 1527 to 1642 it served as the residence of a junior branch of the dukes of Brunswick-Lüneburg. Under Otto II, who ruled from 1549 to 1603, a government chancery and ecclesiastical superintendency were established, although the district never acquired full territorial sovereignty.

The town's fortunes were closely bound to Hamburg's commerce. A long dispute over the Süderelbe led to an Imperial Chamber Court ruling in 1619 confirming free navigation, but Hamburg did not comply. Duke Wilhelm, who received an annual payment from Hamburg, eventually relinquished his claims. His reign also saw a new quarter built on former farmland in 1614. When the ducal branch died out in 1642, Harburg returned to the Celle line and lost its function as a princely residence.
simp_chinese:
哈尔堡位于汉堡对面的易北河南支，起源于一座城堡，以及沿连接沙质河岛与坚实陆地的堤道形成的聚落。1527—1642年，这里是布伦瑞克—吕讷堡公爵一支旁系的驻地。奥托二世统治期间，即1549—1603年，设立了政务官署与教会监督机构，但这一辖区并未获得完整的领土主权。

城镇命运与汉堡商业紧密相连。围绕易北河南支的长期争端，促成1619年帝国最高法院确认自由航行的判决，但汉堡没有执行。每年接受汉堡款项的威廉公爵最终放弃相关要求。他在位期间还于1614年将原有农地辟为新城区。1642年公爵支系绝嗣后，哈尔堡归回策勒主系，失去亲王驻地职能。

english: Harbuzynka lies on a small river of the same name, a tributary of the Mertvovod in the Southern Bug basin. Several small settlements arose here in the middle of the eighteenth century, known as Haidamatske, Moldavanske and Lytovske. Settlers included Cossacks and people moved by the imperial authorities, and in 1799 the communities were united as one village. The river gave the settlement its name and linked it to the valleys leading towards the Bug.
simp_chinese: 哈尔布津卡坐落在同名小河畔。这条河是南布格河流域梅尔特沃沃德河的支流。十八世纪中叶，这里出现了几个小聚落，分别称为海达马茨凯、摩尔达万斯凯和利托夫斯凯。移民中包括哥萨克以及由帝国当局迁来的居民；1799年，这些聚居点合为一村。河流为聚落提供了名称，也将它与通往布格河的河谷联系起来。

english:
Harcourt in eastern Normandy gave its name to a powerful noble family. Its stone castle, begun in the twelfth century and enlarged in later generations, combined a lordly residence with formidable defences. A double ditch and a fortified outer court protected the buildings, while round towers guarded the entrance.

Raised to a county in 1338, Harcourt was drawn into the Hundred Years' War. The English took its fortified castle in 1418, and French forces recovered it after a siege in 1449. It changed hands again during the Wars of Religion and its walls suffered serious damage from artillery. In the late seventeenth century Marie-Françoise de Brancas transformed the fortress into a more comfortable residence, opening large windows and laying out a formal garden.
simp_chinese:
诺曼底东部的阿库尔是一支显赫贵族家族的发源地。这里的石堡始建于十二世纪，经过后世扩建，既是领主的居所，也是一座防御坚固的堡垒。双重壕沟和设防的外院保护着城堡，圆塔则守卫入口。

阿库尔领地于1338年升为伯国，随后卷入百年战争。英军在1418年夺取城堡，法军于1449年围城后将其收复。宗教战争期间，城堡再次易手城墙受到炮火严重损坏。十七世纪末，玛丽-弗朗索瓦丝·德·布朗卡将堡垒改造成更舒适的居所，开辟大窗并修建规整的花园。

english:
Hardanger Fjord's shores supported landed estates as well as farming communities. At Rosendal, Karen Mowat and Ludvig Rosenkrantz received the Hatteberg farm as a wedding gift in 1658. They built a stone manor there, giving the estate its Rosendal name. The house and its surrounding lands brought aristocratic residence into the fjord landscape, alongside the farms and woodland on which landed wealth depended.

The property passed through several members of the Rosenkrantz family. In 1745 Edvard Londemann af Rosencrone purchased it; shortly before his death he converted it into an entailed estate. His son later secured its transformation into a barony. Rosendal's succession illustrates how inheritance, marriage and royal recognition helped organise property on this part of the fjord during the Danish-Norwegian monarchy.
simp_chinese:
哈当厄峡湾沿岸既有农业社区，也有贵族地产。1658年，卡伦·莫瓦特与路德维格·罗森克兰茨获赠哈特贝格农场作为结婚礼物。他们在此建造石砌宅邸，将庄园命名为罗斯达尔。贵族住宅及其土地进入峡湾景观，与支撑地产财富的农场、森林相联系。

庄园先后传给罗森克兰茨家族数位成员。1745年，爱德华·隆德曼·阿夫·罗森克罗内将它购入，并在临终前设为限定继承的家产；他的儿子后来又使其获得男爵领地位。罗斯达尔的传承表明，在丹麦—挪威君主国时期，婚姻、继承和王室认可共同影响着这段峡湾沿岸的财产组织。

english: Hardangervidda is a vast mountain plateau between the fjords of western Norway and the valleys of the east. Its open highlands, lakes and winter snows form a demanding landscape, but wild reindeer have long drawn hunters into it. Remains of medieval hunting stations and heaps of reindeer bones beside northern lakes reveal organised trapping and butchery on the plateau. Routes across the heights also connected communities living on opposite sides of the mountains.
simp_chinese: 哈当厄高原是挪威西部峡湾与东部山谷之间广阔的山地台地。开阔高地、湖泊和冬季积雪构成严酷的环境，但野生驯鹿长期吸引猎人前来。北部湖边的中世纪狩猎站遗迹和驯鹿骨堆，显示高原上曾有组织地捕捉和分割猎物。穿越高地的路线也连接着山脉两侧的社区。

english: Harderwijk stood on the shore of the Zuiderzee at the western edge of the Veluwe. Fishing and seafaring sustained the town, which joined the Hanseatic League and shared in the commerce of the northern seas. Count Otto II of Guelders granted it town rights in 1231, and a wall enclosed it by the end of the century. The Fish Gate opened towards the waterfront. The town expanded southward around 1315, when its great church was built, and northward around 1425. From 1648 Harderwijk also had a university; the Swedish naturalist Carl Linnaeus received his degree there. The university continued until 1811, when Napoleon abolished it along with those of Zutphen and Franeker.
simp_chinese: 哈尔德韦克位于费吕沃高地西缘的须德海岸边。捕鱼和航海维系着城镇生计；它加入汉萨同盟，参与北方海域的贸易。海尔德伯爵奥托二世于1231年授予它城市权利，到该世纪末城墙已将城镇围起。鱼门朝向水滨开放。城镇约在1315年向南扩展，当时兴建了大教堂；约1425年又向北扩展。自1648年起，哈尔德韦克还拥有一所大学，瑞典博物学家卡尔·林奈曾在此获得学位。大学一直延续到1811年，拿破仑将其与聚特芬、弗拉讷克的大学一同废除。

english: Hardoi's old town stands above an ancient settlement mound in the plains of Awadh. Several traditions explain its name: one recalls Raja Hardeo, a Bhar chief, while another connects it with Hiranyakashipu, the king in the story of Prahlad and Holika. A place in the town is remembered as the site of Holika's pyre. Around 1300, Nir Singh and his Chamar Gaur followers are said to have taken the settlement and founded it anew.
simp_chinese: 赫尔多伊老城坐落在阿瓦德平原的一座古聚落丘上。关于城名有多种传说：一种让人想起巴尔首领哈尔德奥王，另一种则将它与普拉赫拉德和霍利卡故事中的国王希兰亚卡西普联系起来。城中一处地方被认为是霍利卡火堆的所在地。相传约1300年，尼尔·辛格率领查马尔高尔人夺取这处聚落，重新建立了城镇。

english: Ojo de Liebre, the Hare's Eye Lagoon, lies on the Pacific coast of the Baja California Peninsula. Sandbars and dunes shelter its shallow waters from the ocean, while salt marshes border the lagoon and dry desert stretches inland. In winter gray whales arrive from northern feeding grounds to mate and bear their calves in these protected waters. Along with nearby San Ignacio and Magdalena lagoons, Ojo de Liebre forms part of the whales' long seasonal journey down the peninsula.
simp_chinese: 野兔眼潟湖，即奥霍德利布雷潟湖，位于下加利福尼亚半岛的太平洋海岸。沙洲与沙丘将浅水潟湖同大洋隔开，盐沼沿岸分布，内陆则是干旱的沙漠。冬季灰鲸从北方觅食地南来，在受保护的水域交配、产仔。野兔眼与附近的圣伊格纳西奥和马格达莱纳潟湖，都是灰鲸沿半岛漫长季节迁徙途中的停留地。

english: Haresabad is a village of the Bayhaq district near Sabzevar, remembered as the birthplace of the historian Abu'l-Fadl Bayhaqi. Born in the late tenth century, he studied at Nishapur and entered the Ghaznavid chancery, where he served under the secretary Abu Nasr Mushkan. His history of the Ghaznavid rulers combined knowledge of court affairs with a vivid Persian prose style, preserving accounts of political life for later generations.
simp_chinese: 哈雷萨巴德是萨卜泽瓦尔附近拜哈格地区的一处村庄，历史学家阿布勒·法兹勒·拜哈基生于此地。拜哈基出生于十世纪末，曾在内沙布尔求学，后进入加兹尼王朝的文书机构，在书记阿布·纳斯尔·穆什坎手下任职。他记述加兹尼诸王的史书结合了对宫廷事务的了解与生动的波斯散文，为后世保存了政治生活的记录。

english: Hargan belongs to the mountain country of Hadjin, north of Sis in Armenian Cilicia. An Armenian bishopric bore the name Hargan, while Hadjin grew as a mountain town during the Armenian period. The surrounding valleys and forested ridges separate this upland country from the Cilician plain. Religious institutions connected its communities with the Armenian church centred at Sis, even as the mountain settlements retained their own local identities.
simp_chinese: 哈尔甘属于锡斯以北的哈金山地，位于奇里乞亚亚美尼亚境内。亚美尼亚的一处主教区以哈尔甘为名，哈金则在亚美尼亚统治时期发展为山城。周围河谷和森林山脊将这一高地区域与奇里乞亚平原隔开。宗教机构使当地社群与以锡斯为中心的亚美尼亚教会相连，山间聚落也保留着各自的地方特色。

sources.title: Catolicosado de la Gran Casa de Cilicia

english: Hargaya was a Muslim polity of the Harar plateau, east of the Awash River, among the principalities that formed the wider region of Adal. Its rulers bore the title garad. In the fourteenth century its people chose Imam Salih to fight the forces of the Ethiopian emperor Amda Seyon. Hargaya's warriors later appear in accounts of Imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi's sixteenth-century campaigns against Christian Ethiopia.
simp_chinese: 哈尔加亚是阿瓦什河以东、哈勒尔高原上的穆斯林政权，也是阿达尔广大地区的诸侯国之一。其统治者称为加拉德。十四世纪，当地人推举伊玛目萨利赫对抗埃塞俄比亚皇帝阿姆达·塞永的军队。十六世纪，哈尔加亚的战士又出现在伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐征战基督教埃塞俄比亚的记载中。

english:
Hargeisa's setting is the inland northern Somali plateau, connected by caravan routes with Harar, the Ogaden and the Gulf of Aden. Oral accounts remember it as a watering and trading stop for nomads and caravans, associated with Arap and neighbouring Somali communities. The permanent religious commune linked with Sheikh Madar belongs to the later nineteenth century; it should not be projected back into the medieval landscape.

Before 1837 the wider region's commercial outlet was Berbera. Its seasonal fair drew goods from the interior, including coffee from the Harar country, myrrh and gum arabic, and connected Somali merchants with Mocha and other Arabian ports. The cool-season trading calendar joined maritime traffic to the movement of caravans and livestock. Regional authority changed through the periods of Ifat, Adal and the Isaaq sultanate, while pastoral society retained its own local relationships. Hargeisa's earlier history is consequently best placed within this inland and coastal network. Its water and routes mattered before the emergence of the larger town, but surviving accounts do not establish a continuous urban history here throughout the fourteenth to eighteenth centuries.
simp_chinese:
哈尔格萨的地理背景是索马里北部内陆高原，商队道路将其同哈勒尔、欧加登及亚丁湾相连。口述传统把这里记为游牧人和商队汲水、交易的停歇地，与阿拉普及邻近索马里社群有关。谢赫·马达尔建立的常住宗教社群属于十九世纪后半叶，不能据此重构中世纪的聚落景象。

1837年以前，更广大地区的重要商业出口是柏培拉。季节性集市汇集内陆物产，包括哈勒尔一带的咖啡、没药和阿拉伯胶，并把索马里商人同穆哈及其他阿拉伯港口连接起来。凉季贸易日程使海运、商队和牲畜流动相互配合。区域权力先后经历伊法特、阿达尔和伊萨克苏丹国的变化，牧民社会仍维持地方关系。哈尔格萨的早期历史因此宜置于这种内陆与沿海网络中理解。水源及交通路线在大型城镇形成前已有作用，但现存记述不足以建立十四至十八世纪连续的城市史。

english: Harib lies in a valley south of Marib, where watercourses descend from the eastern Yemeni highlands toward the sands of Ramlat al-Sab'atayn. Fields and villages occupy the banks of the wadis, whose floods carry alluvial soil from the mountains. At the meeting of Wadi Harib and Wadi Ayn stood the ancient Qatabanian town of Haribat, commanding a caravan route between Bayhan and Marib. Stone walls and inscriptions bear witness to the older settlements of this valley.
simp_chinese: 哈里卜位于马里卜以南的山谷，水道从也门东部高地流向萨巴泰因沙漠。村庄与田地分布在干河两岸，洪水从山中带来冲积土。在哈里卜干河与艾因干河交汇处，曾有盖德班古城哈里巴特，扼守拜汉和马里卜之间的商队道路。石墙与铭文见证了山谷中更古老的聚落。

english: The Harishchandra Range extends eastward from the Western Ghats across the Deccan. It forms a watershed between rivers flowing towards the Godavari and those joining the Bhima and Krishna. The Pravara drains the northern side, while tributaries of the Bhima flow from the southern slopes. This long spur separates neighbouring river basins, its ridges giving way eastward to the drier plateau of Maharashtra.
simp_chinese: 哈里什昌德拉山脉从西高止山脉向东延伸，横贯德干高原。它是戈达瓦里河水系与比马河、克里希纳河水系之间的分水岭。普拉瓦拉河汇集北侧水流，比马河支流则从南坡流出。长长的山脊分隔相邻流域，向东逐渐过渡到马哈拉施特拉较干燥的高原。

english: Harishpur lies in the riverine country of coastal Odisha, where channels of the Mahanadi delta lead towards the Bay of Bengal. In April 1633 a party of English East India Company merchants arrived at Harishpur from Masulipatam, seeking a footing in the region’s trade. Their venture belonged to a wider movement of European traders along the coast, which also brought English merchants to Balasore and other ports where Indian cloth and other goods were gathered for shipment.
simp_chinese: 哈里什布尔位于奥里萨沿海的河流地区，默哈讷迪河三角洲的水道从这里通向孟加拉湾。1633年4月，一队英国东印度公司商人从马苏利帕坦抵达哈里什布尔，寻求在当地贸易中立足。他们的行动是欧洲商人沿海扩张的一部分；英国商人也来到巴莱索尔等港口，收集印度布匹和其他货物装船。

english:
Harlau was one of the residences of Moldavia’s princes. Its court is documented in 1384 as the home of Margareta Musata, mother of Petru I and Roman I. Stephen the Great rebuilt the residence in 1486 and added the Church of Saint George in 1492. On 12 July 1499 he signed a peace treaty here with the Poles of King John Albert. The court was a place of government as well as residence, where princely charters and agreements were issued.

Its importance declined when Alexandru Lapusneanu shifted Moldavia’s capital to Iasi. Yet a fire at the Iasi court in 1624 brought Radu Mihnea back to Harlau. He enlarged the residence, introducing improvements influenced by Italian architecture, and died here in January 1626. The court remained intact when Scarlat Ghica visited in 1727, preserving a substantial reminder of the town’s earlier political importance.
simp_chinese:
赫尔勒乌是摩尔达维亚诸侯的驻地之一。1384年的文书记载，这里的宫廷是彼得鲁一世与罗曼一世之母玛尔加蕾塔·穆沙塔的住所。斯特凡大公于1486年重建宫廷，1492年又增建圣乔治教堂。1499年7月12日，他在此与波兰国王扬·阿尔布雷赫特一方签订和约。宫廷既是居所，也是颁发君主文书、缔结协议的治理场所。

亚历山德鲁·勒普什内亚努将摩尔达维亚首都迁往雅西后，这里的重要性有所减退。但1624年雅西宫廷发生火灾，使拉杜·米赫内亚重新迁来。他扩建驻地，引入受到意大利建筑影响的改造，并于1626年1月在此去世。1727年斯卡尔拉特·吉卡到访时，宫廷仍然完整，保存着这座城镇往日政治地位的鲜明痕迹。

english: Harlech Castle crowns a rocky height above the coast of northwestern Wales. Built for Edward I after the conquest of Gwynedd, it was supplied by a steep route from the sea. Its walls later sheltered a very different court, as Welsh forces turned the king's fortress against English rule. Owain Glyndŵr captured Harlech in 1404 and made it a residence for his family and government. He held a parliament there in 1405, asserting his authority as Prince of Wales. English forces under the future Henry V recovered the castle in 1409. It endured another famous siege in 1468 during the Wars of the Roses.
simp_chinese: 哈勒克城堡雄踞威尔士西北海岸上方的岩石高地。它在爱德华一世征服圭内斯后建造，一条陡峭道路从海边通向城堡，为其供应物资。城墙后来庇护了截然不同的宫廷：威尔士军队将国王的要塞用于反抗英格兰统治。欧文·格林杜尔于1404年夺取哈勒克，将其作为家族和政府的驻地。1405年，他在此召开议会，宣示自己作为威尔士亲王的权威。未来的亨利五世率英军于1409年夺回城堡。1468年玫瑰战争期间，城堡又经历了一次著名围攻。

english:
Harlingen stands on the Frisian coast beside navigable channels through the Wadden Sea. Fishing and shipping sustained the town, though the shallow waters limited the size of vessels that could reach its harbour. During the struggles between the Schieringers and Vetkopers, Franeker forces seized Harlingen in 1496; two years later Duke Albert of Saxony landed here and began strengthening its defences.

Religious refugees, including Mennonites, settled in Harlingen during the Dutch Revolt. The town expanded repeatedly, and in 1597 new earthen fortifications and harbours replaced its older walls. The Admiralty of Friesland moved here from Dokkum in 1645. Merchants imported grain, timber and naval supplies from the Baltic and exported Frisian butter, cheese and livestock, linking the harbour to both its rural hinterland and distant markets.
simp_chinese:
哈灵根位于弗里斯兰海岸，濒临穿过瓦登海的可航行水道。捕鱼和航海维系着城镇生计，但浅水限制了能够进入港口的船只大小。希林格派与费特科珀派争斗期间，弗拉讷克的军队于1496年夺取哈灵根；两年后，萨克森公爵阿尔布雷希特在此登陆并开始加强城防。

荷兰起义期间，门诺派等宗教难民在哈灵根定居。城镇多次扩展，1597年新的土筑防御工事和港口取代了旧城墙。1645年，弗里斯兰海军部从多克姆迁来。商人从波罗的海输入谷物、木材和航海用品，出口弗里斯兰的黄油、奶酪与牲畜，将港口同乡村腹地及远方市场连接起来。

english: Harmancık lies in the wooded mountains south of Bursa, between the heights of Asar and Küplü. Once a small settlement dependent on Adranos, it belonged to a frontier district brought under Ottoman rule in the early fourteenth century. Yörük communities settled in the surrounding uplands, where villages and grazing grounds shared the broken terrain. Remains near İlıcaksu recall the region's earlier Roman past.
simp_chinese: 哈曼哲克位于布尔萨以南的林木山地，坐落在阿萨尔山与屈普吕山之间。它曾是阿德拉诺斯属下的小聚落，周边边疆地区在十四世纪初归入奥斯曼统治。游牧的约鲁克社群在高地定居，村落与牧场分布于崎岖山间；伊勒贾克苏附近的遗迹则留下了更早的罗马时代印记。

english:
Härnösand developed on Härnön around an older market and harbour near the mouth of the Ångerman River. In 1585 Johan III compelled country merchants and craftsmen to gather there and build a town, bringing an important trading place under closer royal control. Timber houses stretched along the shores, each with its own waterside storehouse. A rowing ferry linked the island town with the mainland until the first bridge was built in 1658.

Merchants traded with Stockholm, Lübeck and Danzig, exporting fish, butter, hides, linen, tar and timber while importing salt, grain and manufactured goods. Fishing remained a major occupation, shared by traders and artisans as well as specialist fishermen. Royal regulation could restrict the town's opportunities: customs duties were imposed in 1622, and in 1636 the northern towns were forbidden to trade with places other than Stockholm. Härnösand's growth consequently depended both on its maritime resources and on changing rules imposed by the Crown.
simp_chinese:
海讷桑德在海讷岛的一处旧市场及港口周围发展，靠近翁厄曼河口。1585年，约翰三世迫使乡间商人和工匠迁来集中建镇，以加强王室对重要贸易地点的控制。木屋沿岸排列，各自设有临水仓房。岛上城镇起初依靠划桨渡船联系大陆，1658年才建起第一座桥。

商人与斯德哥尔摩、吕贝克及但泽贸易，输出鱼、黄油、皮张、亚麻布、焦油和木材，输入盐、谷物及制成品。渔业仍是主要生计，商人与工匠也参与其中。王室规制有时限制城镇机会：1622年开始征收关税，1636年北方城镇被禁止与斯德哥尔摩以外的地点贸易。因此，海讷桑德的发展既依靠海上资源，也受王室不断变化的规定影响。

english: Cape Haro projects into the Gulf of California on the Sonoran coast, near the entrance to Guaymas Bay. The bay was home to Indigenous Guaymas, Seri and Yaqui communities before Spanish ships reached it in the sixteenth century. Jesuits later established a mission at San José de Guaymas, but resistance and conflict repeatedly interrupted their work. The mission was finally abandoned in 1759. Guaymas developed as a port only gradually, with commercial maritime traffic authorized in 1811.
simp_chinese: 阿罗角从索诺拉海岸伸入加利福尼亚湾，位于瓜伊马斯湾入口附近。十六世纪西班牙船只抵达以前，瓜伊马斯、塞里和亚基等原住民已居住在湾区。耶稣会后来建立圣何塞德瓜伊马斯传教站，但抵抗与冲突屡次中断传教活动，传教站最终于1759年被放弃。瓜伊马斯逐渐发展为港口，1811年获准开展商业海运。

english: At the northern end of the Strait of Georgia, islands lie between Vancouver Island and a deeply indented mainland shore. The Tla'amin, one of the Coast Salish peoples, have long lived along this coast. Their lands include the Malaspina Peninsula and the islands of Cortes, Savary, Hernando, Harwood, and northern Texada, scattered among the channels leading toward the waters farther north.
simp_chinese: 在乔治亚海峡北端，岛屿散布于温哥华岛与海湾深切的大陆海岸之间。海岸萨利希诸民族之一的特拉阿明人长期生活在这里；他们的土地包括马拉斯皮纳半岛，以及科尔特斯、萨瓦里、埃尔南多、哈伍德和特克萨达岛北部。这些岛屿分布在通向北方水域的众多水道之间。

english:
Harput crowns a rocky height above the fertile plain of the upper Euphrates. Its fortress, known to Armenians as Kharberd, guarded a town whose churches, mosques, markets and workshops reflected a long history of settlement. Under the Artuqids the city became a princely centre, and its Great Mosque, built in the twelfth century, stood among the monuments of that era.

Rival powers fought over Harput in the later Middle Ages. Uzun Hasan took it for the Aq Qoyunlu in 1465; his mother Sara Hatun endowed a mosque bearing her name. The Safavids seized the city in 1507, and the Ottomans acquired it after the battle of Chaldiran. As a sancak centre, Harput retained its administrative importance and served the surrounding towns and villages. By the eighteenth century the district was connected to the administration of the Keban mines. In 1834 the governor moved his residence to Mezre on the plain below, and some inhabitants followed. The old fortress and the buildings around it remained a reminder of the city's long role as a stronghold and meeting place of communities in eastern Anatolia.
simp_chinese:
哈尔普特耸立在幼发拉底河上游肥沃平原之上的岩石高地。亚美尼亚人称其堡垒为哈爾贝尔德，堡垒守护着教堂、清真寺、集市和工坊并存的城镇，反映出悠久的聚落历史。阿尔图克王朝时期，它成为诸侯中心，十二世纪修建的大清真寺是那个时代的建筑之一。

中世纪晚期，各方势力争夺哈尔普特。1465年乌尊·哈桑为白羊王朝夺取城市，他的母亲萨拉·哈敦捐建了一座以她命名的清真寺。1507年萨法维人占领此地，查尔迪兰战役后奥斯曼人取得城市。作为桑贾克治所，哈尔普特保有行政地位，服务于周边城镇和村庄。到十八世纪，当地已与凯班矿业管理机构相联系。1834年总督将驻地迁往下方平原上的梅兹雷，部分居民也随之迁移。古堡与周围建筑仍令人想起这座城市长期作为安纳托利亚东部要塞和社群交汇之地的历史。

english:
Harran lies on a plain south of Edessa, on ancient routes across upper Mesopotamia. Known as Carrhae to the Romans, it was a centre of worship of the moon god Sin and the scene of the defeat of Crassus by the Parthians in 53 BC. Its old religious traditions survived into the Islamic period, and scholars from Harran helped transmit Greek learning into Arabic. The city's stone walls, citadel and great mosque marked a prosperous medieval town.

The Ayyubids strengthened Harran, enlarging its mosque and citadel, but the Mongol invasion brought devastation in the thirteenth century. The population was deported and public buildings destroyed. Although the Mamluks regained the district early in the fourteenth century, the city did not recover its former standing. Its ruined fortifications and mosque remained prominent landmarks on the plain.

After the Ottoman conquest in 1516, Harran served for a time as the centre of a district of villages. The settlement that survived among the ruins was much smaller than the city known to medieval travellers. For a time the old castle continued to see occasional use, even after the loss of the bustling town it had defended. Its history nevertheless reached far beyond its diminished size, from the sanctuary of Sin and the ancient caravan roads to the scholars and rulers of the Islamic age.
simp_chinese:
哈兰位于埃德萨以南的平原上，古老的道路从此穿越上美索不达米亚。罗马人称之为卡莱，这里曾是月神辛的崇拜中心；公元前五十三年，帕提亚人在此击败罗马统帅克拉苏。古老的宗教传统延续到伊斯兰时期，哈兰学者也帮助将希腊学术传入阿拉伯世界。石砌城墙、城堡和大清真寺曾标示着这座繁荣的中世纪城市。

阿尤布王朝扩建清真寺和城堡，加强了哈兰的防御，但十三世纪蒙古人的入侵带来毁灭：居民被迫迁走，公共建筑遭到破坏。十四世纪初马穆鲁克人收复这一地区，城市却未能恢复昔日地位。城防和清真寺的废墟仍然醒目地矗立在平原上。

一五一六年奥斯曼人征服此地后，哈兰一度成为辖有多个村庄的地方行政中心。残存于废墟间的聚落远小于中世纪旅行者所见的城市。老城堡在其守护的繁华城镇衰落后，一度仍被偶尔使用。但从辛神的圣所和古代商路，到伊斯兰时代的学者与统治者，它的历史远比后来缩小的规模更为悠长。

english:
Harrand stood at the eastern foot of the Sulaiman Mountains, near the mouth of the Chachar Pass and west of the Indus floodplain. Its fort watched routes between the mountain country and the settled plains around Dajal. A garrison here could influence the movement of caravans, livestock and armed groups without controlling every valley beyond the foothills.

The district passed between competing frontier powers in the early nineteenth century. In 1827 the nawab of Bahawalpur annexed the Harand and Dajal divisions, which had previously belonged to Kalat. Sikh expansion subsequently brought Harrand within the military system directed from Multan. In the 1830s Diwan Sawan Mal replaced the earlier mud-brick defences with a substantial baked-brick fort. Bastions and gateways strengthened a position used to restrain Baloch groups in the Pachad country and protect access towards the Indus crossings. The rebuilding gave durable form to a recent conquest. Along this frontier, the fort's authority depended on soldiers and agreements with neighbouring communities as well as on its masonry.
simp_chinese:
哈兰德位于苏莱曼山地东麓、查查尔山口附近，东望印度河洪泛平原。堡垒守着山地通向达贾尔周围定居区的道路，驻军能够影响商旅、牲畜和武装人群的往来，控制范围却并不自然伸入每一道山谷。

十九世纪初，这片边地在不同势力之间转手。1827年，巴哈瓦尔布尔纳瓦卜兼并原属卡拉特的哈兰德和达贾尔地区；随后锡克扩张又将哈兰德纳入木尔坦统辖的军事体系。十九世纪三十年代，迪万·萨万·马尔以烧砖重建旧土堡，增固城墙、棱堡与门楼，用来约束帕查德地区的俾路支人群，并保障通往印度河渡口的道路。重建工程将近期征服转化为常设据点。堡垒为官兵提供驻守基础，也向周围社群显示新的统治要求；真正维持这份权威，仍需军队以及同邻近人群的交涉。

sources.title: 1873 Central Asia Part 1--Topography Ethnography Statistics and History of North-West Frontier vol 1 by MacGregor s.pdf

english: The Harricana flows north from the lakes and forests of Abitibi to Hannah Bay on James Bay. Its broad waters and gentle surrounding relief made it a well-used route for the Anishinaabe, linking the interior with the northern coast. In the seventeenth century the Algonquin people of Abitibi and Témiscamingue took part in the fur trade, travelling towards French markets on the St. Lawrence. The Harricana basin also lay within the lands claimed under the Hudson's Bay Company's charter of 1670.
simp_chinese: 哈里卡纳河从阿比蒂比的湖泊森林向北流去，注入詹姆斯湾的汉纳湾。宽阔河水和周围平缓地形，使它成为阿尼希纳贝人经常使用的路线，连接内陆与北方海岸。十七世纪，阿比蒂比和泰米斯卡明格的阿尔冈昆人参与毛皮贸易，前往圣劳伦斯河沿岸的法国市场。1670年哈得孙湾公司的特许状也将哈里卡纳流域纳入其声索范围。

english: Harris forms the mountainous southern part of the island it shares with Lewis in the Outer Hebrides. Its rocky eastern shore contrasts with the sandy beaches and fertile machair of the west. At Rodel in the south stands St Clement's Church, associated with the MacLeods of Harris and Dunvegan. Inside is the finely carved tomb prepared in 1528 for Alexander MacLeod, whose memorial depicts ships and hunting as well as religious scenes.
simp_chinese: 哈里斯位于外赫布里底群岛，与刘易斯同处一岛，占据多山的南部。东岸岩石嶙峋，西岸则有沙滩和肥沃的海滨草地。南端罗德尔的圣克莱门特教堂与哈里斯及邓韦根的麦克劳德家族渊源深厚。教堂内保存着1528年为亚历山大·麦克劳德准备的精雕墓龛，上面既有宗教画面，也刻着船只和狩猎场景。

english: Lake Harris is one of a chain of lakes at the headwaters of the Ocklawaha River in central Florida. Its waters connect with Lake Eustis through the Dead River, and the Ocklawaha ultimately joins the St. Johns. The lake lies in a country of shallow waters and wetlands once inhabited by Timucua-speaking peoples. An 1823 map used the name Lake Eustis for the lake, honouring Colonel Abraham Eustis; the name Harris came later.
simp_chinese: 哈里斯湖是佛罗里达中部奥克拉瓦哈河源头湖链的一部分，湖水经死河与尤斯蒂斯湖相连，奥克拉瓦哈河最终汇入圣约翰河。这片浅水与湿地交错的地区曾是提穆夸语族群的家园。1823年的一幅地图以亚伯拉罕·尤斯蒂斯上校之名称此湖为尤斯蒂斯湖；“哈里斯”之名则出现得更晚。

english: Harro Walabu is remembered as a sacred centre of the Oromo in the country near the Ganale River. Oromo traditions associate Walabu with their origins and with the Abbaa Muudaa, a spiritual father who received envoys from different communities. In the pilgrimage known as muudaa, the envoys were anointed with fresh butter and carried his blessings home. The journey linked far-flung Oromo groups to a common ritual centre.
simp_chinese: 哈罗瓦拉布是奥罗莫人记忆中的圣地，位于加纳莱河附近。奥罗莫传统将瓦拉布与族群起源及阿巴·穆达联系起来；这位精神领袖接待来自不同社群的使者。在称为“穆达”的朝圣仪式中，使者接受新鲜黄油的涂抹，并将祝福带回家乡。这段旅程把分布遥远的奥罗莫群体与共同的仪式中心连接起来。

english: Harrow on the Hill stands above the surrounding Middlesex countryside, its church and school occupying a prominent height northwest of London. In 1572 Elizabeth I granted the local landowner John Lyon a charter to endow a free grammar school for boys of the parish. Lyon's foundation grew from a local provision for learning into a celebrated school, closely associated with the hilltop settlement in which it was established.
simp_chinese: 山上哈罗高踞米德尔塞克斯乡野之上，教堂和学校位于伦敦西北一处显眼的高地。1572年，伊丽莎白一世授予当地地主约翰·莱昂特许状，使他得以资助一所供教区男童就读的免费文法学校。莱昂创办的学校从地方教育机构发展为著名学府，与所在的山顶聚落紧密相连。

english: Hârșova stands on the right bank of the Danube in northern Dobruja. The Roman settlement of Carsium grew around a fort here, overlooking the river on the frontier of Moesia and later Scythia Minor. An Ottoman register of 1570 counted sixty-nine guards in the castle town, alongside Muslim and Christian households. The fortress remained a target in wars along the lower Danube: Russian forces took it in 1809 and again in 1828.
simp_chinese: 赫尔绍瓦坐落在北多布罗加的多瑙河右岸。罗马时代，卡尔西乌姆聚落围绕河畔堡垒发展，先后属于默西亚与小斯基泰行省的边疆。1570年的奥斯曼登记册记载，城堡市镇有六十九名守卫，还有穆斯林和基督徒住户。在多瑙河下游的战争中，这座堡垒仍是争夺目标：俄军于1809年和1828年两次攻取此地。

english:
Harunabad stands on a plain west of Kermanshah, where routes cross the Zagros between Mesopotamia and the Iranian plateau. The ancient mound of Chogha Gavaneh preserves evidence of settlement from the Neolithic to the Bronze Age and again in Islamic times. Clay tablets from the site record deliveries of barley, oil and cloth, offering glimpses of the work and exchange of an early community.

Tradition attributes the foundation of Harunabad to the Abbasid caliph Harun al-Rashid, although local accounts also preserve a different explanation of its name. In later centuries the settlement lay in the country of the Kalhor Kurds. The surrounding plain offered summer pasture, while travellers on the road between Mahidasht and Kerend could find lodging at a caravanserai in the village.
simp_chinese:
哈伦阿巴德位于克尔曼沙阿以西的平原上，连接美索不达米亚与伊朗高原的道路在此穿越扎格罗斯山脉。古老的乔加加瓦内遗址丘保存了从新石器时代至青铜时代，以及伊斯兰时期再次有人居住的证据。出土泥板记载大麦、油和布匹的运送，让人得以窥见早期社群的劳动与交换。

传统将哈伦阿巴德的建立归于阿拔斯哈里发哈伦·拉希德，但当地也流传着地名来源的另一种说法。后来的聚落位于卡勒霍尔库尔德人的地区。周围平原提供夏季牧场，往来马希达什特与凯伦德的旅人则可在村中商队旅舍歇脚。

english: Has is a mountainous region around the Drin and White Drin, between the country of Gjakova and the highlands of northern Albania. Its villages lie around Mount Pashtrik and the valleys that drain toward the two rivers. The name derives from the Ottoman term for a revenue estate reserved to a high official or the ruler. A document of 1570 refers to the area as a hass; sixteenth-century records also use the name Shullan.
simp_chinese: 哈斯是德林河与白德林河附近的山地地区，位于贾科瓦一带与阿尔巴尼亚北部高地之间。村落散布在帕什特里克山及流向两条河流的谷地周围。地名源自奥斯曼语中属于统治者或高级官员的税收领地之称。1570年的文书已将此地称为哈斯，十六世纪记载中也使用舒兰这一名称。

english: At Hasakah the Jaghjagh joins the Khabur, bringing water south from the hills towards the Euphrates. The junction lies in the broad plains of the Jazira, where ancient settlement mounds rise above the river country and grazing lands extend beyond it. Arab and Kurdish tribes moved seasonally through this region, following pastures between the plains and the Taurus Mountains. The meeting of the two streams marked a natural place of passage in the Khabur basin.
simp_chinese: 在哈塞克，贾格贾格河汇入哈布尔河，河水由北面的山地向南流往幼发拉底河。两河交汇处位于杰济拉的广阔平原，古代聚落遗址丘高出河岸，牧场则向更远处延伸。阿拉伯和库尔德部族曾随季节在这里迁徙，往来平原与托罗斯山脉的牧地。两条河流交汇的地方，是哈布尔流域的一处天然通道。

english:
Hasankale overlooks the plain east of Erzurum from a steep spur of Hasan Dağı. Its inner and outer walls guarded the settlement below, and a concealed passage led down to the stream to supply water during a siege. The fortress was built in the fourteenth century by Hasan Bey, a direct descendant of the Ilkhanid commander Hacı Toğay, and gave its name to the town.

The Ottomans established an important frontier district centred here after taking the region from the Safavids. Sultan Süleyman repaired the old fortress and added a mosque, while Murad IV had a pavilion built during his campaign towards Erivan in 1634. Russian occupation in 1829 damaged the town before the Treaty of Adrianople returned it to Ottoman control.
simp_chinese:
哈桑卡莱建在哈桑山的陡峭山嘴上，俯瞰埃尔祖鲁姆以东的平原。内外城墙守护下方的聚落，一条隐蔽通道通往溪流，以便围城时取水。堡垒由伊儿汗国将领哈哲·托阿伊的后裔哈桑贝伊于十四世纪修建，并使城镇得名。

奥斯曼人从萨法维手中取得这一地区后，以此为中心设立边疆行政区。苏丹苏莱曼修缮堡垒并增建清真寺；穆拉德四世于1634年前往埃里温的战役中在堡内建造亭阁。1829年俄军占领使城镇受损，随后《亚得里亚堡条约》将其归还奥斯曼帝国。

english:
Hasankeyf occupies a striking position on the Tigris, where a citadel rises above cliffs honeycombed with caves. Known in Arabic as Hisn Kayfa, the Rock Fortress, it flourished under the Artuqids and Ayyubids. Their palaces and mosques overlooked a great bridge that carried traffic across the river. The bridge and the fortified heights made the town an important crossing between the lands north and south of the Tigris.

The Ilkhanid Mongols plundered Hasankeyf in 1260, but the Ayyubid rulers continued to hold it through much of the later Middle Ages. In 1462 Uzun Hasan of the Aq Qoyunlu captured the town after a long siege. His son Zeynel Bey died fighting the Ottomans at Otlukbeli in 1473; a cylindrical brick mausoleum, decorated with turquoise and dark blue tiles and inscriptions in geometric Kufic script, was built for him on the opposite bank. Its design drew on the funerary architecture of Azerbaijan and Central Asia. Repairs to the old bridge also date from the Aq Qoyunlu period.

Ottoman power reached Hasankeyf after the victory at Chaldiran, and the town entered the empire in 1515. Its local dynasty retained authority for a time before its emirate ended in 1524. The castle, river crossing and monumental tombs reflected a long history in which local lords and greater powers contested control of the upper Tigris.
simp_chinese:
哈桑凯伊夫坐落在底格里斯河畔，城堡高踞岩崖，崖壁上遍布洞穴，地势十分醒目。阿拉伯语中的希森凯法意为“岩石堡垒”；城镇在阿尔图克和阿尤布王朝时期繁盛。宫殿与清真寺俯瞰一座横跨底格里斯河的大桥，桥梁和高处城防使这里成为沟通河流南北的重要渡口。

一二六〇年，伊儿汗国蒙古人劫掠哈桑凯伊夫，但阿尤布王朝的地方统治者在此后中世纪大部分时间里仍保有此地。一四六二年，白羊王朝的乌尊·哈桑经过长期围攻夺取城镇。他的儿子宰因勒贝伊于一四七三年在奥特卢克贝利与奥斯曼人交战时阵亡；人们在对岸为他建造圆柱形砖墓，以青绿和深蓝釉砖及几何式库法体铭文装饰，其形制受到阿塞拜疆和中亚陵墓建筑的影响。旧桥的修缮也可追溯至白羊王朝时期。

恰尔迪兰战役后，奥斯曼势力抵达哈桑凯伊夫，城镇于一五一五年归入帝国。地方王朝一度保有权力，直至其埃米尔国在一五二四年终结。城堡、渡口和纪念性陵墓，共同反映了地方领主与大国长期争夺底格里斯河上游的历史。

english: Hasar lies in the Argun valley near the ancient walled city of Heishantou. The site has an outer enclosure with gates and an inner rectangular precinct, a substantial built centre amid the grasslands and river wetlands. Archaeologists have suggested that it belonged to the family of Jöchi Qasar, brother of Chinggis Khan, whose descendants held lands in the region. The walls preserve evidence of a settled centre in a landscape also used by mobile pastoral communities.
simp_chinese: 哈萨尔位于额尔古纳河谷，靠近黑山头古城。遗址有带城门的外城和长方形内城，是草原与河流湿地之间一处规模可观的建筑中心。考古学者推测它可能由成吉思汗之弟拙赤合撒儿家族建造，该家族后代在这一地区拥有封地。城墙保存了固定聚落的痕迹，周围地区同时也是游牧社群活动的地方。

english: Hashjin lies east of the Qezel Uzan in the mountain country of Khalkhal. The river cuts a deep valley through the ranges before joining the Shahrud and becoming the Safidrud on its way to the Caspian. Villages cling to the surrounding slopes, with small fields and pastures between the ridges. The settlement belongs to a district whose communities maintained ties with the mountains of Talesh to the east.
simp_chinese: 哈沙特金位于哈尔哈尔山区、克孜尔乌赞河以东。河流切穿山脉形成深谷，随后与沙赫鲁德河汇合，成为流向里海的萨菲德河。村庄依山坡而建，小块田地和牧场分布在山脊之间。当地社群与东面的塔雷什山地保持着联系。

english: Hashtrud lies east of the Sahand massif in a country of hills and river valleys. The Qaranquchay drains the district toward the Qezel Uzan, gathering streams from the mountain slopes. Nearby stands the ancient fortress of Zahhak, set on a steep height above the river. Its surviving remains include structures from the Parthian period, a reminder of the long history of settlement and defence in these uplands.
simp_chinese: 哈什特鲁德位于萨汉德山地以东的丘陵与河谷之间。卡兰古恰伊河汇集山坡溪流，将当地水源带向克孜尔乌赞河。附近的古代扎哈克堡垒坐落在河上方的陡峭高地，现存遗迹包括安息时期的建筑，见证了这片高地悠久的定居与防御历史。

english: Haskaont is a Wendat name associated with Georgina Island in the southern part of Lake Simcoe. The lake lies on a route between Lake Ontario and Georgian Bay, through a country inhabited by Wendat peoples and their neighbours. At the narrows to the north, fishing weirs guided fish into openings where nets could be set. Samuel de Champlain saw the great fishery there in 1615 while travelling through the region with Indigenous companions.
simp_chinese: 哈斯卡翁特是与锡姆科湖南部乔治娜岛相关的温达特地名。湖泊位于安大略湖与乔治亚湾之间的路线之上，周围是温达特人及邻族生活的地区。湖泊北面的狭窄水道设有捕鱼堰，将鱼引向可以张网的缺口。1615年，萨缪尔·德·尚普兰与原住民同伴穿行当地时，见到了这处规模巨大的渔场。

english:
Haskovo lies on a plain below the northern foothills of the Rhodopes. Known to the Ottomans as Hasköy, it developed into a town of craftsmen and traders along the road through Thrace. Its Old Mosque, founded in 1394–1395, is among the early surviving Ottoman religious buildings in the region; an endowment once supported a bathhouse as well as the mosque.

Ottoman records describe Hasköy as a growing settlement with several neighbourhoods in the sixteenth century. Nearby Uzundzhovo became a notable gathering place for merchants. In 1592 Grand Vizier Sinan Pasha endowed a substantial complex there, including a mosque and caravanserai where travellers could lodge with their animals. The great fair held near the complex drew trade to the district and linked Haskovo's workshops and markets with a wider world of exchange.
simp_chinese:
哈斯科沃位于罗多彼山北麓的平原上。奥斯曼人称其为哈斯柯伊，它发展为色雷斯道路上一座工匠与商人聚居的城镇。当地老清真寺建于1394至1395年，是地区内早期留存的奥斯曼宗教建筑之一；基金曾同时供养清真寺和浴场。

十六世纪的奥斯曼文献记载，哈斯柯伊是一座不断发展的聚落，拥有多个街区。附近的乌尊朱沃则成为商人重要的聚集地。1592年，大维齐尔锡南帕夏在那里捐建一座规模宏大的建筑群，包括清真寺和可供旅人及牲畜歇宿的商队旅舍。建筑群附近举办的盛大集市将贸易吸引到这一地区，也把哈斯科沃的作坊与市场同更广阔的交换网络连接起来。

sources.title: Muslim Historic Sites in Bulgaria FINAL Web-3.11.10.pdf

english: Hassan takes its name from the goddess Hasanamba, whose shrine stands at the heart of the town. Local tradition tells of seven mother goddesses who came to the region, several making their home at Hassan. The town lies in the country of the Hoysalas, whose former capitals at Belur and Dvarasamudra are renowned for temples carved in stone. In later centuries the surrounding land was contested by the Keladi Nayakas and the rulers of Mysore.
simp_chinese: 哈桑因城中供奉的女神哈桑安巴得名。当地传说讲述七位母神来到此地，其中数位在哈桑安家。城镇位于曷萨拉王朝的故地，附近旧都贝卢鲁和德瓦拉萨穆德拉以石雕神庙闻名。后来的世纪里，凯拉迪那耶迦与迈索尔统治者争夺周边土地。

english:
Hasselt stands near the Demer, between the Campine and the fertile Hesbaye. First named in a document in 1165, it became one of the free towns of the County of Loon. In 1232 Count Arnold IV granted it liberties like those of Liège. The counts moved their court from Loon to nearby Kuringen, where Herkenrode Abbey was founded, and Hasselt grew into the county's largest town.

In 1366 Loon came under the direct authority of the prince-bishops of Liège. Hasselt remained one of the bishopric's “good towns,” retaining its place in the county until French annexation in 1794. After Napoleon's defeat, it became part of the United Kingdom of the Netherlands. Its position between the sandy Campine and the agricultural lands to the south helped make it a local center within Loon.
simp_chinese:
哈瑟尔特位于代默尔河附近，介于坎皮讷地区和肥沃的埃斯拜之间。1165年文书首次提及此地，它后来成为隆伯国的自由城镇之一。1232年，阿诺德四世伯爵授予它与列日相同的自由权。伯爵将宫廷从隆迁至附近的库林根，并在那里建立赫肯罗德修道院；哈瑟尔特逐渐发展为伯国最大的城镇。

1366年，隆归列日亲王主教直接统治。哈瑟尔特仍是主教辖区的“良城”之一，在伯国内保持地位，直到1794年被法国吞并。拿破仑战败后，它归入尼德兰联合王国。城市位于沙质坎皮讷与南方农业地区之间，这一位置使它成为隆地区的地方中心。

english:
Haßfurt stood on the Main under the prince-bishops of Würzburg, but its citizens repeatedly sought greater freedom. Bishop Gerhard of Schwarzburg granted an annual market in 1373, established a mint and began the present parish church in 1390. During the Franconian towns' conflict, Haßfurt resisted a seven-week episcopal siege in 1399. The towns' defeat at Bergtheim nevertheless restored Würzburg's authority.

The town's buildings recorded both civic ambition and noble patronage. Its market-square town hall was built in 1514–1516. Outside the walls, the Ritterkapelle rose between 1431 and its consecration in 1465; a long frieze of heraldic shields displayed the families associated with the sanctuary. Prince-Bishop Julius Echter had its nave vaulted in 1603–1605. War later struck the river crossing: Swedish troops burned the Main bridge in 1632. The eighteenth century brought a Rococo remodelling of the town hall, while the Napoleonic settlement changed the ruler above it. Haßfurt entered the Grand Duchy of Würzburg in 1806 and passed to the Kingdom of Bavaria in 1814.
simp_chinese:
哈斯富特位于美因河畔，受维尔茨堡采邑主教统治，市民却曾多次争取更大自由。施瓦茨堡的格哈德主教在1373年授予年度集市权，设立铸币所，并于1390年动工修建现存堂区教堂。1399年法兰克尼亚城镇同主教交战时，哈斯富特抵住七周围攻；城镇联盟随后在贝格特海姆战败，维尔茨堡重新确立统治。

市内建筑体现着市民抱负与贵族赞助。集市广场的市政厅建于1514至1516年。城外骑士礼拜堂于1431年开工、1465年祝圣，唱诗班席外檐的长列纹章展示了相关家族。尤利乌斯·埃希特主教于1603至1605年为中殿增筑拱顶。战火后来波及渡河要道，瑞典军队于1632年烧毁美因河桥。十八世纪，市政厅局部改建为洛可可风格；拿破仑时代则改变城市归属：1806年划入维尔茨堡大公国，1814年转归巴伐利亚王国。

english: Hastings is a Sussex coastal town whose castle overlooks the English Channel. One of the Cinque Ports, it owed ships to the Crown and took part in the maritime defence of England. The town's fortunes were vulnerable both to the sea and to warfare across the Channel. In 1337 Hastings contributed ten ships to a fleet assembled at Sandwich. Yet coastal erosion and storms damaged the port and its castle, while French raids brought further destruction. Hastings was attacked and burned in 1339 and again in 1377, during the Hundred Years' War. Once an important member of the port confederation, it declined as a harbour after these repeated blows.
simp_chinese: 黑斯廷斯是萨塞克斯海岸城镇，城堡俯瞰英吉利海峡。作为五港同盟成员，它有义务向王室提供船只，参与英格兰的海上防御。城镇的命运既受到海浪影响，也受到海峡对岸战争的威胁。1337年，黑斯廷斯为集结在桑威奇的舰队提供了十艘船。然而海岸侵蚀和风暴破坏了港口及城堡，法国人的袭击又带来进一步损失。百年战争期间，黑斯廷斯于1339年和1377年两次遭袭并被焚毁。接连的打击使这座曾经重要的同盟港口逐渐衰落。

english: The Hastings River reaches the Pacific on the eastern coast of Australia, opening through a coastal landscape of beaches and headlands. This is country long known to the Birpai people. In 1818 John Oxley travelled to the river mouth and named it the Hastings during his exploration of the coast.
simp_chinese: 黑斯廷斯河在澳大利亚东海岸注入太平洋，河口附近分布着沙滩与岬角。这里是比尔派人长期熟悉的土地。1818年约翰·奥克斯利考察海岸时来到河口，将河流命名为黑斯廷斯。

english:
Hata is the far southwestern corner of Tosa, the basin of the Shimanto River around Nakamura. It had belonged to the Ichijo house, one of the five regent families of Kyoto, as the estate of Hata since Kamakura times. In 1468, with the capital in flames in the Onin War and the rents not arriving, the former regent Ichijo Norifusa came down from Nara to manage the estate in person, with nobles, warriors and craftsmen in his train, and made his residence at Nakamura.

His son Fusaie, born in Tosa, never returned to Kyoto; he laid out Nakamura on the pattern of the capital and rose to the rank of provisional Major Counsellor in 1516. The Tosa Ichijo became first among the seven lords of the province, with Hata assessed at 16,000 kan, but fell in the 1570s: Chosokabe Motochika drove Kanesada from Hata, and in 1575 Kanesada's attempt to return from Bungo was crushed in the battle of the Shimanto River. After the Yamauchi took Tosa, Yasutoyo received Hata at twenty thousand koku and founded the Nakamura Yamauchi line. In 1724 Yamazaki Iekatsu began a reservoir at Tanokawa, completed by his son Ienaga.
simp_chinese:
幡多是土佐国最西南的一角，以中村为中心的四万十川流域。镰仓时代以来，这里一直是京都五摄家之一一条家的庄园。1468年，京城在应仁之乱中陷入战火，年贡也送不到，前关白一条教房从奈良来到土佐，亲自经营庄园，随行的有公家、武士和工匠，他把居所设在中村。

教房之子房家生于土佐，一生没有回到京都；他仿照京都的格局建设中村，永正十三年（1516年）上京时升任权大纳言。土佐一条氏成为土佐七雄之首，幡多一带的领地约一万六千贯，但在16世纪70年代覆灭：长宗我部元亲把兼定逐出幡多，1575年兼定借丰后之力反攻，在四万十川之战中败北。山内氏入主土佐后，山内康豊获得幡多二万石，立中村山内家。享保九年（1724年），山崎家胜开始修筑田野川的灌溉蓄水池，由其子家永完成。

english:
The Hatam are one of the peoples associated with the Arfak Mountains of western New Guinea. Their language is distinct from those of neighbouring communities, while their homelands span mountain and lower-lying country on the Bird's Head Peninsula.

Arfak communities have traditionally combined shifting cultivation with hunting and gathering in the forest. Paths link settlements across the steep terrain, and the coastal areas beyond the mountains have long connected western New Guinea with the islands of eastern Indonesia. Local life and languages developed within this varied landscape.
simp_chinese:
哈塔姆人是与新几内亚西部阿尔法克山地相关的族群之一。他们的语言不同于邻近社群的语言，家园分布在鸟首半岛的山地及较低地带。

阿尔法克地区的社群传统上结合轮耕、狩猎和森林采集维持生活。山径穿过陡峭地形，将聚落连接起来；山地之外的沿海地区则长期使新几内亚西部与印度尼西亚东部诸岛相通。当地的生活与语言在这一多样景观中发展。

english:
The Hatchie winds from northern Mississippi across western Tennessee to the Mississippi River. Its slow course passes through wooded floodplains, swamps and bends cut off from the main channel. The river retains a Chickasaw name, recalling the people who claimed and used the country before American settlement spread west of the Tennessee River.

In 1818 the Chickasaw ceded their claim to this region to the United States. Settlers established Hatchie Town beside the river, where it became a temporary county seat in 1823. A new town was laid out farther south and named Bolivar, after the South American liberator. A ferry crossed the broad river bottoms, while boats carried goods along the Hatchie toward the Mississippi. The river continued to serve the settlement as a route for trade.
simp_chinese:
哈奇河从密西西比北部蜿蜒穿过田纳西西部，汇入密西西比河。缓慢的河水流经森林覆盖的泛滥平原、沼泽和与主河道隔开的旧河弯。河流保留着奇克索人的名字，使人想起美国移民越过田纳西河之前在此活动并主张土地权利的民族。

1818年，奇克索人将这一地区的土地权利割让给美国。移民在河畔建立哈奇镇，1823年它成为临时县治。后来，居民在更南面规划新镇，以南美解放者玻利瓦尔命名。渡船穿过宽阔的河滩，船只则沿哈奇河运送货物，驶向密西西比河。河流仍是聚落开展贸易的通道。

english: Hațeg lies in a basin surrounded by the Southern Carpathians, at the centre of a district of Romanian communities and noble families. A royal castle guarded the approaches to the basin, and its castellan represented the voivode of Transylvania. A district of Hațeg is recorded in the fourteenth century, when assemblies of local knezes dealt with disputes and obligations. The small town and its surrounding villages preserved institutions rooted in this mountain country while forming part of the Kingdom of Hungary.
simp_chinese: 哈采格位于南喀尔巴阡山环绕的盆地中，是罗马尼亚社区和贵族家族所在地区的中心。王室城堡守卫盆地入口，城堡长官代表特兰西瓦尼亚总督。十四世纪已有哈采格地区的记载，当地克涅兹的集会处理争端和义务。小镇与周围村庄属于匈牙利王国，同时保留了扎根于这片山地的地方制度。

english: On the Pierian plain between Mount Olympus and the Thermaic Gulf, the name Hatera appears in old accounts of a settlement near the later town of Katerini. Under Ottoman rule Katerini was a modest community, but it also served as the seat of a judge: a decree of 1686 addressed its official alongside those of neighboring towns. In 1806 the traveler William Leake counted about a hundred houses, while the surrounding plain supported cultivation of wheat.
simp_chinese: 在奥林匹斯山与塞尔迈湾之间的皮埃里亚平原上，古老记载提到一个名为哈泰拉的聚落，位于后来卡泰里尼一带。奥斯曼统治时期，卡泰里尼规模不大，却也是法官的驻地：1686年的一份敕令便将这里的官员与邻近城镇的法官一同列出。1806年，旅行者威廉·利克记下约一百座房屋，周围平原则种植小麦。

english:
Haterk lies in the wooded mountains above the Tartar River, in the historic lands of Khachen. It was the centre of an Armenian principality whose lords held a series of fortresses and supported monasteries in the surrounding valleys. Prince Vakhtang's court sheltered the scholar Mkhitar Gosh, while the family helped build the monastery of Nor Getik beyond its own lands.

In the fifteenth century the region suffered under the campaigns of the Qara Qoyunlu and Aq Qoyunlu, and Haterk was destroyed. Its inhabitants established a settlement nearby in the following century, carrying the old name into a new village among the mountains. Old churches, carved cross-stones and ruined settlements in the surrounding hills recall the earlier community and its princely patrons.
simp_chinese:
哈泰尔克位于塔尔塔尔河上方的林木山区，属于历史上的哈琴地区。它曾是一个亚美尼亚公国的中心，领主们掌握着一系列堡垒，并资助周围河谷的修道院。瓦赫坦亲王的宫廷接待过学者姆希塔尔·戈什，家族还帮助在领地之外修建了诺尔盖提克修道院。

十五世纪，黑羊和白羊诸部的征战使这一地区受创，哈泰尔克遭到摧毁。居民于次世纪在附近建立了新聚落，将旧名带到了山中的新村庄。周围山中的古老教堂、雕刻十字石碑和村庄遗址，仍使人想起昔日的社区及其诸侯赞助者。

english: At the northern end of the Labrador Peninsula, steep mountains descend towards a coast cut by deep fjords. Ice and fog shape the shores where the Labrador Sea meets this rocky country. The Torngat Mountains are part of an Inuit homeland, and their valleys connect the waters of Ungava Bay with the eastern coast. Inuit travellers have used the Kuururjuaq valley as a route between the two shores for thousands of years.
simp_chinese: 拉布拉多半岛北端，陡峭山地伸向被深邃峡湾切割的海岸。冰雪和海雾影响着拉布拉多海与岩石陆地交接的岸边。托恩加特山脉是因纽特人故土的一部分，山谷连接昂加瓦湾和东部海岸。数千年来，因纽特旅人一直利用库鲁尔茹阿克谷地往返两岸。

english: Hatteras lies among the low barrier islands that shelter the sounds of the Carolina coast from the Atlantic. The Algonquian-speaking people known to the English as Croatoan lived on these islands when Raleigh's expeditions arrived in the 1580s. John Lawson later described the Hatteras Indians and a settlement on the sound side of the island. By the early eighteenth century the population of this village had fallen sharply.
simp_chinese: 哈特拉斯位于低平的障壁岛之间，这些岛屿将卡罗来纳沿岸的潟湾与大西洋隔开。十六世纪八十年代罗利派来的远征队抵达时，英国人称为克罗阿托安的阿尔冈昆语族人居住在岛上。约翰·劳森后来记述了哈特拉斯人，以及岛屿面向潟湾一侧的一处聚落。到十八世纪初，村庄的人口已经大幅减少。

english:
Hattfjelldal is an inland valley in Nordland. Its name comes from the old Hattfjelldalen farm, recorded as Hatfieldalen in 1723. The farm in turn took its name from Hattfjellet, the distinctive mountain whose name means “hat mountain”. The place-name preserves the relationship between a particular farm, the surrounding valley and a conspicuous landmark.

An early chapel was built here in the 1720s. In 1788 it was replaced by a larger chapel, the building that served the settlement through the closing decades of the eighteenth century and the early nineteenth century. This predecessor should be distinguished from the present wooden church, which belongs to the later nineteenth century. The succession of chapels gives Hattfjelldal a concrete local chronology within the wider religious history of inland Helgeland.
simp_chinese:
哈特菲耶尔达尔是诺尔兰的内陆河谷，名称来自旧哈特菲耶尔达伦农庄，1723年的记录将其写作Hatfieldalen。农庄又得名于形状鲜明的哈特山，山名意为“帽子山”。这一地名将一座具体农庄、周围山谷与醒目的地标联系起来。

十八世纪二十年代，这里修建了一座早期小教堂。1788年，一座更大的小教堂取代旧建筑，在十八世纪末及十九世纪初服务当地居民。这座前身建筑与十九世纪后期修建的现存木教堂应当区分。几代教堂的更替，为海尔格兰内陆的宗教生活留下了具体的地方年代线索。

english: Hatthigiripura, the city of Elephant Rock, takes its name from the great rocky outcrop above Kurunegala in Sri Lanka’s interior. The hill is known as Ethagala because its shape resembles an elephant. The rocky heights offered a striking setting for a royal centre in the period when Sri Lanka’s capitals moved between fortified inland sites. Nearby Kurunegala became a seat of kings after the brief royal occupation of Yapahuwa, and the country around the rock formed part of that changing political landscape.
simp_chinese: 哈提吉利普拉意为象岩之城，得名于斯里兰卡内陆库鲁内格勒上方的巨大岩丘。岩丘因形似大象而称为埃塔加拉。在斯里兰卡都城于内陆设防地点之间迁移的时期，这片岩石高地为王权中心提供了醒目的地理背景。王室短暂驻于雅帕胡瓦之后，附近的库鲁内格勒成为国王驻地，象岩周围的土地也处在不断变化的政治格局之中。

english:
Hatun Kañar is the highland country of the Cañari, home to the great stone complex of Ingapirca. Standing above a cold Andean basin, its best-known structure is an oval platform of carefully fitted masonry, often called the Temple of the Sun. Nearby are plazas, rooms and a Cañari burial marked by a standing stone, evidence of an older sacred landscape.

The Incas built at Ingapirca after extending their authority into Cañari lands. They incorporated the place into the Qhapaq Ñan, the great Andean road network, and gave it religious, political and administrative importance. The finely worked platform and trapezoidal doorways reveal the imperial building tradition, while the earlier burial and local remains recall the Cañari communities who inhabited the region before the Inca arrival. Together the structures preserve the meeting of two Andean traditions on a high plateau.
simp_chinese:
哈通卡尼亚尔是卡尼亚里人的高地家园，宏大的因加皮尔卡石建筑群便位于这里。建筑群俯瞰寒冷的安第斯盆地，其中最著名的是一座由精密石砌围墙环绕的椭圆形台基，常被称作太阳神庙。附近还有广场、房舍和以立石标记的卡尼亚里墓葬，见证着更早的神圣景观。

印加人将势力扩展到卡尼亚里土地后，在因加皮尔卡修建建筑。他们把这里纳入安第斯大道卡帕克尼扬，使其成为宗教、政治和行政中心。精工石砌台基与梯形门道体现了帝国的建筑传统，而更早的墓葬和当地遗物则让人想起印加人到来之前居住在此的卡尼亚里社群。两种安第斯传统在这片高原留下了共同的印记。

english:
Hatun Killaka was the principal place of the Killaka political grouping south of Lake Poopó in the Bolivian highlands. Killaka authority belonged to a federation that also included Asanaqi and other neighboring peoples. Its leaders exercised influence through communities and territories spread across the plateau and beyond it, rather than through a compact town alone. Relations with the Inca state incorporated these local hierarchies into a larger imperial order.

Under Spanish government, the settlement was reorganized as a reducción, a town intended to concentrate a previously dispersed population, and received the name Oropesa de Quillacas. During much of the colonial period it was nevertheless known as Hatun Quillacas. The wider Repartimiento de Quillacas y Asanaques included Condo, the Asanaqi centre, illustrating the continued layering of local and colonial jurisdictions. Rule depended on relations between hereditary authorities and their subjects, and these relations could break down violently. In 1774 subjects killed Asanaqi leaders of the Llanquipacha family; the weakened institution declined afterward. Hatun Killaka's history was thus intertwined with neighboring communities whose political ties were reshaped under successive empires.
simp_chinese:
哈通基利亚卡是玻利维亚高地波波湖南面的基利亚卡政治群体的主要中心。其权威属于一个还包括阿萨纳基等邻近群体的联盟。领袖通过分布于高原及周边的社群和土地行使影响，政治基础超出单一城镇。与印加国家的关系，又将这些地方等级纳入更大的帝国秩序。

西班牙统治下，聚落被重新组织为集中分散人口的归并村，获名奥罗佩萨·德基利亚卡斯；但殖民时期的大部分岁月里，仍以哈通基利亚卡斯之名出现。较大的基利亚卡斯—阿萨纳克斯辖区也包括阿萨纳基中心孔多，体现地方权威与殖民管辖的层层叠合。世袭首领同属民的关系维持统治，也可能剧烈破裂。1774年，阿萨纳基的利安基帕查家族领袖遭属民杀害，此后已经削弱的制度继续衰落。哈通基利亚卡的历史因此与邻近社群相互交织，其政治联系不断受到前后帝国统治的重塑。

english:
Hatun Xauxa stood in the northern Mantaro valley, an important Inca provincial centre near the later city of Jauja. Its broad extent and substantial population made it a major place of administration and ceremony. Communities from other parts of the empire, including Yauyos settlers, lived there, and ceremonies honoured sacred powers such as Pariacaca. The fertile valley and the roads through the central Andes gave the settlement a prominent place in the Inca realm.

In 1533 Hernando Pizarro reached Hatun Xauxa during the Spanish conquest. The following year Francisco Pizarro established Santa Fe de Hatun Xauxa as the first capital of his new Spanish government. Plots were assigned around the main square for a church, a Dominican house and Spanish settlers. The capital was soon moved to Lima on the coast, but Jauja remained an important town in the Mantaro valley. Its history joins the imperial centre of the Incas with the early years of Spanish rule.
simp_chinese:
哈通豪哈坐落在曼塔罗河谷北部，是邻近后来豪哈城的重要印加省级中心。这里范围广阔，人口众多，是行政和礼仪活动的重要场所。来自帝国其他地区的社群，包括雅乌约斯移民，居住于此；人们举行仪式，敬奉帕里亚卡卡等神圣力量。肥沃的河谷和贯穿安第斯中部的道路，使这座聚落在印加领地中地位显著。

1533年西班牙征服期间，埃尔南多·皮萨罗抵达哈通豪哈。次年，弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗建立圣菲德哈通豪哈，作为新西班牙政权的第一个首府。主广场周围为教堂、多明我会和西班牙定居者划分地块。首府很快迁往海岸的利马，但豪哈仍是曼塔罗河谷的重要城镇，其历史连接着印加帝国中心与西班牙统治初期。

english:
Hatunllacta, “great town,” is a name associated in early Spanish records with the country of Pasto in the northern Andean highlands. The valley below Galeras volcano was inhabited by Indigenous peoples including the Quillacinga, while the Pastos lived farther south. The highland landscape of fields and mountains connected communities across the region before the arrival of Spanish expeditions.

In the 1530s expeditions led by Sebastián de Belalcázar entered the area and established a Spanish settlement known as Villaviciosa or Pasto. Documents from 1537 refer to Villaviciosa de Hatunllacta. The town grew in a country already occupied and named by Indigenous peoples, whose communities faced the demands of the new colonial authorities.
simp_chinese:
哈通亚克塔意为“大城镇”，早期西班牙文献将这一名称与北安第斯高地的帕斯托地区联系起来。加莱拉斯火山下的谷地居住着基亚辛加等原住民，帕斯托人则住在更南方。西班牙远征队到来之前，农田和群山构成的高地景观已连接着各地社群。

1530年代，塞瓦斯蒂安·德贝拉尔卡萨率领的远征进入当地，建立称为比利亚维西奥萨或帕斯托的西班牙聚落。1537年文书提到哈通亚克塔的比利亚维西奥萨。城镇在原住民早已居住并命名的地区发展，其社群随后面对新的殖民当局的要求。

english:
Hatunqulla, “great Colla” in Quechua, was the home of the Colla lords on the plateau northwest of Lake Titicaca, close to the funerary towers of Sillustani. The Colla claimed descent from Tiwanaku and may have spoken Puquina; their chiefdom of some 20,000 square kilometres was one of the greatest of the altiplano. After Tiwanaku vanished around 1000, wars between chiefdoms, probably worsened by drought, drove the people into hill forts called pukaras, which became common after 1300. The Colla chiefs held the Titicaca islands, including the Island of the Sun, and the silver and gold mines of Potosí and Carabaya.

The Colla rivalled the Lupaqa to the south. When Inca Viracocha secretly allied with the Lupaqa lord Cari, the ruler of Hatunqulla invaded Lupaqa land and was beaten at Paucarcolla. Later, Pachacuti marched on the Collao, defeated the Colla Capac Chuchi in two battles at Ayaviri and Pucara, and took him prisoner. Pachacuti then went to Hatunqulla to receive the submission of the surrounding peoples. The conquest of the Colla gave the Inca state its imperial stature, and the south-eastern quarter of the empire, Qullasuyu, took its name from them. The Colla rose in revolt several times, and Pachacuti's son Amaru Yupanqui and later Topa Inca put the revolts down.
simp_chinese:
哈通库利亚在克丘亚语中意为“大科利亚”，是的的喀喀湖西北高原上科利亚首领们的故地，附近就是西尤斯塔尼的墓塔。科利亚人自称是蒂瓦纳库的后裔，可能说普基纳语；他们的酋邦面积约两万平方公里，是高原上最大的酋邦之一。蒂瓦纳库在约1000年消失后，各酋邦间战争不断，干旱可能使情况更糟，人们退入称为普卡拉的山寨，1300年之后这类山寨很常见。科利亚首领掌管着的的喀喀湖诸岛（包括太阳岛）以及波托西的银矿和卡拉瓦亚的金矿。

科利亚人与南面的卢帕卡人是对手。当维拉科查·印加暗中与卢帕卡领主卡里结盟时，哈通库利亚的统治者入侵卢帕卡领地，在保卡尔科利亚被击败。后来，帕查库蒂进军高原，在阿亚比里和普卡拉两战中打败科利亚首领丘奇·卡帕克并将其俘获，随后前往哈通库利亚，接受周围各族臣服。征服科利亚使印加国家有了帝国的格局，帝国东南部的科利亚苏尤也以他们得名。科利亚人屡次反叛，帕查库蒂之子阿马鲁·尤潘基和后来的图帕克·印加先后将其平定。

english:
Hatunsaray lies southwest of Konya, close to the ancient city of Lystra. The plateau preserves several layers of settlement, from rock-cut Christian buildings to the institutions established under Turkish rule. Seljuk religious lodges and hospices helped shape the settlement network, and Ottoman surveys of the sixteenth century counted Hatunsaray among the most populous subdistricts of the Konya sancak. Christian inhabitants remained in the wider area into the seventeenth century.

Water and movement gave everyday life its practical structure. Hatunsaray stood on the caravan route from Konya toward Antalya and Alanya, where streams required bridges and travellers needed stopping places. Limited water supplies encouraged storage in rock-cut cisterns, a technique inherited from earlier periods and continued under Turkish rule. Drinking water, cultivation and transport thus depended on different but connected works. The region's early modern history belongs to this inhabited corridor: religious foundations and changing communities occupied an older landscape, while roads and water management linked village needs with journeys across the Anatolian interior.
simp_chinese:
哈通萨赖位于科尼亚西南、古城利斯特拉附近。高原保存着多层聚居遗迹，从基督教岩凿建筑延续至突厥统治时期形成的机构。塞尔柱时期设立的宗教道院与旅舍参与塑造聚落网络；十六世纪奥斯曼调查中，哈通萨赖是科尼亚桑贾克人口最密集的分区之一，周围地区的基督徒社群仍延续至十七世纪。

水源与交通决定日常生活的实际条件。哈通萨赖处于科尼亚通往安塔利亚、阿拉尼亚的商队路线上，沿途溪流需要桥梁，旅客也需要停歇地点。水源有限，促使居民使用岩凿蓄水池储水，这种从早期时代继承的技术在突厥时期继续沿用。饮水、耕作与运输因此依赖彼此关联的设施。当地近世历史属于这条早已有居民的高原通道：宗教机构与变化中的社群利用旧有聚居地，而道路和水资源管理将村庄需求同安纳托利亚内陆的长途旅行联系起来。

english: Haugalandet lies on Norway's western coast, around the island of Karmøy and the sheltered Karmsund strait. Ships sailing along the coast could pass through the strait instead of facing the rough waters west of the island. At Avaldsnes, beside this important passage, Harald Fairhair and his successors maintained a royal seat associated with the early kingdom of Norway. King Håkon IV had the stone church of St Olaf built there around 1250, leaving a conspicuous landmark beside the old sailing route.
simp_chinese: 海于加兰讷位于挪威西岸，包括卡尔默岛及其东侧避风的卡尔姆海峡。沿海航行的船只可以穿过海峡，避开岛屿西侧波涛汹涌的海面。海峡边的阿瓦尔斯内斯曾是金发哈拉尔及其继承者的王室驻地，与挪威王国的早期历史密切相关。约1250年，国王哈康四世在此修建圣奥拉夫石教堂，为这条古老航道留下了一座醒目的地标。

english: Haukivesi is a broad basin in Finland's Saimaa lake system, stretching northwest from the waters around Savonlinna. Islands, wooded shores and narrow channels break up its surface, joining it to neighbouring lakes. The interconnected waters of Saimaa form an extensive inland route through Savolax, where boats could pass between settlements separated by forest and rocky ground.
simp_chinese: 豪基韦西是芬兰塞马湖水系的一片宽阔水域，从萨翁林纳附近向西北延伸。岛屿、林岸和狭窄水道分割湖面，并将它与邻湖相连。塞马相互连通的湖水构成贯穿萨沃拉克斯的广阔内陆水路，船只可以往来于被森林和岩地分隔的聚落之间。

english: The Haungtharaw flows from the Dawna Range through the hills of southeastern Burma. It joins the Hlaingbwe to form the Gyaing River, which runs west to meet the Salween near Mawlamyine. Forested slopes and valleys surround the upper river, while the lower Gyaing widens into a tidal waterway with many sandbanks. Together these rivers connect the Karen highlands with the coastal plain and the waters of the Gulf of Martaban.
simp_chinese: 杭塔鲁河发源于道纳山脉，流经缅甸东南部的丘陵。它与莱布韦河汇合形成基昂河，后者向西流，在毛淡棉附近注入萨尔温江。上游河流周围是林木覆盖的山坡与谷地，下游基昂河则扩展为有众多沙洲的潮汐水道。这些河流共同连接克伦高地、沿海平原与马达班湾。

sources.title: Mawlamyine Township Environment Assessment Report Nov2017.pdf

english: Hauraki lies around the gulf and the river plains at the foot of the Coromandel Peninsula. Its waterways connected Māori communities with Tāmaki and the wider North Island. In 1821–22 the northern leader Hongi Hika led musket-armed campaigns against groups in the region, including Ngāti Maru at Te Tōtara.
simp_chinese: 豪拉基位于科罗曼德半岛南端的海湾与河流平原一带。水道将当地毛利社群与塔马基及北岛其他地区联系起来。1821至1822年，北方首领洪吉·希卡率持火枪的军队进攻该地区的群体，包括特托塔拉的恩加蒂马鲁人。

english: Tīkapa Moana, the Hauraki Gulf, lies between the northern shores of New Zealand’s North Island and the Coromandel Peninsula. Māori communities lived around its coasts and islands. In November 1769 James Cook sailed around the peninsula into the Firth of Thames and spent two days on the Waihou River, recording the region and its people.
simp_chinese: 蒂卡帕莫阿纳，也就是豪拉基湾，位于新西兰北岛北部海岸与科罗曼德半岛之间。毛利社群居住在海湾的海岸及岛屿上。1769年11月，詹姆斯·库克绕过半岛驶入泰晤士湾，并在怀霍河停留两天，记录了当地及其居民。

english: Lake Hauroko lies among the forested mountains of southwestern New Zealand. Long and narrow, it drains through the Wairaurahiri River towards the southern coast. Its deep waters belong to the landscape of Fiordland, where steep valleys and lakes were shaped by ice and where Māori travelled through the wider southern country.
simp_chinese: 豪罗科湖位于新西兰西南部森林覆盖的群山之间。湖泊狭长，通过怀劳拉希里河向南岸排水。深湖属于峡湾地区的景观，冰川塑造了陡峭山谷与湖泊，毛利人也穿行于更广阔的南部地区。

english:
Havaiʻi, later known as Raiatea, is a high island in the Leeward Society Islands, surrounded by a reef and shared lagoon. At Opoa on its southeastern coast stands Taputapuātea, a complex of marae used for political, religious and funerary ceremonies. Its sacred pass through the reef opened onto the routes connecting Polynesian islands. Stone-paved courts and platforms marked the spaces where the living met ancestors and gods.

The rise of Taputapuātea was linked to the Tamatoa chiefly line and worship of the god ʻOro. Priests and chiefs travelled to the site from other islands, making Raiatea a centre of religious authority as well as voyaging. In 1769 James Cook and Joseph Banks visited Taputapuātea, recording its stone structures and ceremonies during the Endeavour’s Pacific voyage.
simp_chinese:
哈瓦伊后来称为赖阿特阿，是社会群岛背风群岛的一座高岛，周围有礁盘和与邻岛共用的潟湖。东南岸奥波阿的塔普塔普阿特阿由多座马拉埃组成，用于政治、宗教与葬礼仪式。神圣礁道通向连接波利尼西亚诸岛的海路。石铺庭院和台基标示着生者与祖先、神灵相会的空间。

塔普塔普阿特阿的兴盛与塔马托阿首领世系以及对神祇奥罗的崇拜相关。来自其他岛屿的祭司与首领航行至此，使赖阿特阿成为宗教权威和远航中心。1769年，詹姆斯·库克与约瑟夫·班克斯随奋进号到访，记录了石建筑与仪式。

english: A coral reef and lagoon surround Raiatea, formerly called Havaiʻi, in the Leeward Society Islands. At Opoa the sacred Taputapuātea marae stands beside the lagoon. A reef passage, Te Ava Moʻa, links the ceremonial complex to the open sea and the routes followed by Polynesian voyagers from other islands.
simp_chinese: 珊瑚礁与潟湖环绕社会群岛背风群岛的赖阿特阿，旧称哈瓦伊。奥波阿的神圣塔普塔普阿特阿马拉埃坐落在潟湖边。名为特阿瓦莫阿的礁道将礼仪建筑群与外海相连，也通向其他岛屿的波利尼西亚航行者使用的航路。

english:
Havana Bay is a deep, sheltered harbor on Cuba’s northern coast, entered through a narrow channel guarded by the fortresses of El Morro and La Punta. Its spacious inner waters made Havana a gathering place for the Spanish fleets carrying American goods across the Atlantic.

As the fleet system developed in the sixteenth century, the harbor became one of the most important in the Spanish Caribbean and its maritime trade. Fortifications rose around its entrance and shores, and a royal dockyard built ships for the Crown. In 1762 a British force besieged Havana and captured El Morro, opening the way to the city. Spain regained the port under the peace settlement of 1763 and strengthened its defenses with the great fortress of La Cabaña.
simp_chinese:
哈瓦那湾是古巴北岸一处深邃、受庇护的港湾，狭窄入口由莫罗堡和蓬塔堡守卫。宽阔的内港使哈瓦那成为运载美洲货物横渡大西洋的西班牙船队集结地。

随着十六世纪船队制度的发展，海湾成为西属加勒比地区最重要的港口和海上贸易中心之一。入口与岸边相继建起防御工事，皇家船厂也为王室造船。1762年英国军队围攻哈瓦那，攻占莫罗堡，打开了通往城市的道路。西班牙根据1763年和平协议收回港口，随后建造庞大的卡瓦尼亚堡加强防御。

english: Havasu belongs to the eastern Mojave Desert, near the Providence Mountains, known as Avi-kwe-havasu in Indigenous place-name records. The range rises above a dry country of valleys and scattered water sources. Chemehuevi, a Southern Paiute people, ranged through the Mojave between the Colorado River and mountains farther west. Their routes linked the resources and significant places of this desert landscape across considerable distances.
simp_chinese: 哈瓦苏位于莫哈韦沙漠东部、普罗维登斯山脉附近。原住民地名记录中，这座山脉称为阿维克韦哈瓦苏。山岭耸立于干燥河谷和零散水源之间。南派尤特人的一支切梅维人在莫哈韦地区活动，范围从科罗拉多河延伸到更西方的山地。他们的道路跨越广阔距离，连接沙漠中的资源与重要地点。

sources.title: WMRNP ROD Appendix C HPMP Att 5 Historic Trails Context  May 2019.pdf

english: The Havasupai, or Havsuw’ Baaja, live in the canyon country south of the Colorado River. Their homeland includes Havasu Canyon, where a perennial stream waters fields deep beneath the rim, and the Coconino Plateau above. Families traditionally divided their time between canyon gardens, intermediate terraces and winter camps on the plateau. When the Franciscan Francisco Garcés visited the Havasupai in 1776, he found them farming in the canyon. Their crops supplemented hunting and gathering across the surrounding country, and exchange with the Hopi brought tools and other goods to the community.
simp_chinese: 哈瓦苏派人，又称哈夫苏巴阿贾人，生活在科罗拉多河以南的峡谷地带。其故土包括哈瓦苏峡谷和峡谷上方的科科尼诺高原；常年溪水浇灌着深藏崖下的田地。家庭传统上在峡谷园地、中间台地和高原冬营地之间迁移。1776年，方济各会士弗朗西斯科·加尔塞斯访问哈瓦苏派人时，见到他们在峡谷内耕种。农作物补充了周边地区的狩猎与采集；与霍皮人的交换则带来了工具及其他物品。

english: Havelberg stands where the Havel approaches the Elbe, with the old town on an island below the cathedral hill. King Otto I founded a bishopric here in 946, but the early bishop's seat was destroyed during the Slavic uprising of 983. Ecclesiastical life resumed after the Wendish Crusade of 1147, and a Premonstratensian cathedral chapter was established. The cathedral was rebuilt after a fire, with work continuing until 1385. Its church and cloister rose above a town whose river position supported trade and fairs. The bishopric later came under Brandenburg's influence; after the Reformation its chapter continued in Protestant form, while the great cathedral remained a landmark above the waterways.
simp_chinese: 哈弗尔贝格位于哈弗尔河接近易北河之处，旧城坐落在大教堂山下的岛屿上。946年，国王奥托一世在此建立主教区，但早期主教驻地在983年的斯拉夫人起义中被毁。1147年文德十字军之后，教会生活重新开始，并建立了普雷蒙特雷会主教座堂参事会。大教堂在火灾后重建，工程持续至1385年。教堂和回廊俯瞰城镇，河流位置促进了贸易与集市。主教领后来受到勃兰登堡影响；宗教改革后参事会以新教形式延续，宏伟的大教堂仍高耸于水道之上。

english: Haveri is home to the Siddheshvara temple, an ornate example of Western Chalukya stone architecture. Unlike many temples of its type, its entrance faces west. Carved pillars and images of deities fill the shrine and its hall, while inscriptions preserve the gifts made by townspeople and merchants. A record of 1152 describes a grant of taxes to Siddheshvara made jointly with a body of five hundred Banajiga merchants, in the presence of the town’s learned assembly.
simp_chinese: 哈韦里拥有悉地湿伐罗神庙，是西遮娄其精美石造建筑的一例。与许多同类神庙不同，它的入口朝西。雕刻柱和神像布满神祠与大厅，铭文则保存了市民和商人的捐赠记录。1152年的一份记录记载，当地人与五百名巴纳吉加商人共同捐出部分税收供奉悉地湿伐罗，城中学者会议成员见证了这项捐赠。

english: Haverö lies in the wooded interior of northern Sweden, around Lake Havern. A medieval church stood on a peninsula on the lake's northern shore, serving a parish whose history reaches back many centuries. Around the turn of the seventeenth century, Forest Finns began to settle in the district, particularly near Byberget and Snöberg. The forests, lakes and waterways of the parish formed part of a border country between the Swedish and Norwegian realms.
simp_chinese: 哈韦勒位于瑞典北部森林内陆，环绕哈弗恩湖。湖泊北岸的一处半岛上曾矗立着中世纪教堂，为历史悠久的教区居民服务。十六世纪末至十七世纪初，森林芬兰人开始迁入这一带，尤以比贝里耶和斯讷贝里附近为多。教区的森林、湖泊与水道构成了瑞典和挪威两国之间边地的一部分。

english:
The waters off Havre-Aubert surround the southern part of the Magdalen Islands in the Gulf of Saint Lawrence. Along the narrow shore of La Grave, Indigenous visitors from the mainland and Basque, Breton and Norman fishermen worked during the sixteenth century. The sandy and gravelly beach provided ground on which crews could dry their catches. Seasonal fishing connected these small shores with distant Atlantic ports before a permanent island community developed.

In 1762 Richard Gridley, formerly an officer and military engineer in British service, established a fishing and walrus-hunting enterprise with Acadian and Canadian families. They formed the first lasting settlement of the archipelago, probably living on Havre-Aubert while hunting farther northeast around Grosse-Île and Old Harry. Gridley operated the undertaking until 1765. Further refugees from the Acadian deportation enlarged the settled population. The surrounding sea supported both visiting crews and resident households, while the work of catching, drying and transporting marine products linked the island with outside suppliers and markets. Havre-Aubert's maritime history therefore developed around an identifiable working shore within the gulf.
simp_chinese:
奥贝尔港外海环绕圣劳伦斯湾马德莱娜群岛的南部。十六世纪，来自大陆的原住民访客，以及巴斯克、布列塔尼和诺曼底渔民，已在拉格拉夫狭窄岸边活动。砂砾滩为船员提供晾晒渔获的场地。在岛上形成永久社群以前，季节捕鱼便已将这些小片海岸同遥远的大西洋港口连接起来。

1762年，曾在英国军队任军官和军事工程师的理查德·格里德利，带领阿卡迪亚及加拿大人家庭建立捕鱼、猎捕海象的企业。他们构成群岛最早持久的定居社群，可能住在奥贝尔港岛，而向东北的格罗斯岛、老哈里一带出猎。格里德利经营至1765年，后来又有阿卡迪亚驱逐事件的难民到来，扩大居民群体。周围海洋同时支持来访船员和常住家庭；捕捞、晾晒与运送海产，将岛屿接入外部补给与市场。当地海上历史由此围绕海湾中一处具体的劳动岸线发展。

english: Hawaastatkiicu is a name for the Washita River of the southern Great Plains, flowing toward the Red River through present-day Oklahoma. Its valley preserves evidence of villages flourishing between about 1250 and 1450, a period archaeologists call the Washita River phase. Settlements commonly contained five to twenty houses, with storage pits, hearths, refuse deposits and burial areas. Excavated houses included rectangular buildings made with upright posts and wattle-and-daub walls. The river therefore belonged to an inhabited farming landscape well before nineteenth-century military expeditions. In 1834 Captain James Dean's infantry cleared a road from Fort Towson toward the river's mouth and established Camp Washita as a forward base for the Dodge-Leavenworth expedition. George Catlin travelled with the advance party, while disease disabled many soldiers and animals at the camp. The valley's long history combines Indigenous settlement with the later movement of American forces into a region whose waterways already had established names and uses.
simp_chinese: 哈瓦斯塔特基库是南部大平原沃希托河的一种名称，河流穿过今俄克拉何马州，流向红河。河谷保存着约1250至1450年间繁盛村落的遗迹，考古学将这一阶段称为沃希托河期。聚落通常有五至二十所房屋，另有储藏坑、炉灶、废弃物堆积和墓地。发掘发现的长方形住宅，以直立木柱和编枝抹泥墙构成。因此，远在十九世纪军事探险到来以前，河流已经属于有人居住的农业景观。1834年，詹姆斯·迪恩上尉的步兵从陶森堡向河口清理道路，建立沃希托营，作为道奇－莱文沃思远征的前进基地。画家乔治·卡特林随先遣队同行，疾病则使营中许多士兵和牲畜失去行动能力。原住民聚落与后来美军的进入，构成河谷历史中相隔数百年的不同阶段；水道在军队到来前，早已有自身名称和用途。

english: East of Hawaiʻi Island, the open Pacific extends beyond the volcanic shores of the Hawaiian archipelago. Polynesian settlers reached these islands centuries before European arrival. James Cook sighted the Hawaiian chain in 1778; early the following year his ships anchored at Kealakekua Bay on Hawaiʻi’s western coast.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷岛以东，开阔的太平洋延伸至群岛火山海岸之外。波利尼西亚移民早在欧洲人到来数百年前便已抵达这些岛屿。詹姆斯·库克于1778年望见夏威夷群岛，翌年初其船只停泊在夏威夷岛西岸的凯阿拉凯夸湾。

english: The high sea east of Hawaiʻi Island forms part of the vast North Pacific around the Hawaiian chain. Long before European ships arrived, Polynesian voyagers reached these islands and established communities there. James Cook’s expedition sighted the archipelago in 1778 and subsequently sailed around Hawaiʻi Island.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷岛以东的远海属于环绕夏威夷群岛的浩瀚北太平洋。早在欧洲船只到来之前，波利尼西亚航海者就抵达岛屿并建立了社群。詹姆斯·库克的船队于1778年望见群岛，此后环绕夏威夷岛航行。

english: Northeast of Hawaiʻi, the open ocean reaches beyond the eastern end of the Hawaiian island chain. Polynesian voyagers crossed the Pacific to settle these islands long before European contact. James Cook’s expedition reached the archipelago in 1778, later exploring the northern and eastern sides of Hawaiʻi Island.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷岛东北方，开阔大洋延伸至夏威夷群岛东端以外。波利尼西亚航海者早在欧洲人接触之前便横渡太平洋，定居于这些岛屿。詹姆斯·库克的船队于1778年抵达群岛，后来考察了夏威夷岛北岸和东岸。

english: North of the eastern Hawaiian Islands, open Pacific waters lie beyond the volcanic shores of the archipelago. Polynesian seafarers settled the islands long before European contact. James Cook sighted the Hawaiian chain in 1778, and his ships later circumnavigated Hawaiʻi Island before anchoring on its western coast.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷群岛东部以北，开阔的太平洋水域延伸在火山海岸之外。早在欧洲人到来之前，波利尼西亚航海者已在群岛定居。詹姆斯·库克于1778年望见夏威夷群岛，其船队后来环绕夏威夷岛航行，继而在西岸下锚。

english: The waters north of the Hawaiian Islands lie in the open North Pacific, beyond the archipelago’s volcanic peaks. The islands were settled by Polynesian voyagers long before James Cook reached the chain in 1778. His first Hawaiian landfall was on Kauaʻi, west of the main islands farther east.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷群岛以北的水域位于开阔的北太平洋，群岛火山山峰在其南方。早在詹姆斯·库克于1778年抵达群岛之前，波利尼西亚航海者已在岛上定居。库克首次在夏威夷登陆的地点是主岛群西部的考艾岛。

english: North of the Hawaiian chain, the open ocean separates the main islands from the long reaches of the North Pacific. Hawaiian traditions preserve accounts of voyages west from Niʻihau to Nihoa, an island northwest of Kauaʻi. In 1822 Kaʻahumanu led a royal expedition to Nihoa and claimed it for the Hawaiian kingdom.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷群岛以北的开阔海洋将主岛群与北太平洋的遥远水域连接起来。夏威夷传说保存了从尼豪岛向西航行至考艾岛西北方尼霍阿岛的记忆。1822年，卡阿胡玛努率王室船队到访尼霍阿，宣布其属于夏威夷王国。

english: Northwest of Kauaʻi, the open Pacific surrounds the smaller islands of the northwestern Hawaiian chain. Hawaiian chants and oral histories recount voyages from Niʻihau to Nihoa. In 1822 Kaʻahumanu led a royal expedition to Nihoa and claimed the island for the Hawaiian kingdom.
simp_chinese: 考艾岛西北方，开阔的太平洋环绕夏威夷西北列岛的小岛。夏威夷歌谣和口述历史记载了从尼豪岛到尼霍阿岛的航行。1822年，卡阿胡玛努率王室船队到访尼霍阿，宣布该岛属于夏威夷王国。

english: The Pacific west of Kauaʻi leads toward the low islands and reefs of the northwestern Hawaiian chain. Hawaiian traditions tell of voyages from Niʻihau to Nihoa, west-northwest of Kauaʻi. In 1822 Kaʻahumanu travelled to Nihoa and claimed it for the Hawaiian kingdom.
simp_chinese: 考艾岛以西的太平洋通向夏威夷西北列岛的低矮岛礁。夏威夷传统讲述了从尼豪岛航行至考艾岛西北偏西的尼霍阿岛。1822年，卡阿胡玛努前往尼霍阿，宣布该岛属于夏威夷王国。

english: West of the main Hawaiian Islands, open water leads toward the smaller islands of the northwestern chain. Hawaiian oral traditions recount voyages between Niʻihau and Nihoa, west-northwest of Kauaʻi. In 1822 Kaʻahumanu visited Nihoa with a royal party and claimed it for the Hawaiian kingdom.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷主岛群以西，开阔水域通向西北列岛中较小的岛屿。夏威夷口述传统记载了尼豪岛与考艾岛西北偏西的尼霍阿岛之间的航行。1822年，卡阿胡玛努与王室随员到访尼霍阿，宣布其属于夏威夷王国。

english: West of Hawaiʻi Island lies a broad stretch of ocean between the main Hawaiian Islands and the open Pacific. Their inhabitants were descendants of Polynesian voyagers who had crossed the ocean long before European arrival. On Hawaiʻi’s western shore, Kealakekua Bay became a place of encounter when James Cook’s ships anchored there in 1779.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷岛西方是一片宽广海域，连接夏威夷主岛群与开阔的太平洋。岛民是远在欧洲人到来之前横渡大洋的波利尼西亚航海者后裔。1779年，詹姆斯·库克的船只在夏威夷岛西岸的凯阿拉凯夸湾下锚，这里成为双方相遇之地。

english: Southwest of Hawaiʻi Island the volcanic Hawaiian chain gives way to the open Pacific. Polynesian voyagers reached the islands long before European ships entered these waters. James Cook’s expedition visited Hawaiʻi in 1779, anchoring at Kealakekua Bay on its western shore, where Cook was killed after a confrontation.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷岛西南方，火山构成的夏威夷群岛之外便是开阔太平洋。远在欧洲船只进入这些水域之前，波利尼西亚航海者已抵达岛屿。1779年，詹姆斯·库克的船队到访夏威夷岛，在西岸凯阿拉凯夸湾下锚；库克在一场冲突中遇害。

english: Far west of the main Hawaiian Islands, the open Pacific surrounds the remote reefs and islands of the northwestern chain. Hawaiian traditions recall voyages to Nihoa, nearer the eastern end of this long island chain. In 1822 Kaʻahumanu visited Nihoa and claimed it for the Hawaiian kingdom.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷主岛群远西方，开阔的太平洋环绕着西北列岛偏远的岛礁。夏威夷传统记得前往尼霍阿岛的航行，该岛位于这一长串岛屿较靠东的位置。1822年，卡阿胡玛努到访尼霍阿，宣布它属于夏威夷王国。

english: The ocean west of the main Hawaiian Islands lies near the long chain of small northwestern islands and reefs. Hawaiian oral histories tell of voyages from Niʻihau to Nihoa at the chain’s eastern end. In 1822 Kaʻahumanu led an expedition to Nihoa and claimed it for the Hawaiian kingdom.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷主岛群以西的海洋靠近绵长的西北岛礁链。夏威夷口述历史讲述了从尼豪岛前往这条岛链东端尼霍阿岛的航行。1822年，卡阿胡玛努率船队到访尼霍阿，宣布它属于夏威夷王国。

english: West of Kauaʻi, the Hawaiian archipelago continues as a long line of small islands and reefs amid the Pacific. Hawaiian chants remember journeys to Nihoa near the eastern end of that chain. Kaʻahumanu visited Nihoa with a royal party in 1822 and claimed the island for the Hawaiian kingdom.
simp_chinese: 考艾岛以西，夏威夷群岛在太平洋中延续为一长列小岛与珊瑚礁。夏威夷歌谣记载了前往岛链东端附近尼霍阿岛的航行。1822年，卡阿胡玛努与王室随员到访尼霍阿，宣布它属于夏威夷王国。

english: Northwest of the main Hawaiian Islands, open water lies among the islands and reefs of the northwestern chain. Hawaiian oral histories describe voyages between Niʻihau and Nihoa. In 1822 Kaʻahumanu and a royal party travelled to Nihoa and claimed the island for the Hawaiian kingdom.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷主岛群西北方，开阔水域环绕着西北列岛的岛屿与珊瑚礁。夏威夷口述历史描述了尼豪岛与尼霍阿岛之间的航行。1822年，卡阿胡玛努与王室随员前往尼霍阿，宣布该岛属于夏威夷王国。

english: North of Mokumanamana, the Pacific surrounds the low and isolated islands of the northwestern Hawaiian chain. Hawaiians built ceremonial structures and carved stone images on Mokumanamana before European arrival. In 1786 the French navigator La Pérouse passed the island and named it Necker.
simp_chinese: 莫库马纳马纳岛以北，太平洋环绕着夏威夷西北列岛低矮而孤立的岛屿。欧洲人到来之前，夏威夷人在莫库马纳马纳修建祭祀建筑并雕刻石像。1786年，法国航海家拉佩鲁兹经过此岛，将其命名为内克尔。

english: The northwestern Hawaiian Islands stretch across a remote reach of the Pacific, northwest of the larger Hawaiian Islands. Low islands and reefs punctuate the open sea. Hawaiian voyagers reached some of these islands, including Nihoa and Mokumanamana, leaving traces of visits before sustained European navigation in the region.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷群岛西北部诸岛横跨远离主要夏威夷群岛的太平洋水域。低矮岛屿与礁石点缀在大洋中。夏威夷航海者曾抵达尼豪阿和莫库马纳马纳等岛屿，在欧洲船只持续进入该地区之前留下到访痕迹。

english: Far northwest of the main Hawaiian Islands, open water surrounds remote atolls and reefs. Near the end of the chain lies Kure Atoll, visited by several ships before 1827. Its low coral reef and small islands offered little warning to vessels approaching across the North Pacific.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷主岛群远西北方，开阔水域环绕着偏远环礁和珊瑚礁。岛链末端附近是库雷环礁，1827年以前已有数艘船只到访。低矮的珊瑚礁与小岛难以向横渡北太平洋的船只提供明显警示。

english: The sea north of the northwestern Hawaiian atolls forms part of the open North Pacific. The reefs below are low and widely scattered: Pearl and Hermes Atoll, for example, is mostly submerged. In 1822 its reef wrecked the two British whalers whose names it bears.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷西北环礁以北的海域属于开阔的北太平洋。南面的珊瑚礁低矮而分散，例如珍珠与赫耳墨斯环礁大部分位于水下。1822年，两艘英国捕鲸船在其礁上失事，环礁后来以两船命名。

english: North of Holoikauaua, the North Pacific stretches beyond the low reefs of the Hawaiian chain. The atoll was named Pearl and Hermes after two British whalers that struck its reef on the same night in 1822. Their stranded crews salvaged timber and built a small schooner.
simp_chinese: 霍洛伊考阿瓦阿以北，北太平洋延伸在夏威夷岛链的低矮珊瑚礁之外。1822年，两艘英国捕鲸船同夜在该环礁触礁，环礁后来以两船命名为珍珠与赫耳墨斯。受困船员回收木材，建造了一艘小型纵帆船。

english: The high sea north of the northwestern Hawaiian Islands lies beyond a chain of low islands and submerged reefs. In 1805 the Russian ship Neva grounded near Papaʻāpoho while sailing from Sitka toward Macao. The island and the adjoining shoal were named for the captain and his ship.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷西北列岛北方的远海位于一连串低岛和暗礁之外。1805年，俄国船只“涅瓦”号从锡特卡驶往澳门途中在帕帕阿波霍附近搁浅。该岛和邻近浅滩分别以船长和船只的名字命名。

english: Northeast of Papaʻāpoho, open water extends beyond the scattered reefs of the northwestern Hawaiian chain. The Russian ship Neva grounded near the island in 1805. Its captain Yuri Lisianski freed the ship, giving the island its later European name and the nearby shoal the name of his vessel.
simp_chinese: 帕帕阿波霍东北方，开阔水域延伸至夏威夷西北列岛零散的珊瑚礁之外。1805年，俄国“涅瓦”号在该岛附近搁浅。船长尤里·利相斯基使船脱险；该岛后来的欧洲名称取自船长之名，附近浅滩则以船名命名。

english: Northeast of the low islands of the northwestern Hawaiian chain lies open North Pacific water. The Russian ship Neva encountered the region in 1805, grounding near Papaʻāpoho. Captain Yuri Lisianski freed his ship after jettisoning cargo; the broad shoal nearby came to bear the vessel’s name.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷西北列岛低矮岛屿的东北方是开阔的北太平洋水域。1805年，俄国“涅瓦”号来到这一地区，在帕帕阿波霍附近搁浅。船长尤里·利相斯基抛弃部分货物后使船脱险；附近广阔浅滩后来以船名命名。

english: The open ocean between Mokumanamana and Papaʻāpoho belongs to the northwestern reach of the Hawaiian chain. Hawaiians visited Mokumanamana and left religious structures and carved stone images. Farther northwest, the Russian ship Neva grounded near Papaʻāpoho in 1805 during its voyage across the Pacific.
simp_chinese: 莫库马纳马纳与帕帕阿波霍之间的开阔海域属于夏威夷岛链西北部分。夏威夷人曾到访莫库马纳马纳，留下宗教建筑和雕刻石像。再向西北，俄国“涅瓦”号于1805年横渡太平洋途中在帕帕阿波霍附近搁浅。

english: Southeast of Papaʻāpoho lies a broad expanse of the Pacific, close to the extensive Neva Shoals. In 1805 the Russian vessel Neva ran aground in this region during its voyage from Sitka to Macao. Captain Yuri Lisianski eventually freed the ship from the reef.
simp_chinese: 帕帕阿波霍东南方是一片广阔太平洋，靠近面积巨大的涅瓦浅滩。1805年，俄国船只“涅瓦”号从锡特卡驶往澳门途中在这一地区搁浅。船长尤里·利相斯基最终使船脱离珊瑚礁。

english: South of Papaʻāpoho, the North Pacific surrounds the remote reefs of the northwestern Hawaiian Islands. The Russian ship Neva grounded near the island in 1805, and its captain Yuri Lisianski had to free it from the shallows. A Hawaiian gourd was seen on the beach during the visit.
simp_chinese: 帕帕阿波霍南方，北太平洋环绕着夏威夷西北列岛的偏远珊瑚礁。1805年，俄国“涅瓦”号在岛附近搁浅，船长尤里·利相斯基设法使船脱离浅水。船员到访期间在海滩上看见了一只夏威夷葫芦器皿。

english: Southwest of Holoikauaua, the Pacific stretches around the low reefs of the northwestern Hawaiian chain. In 1822 two British whalers, Pearl and Hermes, were wrecked together on that atoll. Most survivors were eventually taken aboard a passing ship, while others sailed a schooner built from the wreckage to Honolulu.
simp_chinese: 霍洛伊考阿瓦阿西南方，太平洋环绕着夏威夷西北岛链的低矮珊瑚礁。1822年，英国捕鲸船“珍珠”号和“赫耳墨斯”号一同在该环礁失事。大部分幸存者最终由过往船只救走，另一些人乘用残骸建造的纵帆船驶至檀香山。
